column1: 这几天我们在新家坐着看电视的时候，又发现了新问题。房子大了，电视看起来就有点儿小。这个电视是我们结婚时买的，是时候换个新电视了。今天我一直在网上选电视，没想到，现在的电视不仅便宜，而且用着非常方便，有的电视叫它一声就能开机。我看了好几个，都很满意，晚上让一雪来决定吧。
column2: Zhè jǐ tiān wǒmen zài xīn jiā zuòzhe kàn diànshì de shíhou, yòu fāxiàn le xīn wèntí. Fángzi dà le, diànshì kàn qǐlai jiù yǒudiǎnr xiǎo. Zhège diànshì shì wǒmen jiéhūn shí mǎi de, shì shíhou huàn ge xīn diànshì le. Jīntiān wǒ yìzhí zài wǎng shàng xuǎn diànshì, méi xiǎngdào, xiànzài de diànshì bùjǐn piányi, érqiě yòngzhe fēicháng fāngbiàn, yǒude diànshì jiào tā yì shēng jiù néng kāijī. Wǒ kàn le hǎojǐ ge, dōu hěn mǎnyì, wǎnshang ràng Yīxuě lái juédìng ba.
column3: These past few days, sitting and watching TV in the new place, we noticed a new problem. Now that the house is bigger, the TV looks a bit small. This TV was bought when we got married—it's time for a new one. Today I've been picking TVs online, and to my surprise, TVs now are not only cheap but also very easy to use—some turn on just by calling out to them. I looked at several I liked; I'll let Yixue decide tonight.

column3: Tianzhong, I've been seeing you at the gym a lot lately.

column3: After class I often play badminton—come join us.

column3: I'll take you to the hospital and have a doctor check you.

column3: Okay, but if you still have a fever this afternoon, you must go see a doctor.

column3: You don't look like a patient at all.

column3: You run every day and sometimes swim too—could it be too much exercise?

column2: Yīshēng yě zhème shuō, dànshì hái děi zuò wán jiǎnchá cái néng zhīdào.
column3: The doctor said so too, but we won't know until the tests are done.

column1: 别担心！听医生的话，好好休息，你的腿一定能好。

column3: Don't worry! Listen to the doctor, rest well, and your leg will surely get better.

column1: 今天我出院了。出院前，医生给我开了几种药，而且告诉了我吃药的方法。有一种药要每天睡前吃一次，其他几种每天吃三次，饭后吃。除了吃药，医生还说最重要的是多休息。我都记在心里了。回家以后一定会多注意。希望我的腿能快一点儿好。
column2: Jīntiān wǒ chūyuàn le. Chūyuàn qián, yīshēng gěi wǒ kāi le jǐ zhǒng yào, érqiě gàosu le wǒ chī yào de fāngfǎ. Yǒu yì zhǒng yào yào měi tiān shuì qián chī yí cì, qítā jǐ zhǒng měi tiān chī sān cì, fàn hòu chī. Chúle chī yào, yīshēng hái shuō zuì zhòngyào de shì duō xiūxi. Wǒ dōu jì zài xīn li le. Huí jiā yǐhòu yídìng huì duō zhùyì. Xīwàng wǒ de tuǐ néng kuài yìdiǎnr hǎo.
column3: Today I was discharged. Before I left, the doctor prescribed several kinds of medicine and told me how to take them. One kind is taken once a day before bed; the others three times a day, after meals. Besides medicine, the doctor said the most important thing is to rest more. I've kept it all in mind. After going home, I'll be sure to take good care. I hope my leg gets better soon.

column1: 我喜欢看体育比赛，最爱看的就是奥运会。奥运会是世界上影响最大的体育比赛。从1896年到2024年，每次奥运会都有非常多的运动员参加。第一位参加奥运会的中国运动员是刘长春，他1932年参加了100米和200米短跑比赛。虽然他没有得到好成绩，但是他让世界认识了中国。
column2: Wǒ xǐhuan kàn tǐyù bǐsài, zuì ài kàn de jiù shì Àoyùnhuì. Àoyùnhuì shì shìjiè shàng yǐngxiǎng zuì dà de tǐyù bǐsài. Cóng yī bā jiǔ liù nián dào èr líng èr sì nián, měi cì Àoyùnhuì dōu yǒu fēicháng duō de yùndòngyuán cānjiā. Dì-yī wèi cānjiā Àoyùnhuì de Zhōngguó yùndòngyuán shì Liú Chángchūn, tā yī jiǔ sān èr nián cānjiā le yìbǎi mǐ hé èrbǎi mǐ duǎnpǎo bǐsài. Suīrán tā méiyǒu dédào hǎo chéngjì, dànshì tā ràng shìjiè rènshi le Zhōngguó.
column3: I like watching sports, and my favorite is the Olympics. The Olympics is the most influential sporting event in the world. From 1896 to 2024, a great many athletes have competed in every Olympics. The first Chinese athlete to compete in the Olympics was Liu Changchun, who ran the 100m and 200m sprints in 1932. Although he didn't get a good result, he let the world know China.

column3: Didn't you see the email? The manager isn't back yet—the meeting won't be until next week.

column1: 那不着急了。走，吃饭去。
column2: Nà bù zháojí le. Zǒu, chī fàn qù.
column3: Then there's no rush. Come on, let's go eat.

column1: 前几天，上海的同事来北京了。一起吃饭时，他们跟我说最近有不少同事去上海工作了，问我愿意不愿意也去上海。我是这样想的：现在丈夫和孩子都在北京，刘明的工作很忙，小雪和小明也还小，我去别的城市工作就要离开他们。虽然去上海可能会有更好的机会，但是对我来说，生活也很重要，我不愿意为了工作放弃丈夫和孩子。
column2: Qián jǐ tiān, Shànghǎi de tóngshì lái Běijīng le. Yìqǐ chī fàn shí, tāmen gēn wǒ shuō zuìjìn yǒu bù shǎo tóngshì qù Shànghǎi gōngzuò le, wèn wǒ yuànyì bú yuànyì yě qù Shànghǎi. Wǒ shì zhèyàng xiǎng de: xiànzài zhàngfu hé háizi dōu zài Běijīng, Liú Míng de gōngzuò hěn máng, Xiǎoxuě hé Xiǎomíng yě hái xiǎo, wǒ qù biéde chéngshì gōngzuò jiù yào líkāi tāmen. Suīrán qù Shànghǎi kěnéng huì yǒu gèng hǎo de jīhuì, dànshì duì wǒ lái shuō, shēnghuó yě hěn zhòngyào, wǒ bú yuànyì wèile gōngzuò fàngqì zhàngfu hé háizi.
column3: A few days ago, a colleague from Shanghai came to Beijing. Over a meal, they told me quite a few colleagues had gone to work in Shanghai recently and asked whether I'd be willing to go too. Here's how I see it: my husband and children are all in Beijing now, Liu Ming's job is busy, and Xiaoxue and Xiaoming are still young—working in another city would mean leaving them. Although going to Shanghai might bring better opportunities, for me, life matters too, and I'm not willing to give up my husband and children for work.

column1: 王老师，您看，这条街上的树都开花了。
column2: Wáng lǎoshī, nín kàn, zhè tiáo jiē shàng de shù dōu kāihuā le.
column3: Teacher Wang, look—the trees on this street are all in bloom.

column1: 上周我去公园坐船了，公园里的花也开了。
column2: Shàng zhōu wǒ qù gōngyuán zuò chuán le, gōngyuán li de huā yě kāi le.
column3: Last week I went boating in the park; the flowers there are blooming too.

column1: 天气这么好，下午我也想去公园坐船。
column2: Tiānqì zhème hǎo, xiàwǔ wǒ yě xiǎng qù gōngyuán zuò chuán.
column3: The weather's so nice—this afternoon I'd like to go boating in the park too.

column1: 去吧！今天是工作日，人应该不多。
column2: Qù ba! Jīntiān shì gōngzuòrì, rén yīnggāi bù duō.
column3: Go for it! It's a weekday, so it shouldn't be crowded.

column1: 您有时间吗？我想跟您一起去。
column2: Nín yǒu shíjiān ma? Wǒ xiǎng gēn nín yìqǐ qù.
column3: Do you have time? I'd like to go with you.

column1: 我今天下午有课，不能去太远的地方。
column2: Wǒ jīntiān xiàwǔ yǒu kè, bù néng qù tài yuǎn de dìfang.
column3: I have class this afternoon, so I can't go anywhere too far.

column1: 那咱们换一天去？
column2: Nà zánmen huàn yì tiān qù?
column3: Then shall we go another day?

column1: 行。或者明天去，或者后天去，我给你打电话。
column2: Xíng. Huòzhě míngtiān qù, huòzhě hòutiān qù, wǒ gěi nǐ dǎ diànhuà.
column3: Sure. Either tomorrow or the day after—I'll call you.

column1: 刚才还是大晴天呢，怎么突然就刮起风来了？
column2: Gāngcái háishi dà qíngtiān ne, zěnme tūrán jiù guā qǐ fēng lái le?
column3: It was sunny just now—how did the wind suddenly pick up?

column1: 好像新闻里说今天有雨。
column2: Hǎoxiàng xīnwén li shuō jīntiān yǒu yǔ.
column3: I think the news said it would rain today.

column1: 啊？我每天书包里都放着雨伞，就今天没带。
column2: À? Wǒ měi tiān shūbāo li dōu fàngzhe yǔsǎn, jiù jīntiān méi dài.
column3: Huh? I keep an umbrella in my bag every day—and today's the one day I didn't bring it.

column1: 我可以借给你，我车里有一把伞和一件雨衣。
column2: Wǒ kěyǐ jiè gěi nǐ, wǒ chē li yǒu yì bǎ sǎn hé yí jiàn yǔyī.
column3: I can lend you one—I have an umbrella and a raincoat in my car.

column1: 谢谢，希望下午天气能变好。
column2: Xièxie, xīwàng xiàwǔ tiānqì néng biàn hǎo.
column3: Thanks—I hope the weather improves this afternoon.

column1: 这个季节天气变化很快。
column2: Zhège jìjié tiānqì biànhuà hěn kuài.
column3: The weather changes fast this season.

column1: 雨已经下起来了，咱们快点儿走吧。
column2: Yǔ yǐjīng xià qǐlai le, zánmen kuài diǎnr zǒu ba.
column3: It's started raining—let's hurry.

column1: 您来这里已经一年多了，习惯了吧？
column2: Nín lái zhèlǐ yǐjīng yì nián duō le, xíguàn le ba?
column3: You've been here over a year now—you must be used to it?

column1: 别的早就习惯了，就是天气我还不太习惯。
column2: Biéde zǎo jiù xíguàn le, jiù shì tiānqì wǒ hái bú tài xíguàn.
column3: I got used to everything else long ago—it's just the weather I'm still not quite used to.

column1: 为什么？您不喜欢这里的天气吗？
column2: Wèishénme? Nín bù xǐhuan zhèlǐ de tiānqì ma?
column3: Why? Don't you like the weather here?

column1: 我觉得冬天太冷了。
column2: Wǒ juéde dōngtiān tài lěng le.
column3: I find the winters too cold.

column1: 冬天虽然冷，但是下雪的时候特别漂亮。
column2: Dōngtiān suīrán lěng, dànshì xià xuě de shíhou tèbié piàoliang.
column3: Winter is cold, but it's especially beautiful when it snows.

column1: 我也喜欢雪。北京常常下雪，但听说今年就下了一次。
column2: Wǒ yě xǐhuan xuě. Běijīng chángcháng xià xuě, dàn tīngshuō jīnnián jiù xià le yí cì.
column3: I like snow too. It often snows in Beijing, but I hear it only snowed once this year.

column1: 我没关注过北京的天气，但是新闻里说过，今年冬天很多地方雪下得都少了。
column2: Wǒ méi guānzhù guo Běijīng de tiānqì, dànshì xīnwén li shuōguo, jīnnián dōngtiān hěn duō dìfang xuě xià de dōu shǎo le.
column3: I haven't followed Beijing's weather, but the news said that this winter many places had less snowfall.

column1: 我离开北京到这里工作一年多了。这一年多住下来，我还是更喜欢北京的四季。北京的春天最舒服，天气不冷不热，夏天白天很热，但是晚上比较凉快。秋天树上的叶子都变成了红色、黄色，非常漂亮。冬天不但冷，而且风很大，我最不喜欢冬天。每个人都有自己最喜欢的季节，你最喜欢哪个季节呢？
column2: Wǒ líkāi Běijīng dào zhèlǐ gōngzuò yì nián duō le. Zhè yì nián duō zhù xiàlai, wǒ háishi gèng xǐhuan Běijīng de sìjì. Běijīng de chūntiān zuì shūfu, tiānqì bù lěng bú rè, xiàtiān báitiān hěn rè, dànshì wǎnshang bǐjiào liángkuai. Qiūtiān shù shàng de yèzi dōu biàn chéng le hóngsè, huángsè, fēicháng piàoliang. Dōngtiān búdàn lěng, érqiě fēng hěn dà, wǒ zuì bù xǐhuan dōngtiān. Měi ge rén dōu yǒu zìjǐ zuì xǐhuan de jìjié, nǐ zuì xǐhuan nǎge jìjié ne?
column3: I left Beijing to work here over a year ago. After living here for over a year, I still prefer Beijing's four seasons. Beijing's spring is the most comfortable—neither cold nor hot; in summer the days are hot, but the evenings are fairly cool. In autumn the leaves turn red and yellow, very beautiful. Winter is not only cold but also very windy—I dislike winter most. Everyone has their own favorite season; which season do you like best?

column1: 今天我请客，你们想吃什么就点什么！
column2: Jīntiān wǒ qǐngkè, nǐmen xiǎng chī shénme jiù diǎn shénme!
column3: It's my treat today—order whatever you want to eat!

column1: 那我就不客气了。听说这家饭馆的鱼做得很特别？
column2: Nà wǒ jiù bú kèqi le. Tīngshuō zhè jiā fànguǎn de yú zuò de hěn tèbié?
column3: Then I won't be shy. I hear this restaurant's fish is made in a special way?

column1: 对，南方菜跟你们北方菜的做法不同。除了鱼，你们还想吃什么？
column2: Duì, nánfāng cài gēn nǐmen běifāng cài de zuòfǎ bùtóng. Chúle yú, nǐmen hái xiǎng chī shénme?
column3: Right, southern cuisine is prepared differently from your northern dishes. Besides fish, what else would you like?

column1: 我不常吃南方菜，还是你决定吧。
column2: Wǒ bù cháng chī nánfāng cài, háishi nǐ juédìng ba.
column3: I don't often eat southern food—you decide.

column1: 好，那再加一个鸡肉，一个……
column2: Hǎo, nà zài jiā yí ge jīròu, yí ge……
column3: Okay, then add a chicken dish, and one more…

column1: 咱们就三个人，别点那么多。
column2: Zánmen jiù sān ge rén, bié diǎn nàme duō.
column3: There are only three of us—don't order so much.

column1: 好，那先来这几个菜。
column2: Hǎo, nà xiān lái zhè jǐ ge cài.
column3: Okay, let's start with these few dishes.

column1: 对了，下周我儿子过生日，你们有时间的话，就来我家做客，我给你们做北京菜。
column2: Duì le, xià zhōu wǒ érzi guò shēngrì, nǐmen yǒu shíjiān de huà, jiù lái wǒ jiā zuòkè, wǒ gěi nǐmen zuò Běijīng cài.
column3: By the way, my son's birthday is next week—if you have time, come over to my place, and I'll cook you some Beijing dishes.

column1: 第一次请新邻居来做客，总是担心有什么没准备好。
column2: Dì-yī cì qǐng xīn línjū lái zuòkè, zǒngshì dānxīn yǒu shénme méi zhǔnbèi hǎo.
column3: It's the first time inviting the new neighbors over—I keep worrying something isn't ready.

column1: 放心吧，我都准备了，都已经准备好了。
column2: Fàngxīn ba, wǒ dōu zhǔnbèi le, dōu yǐjīng zhǔnbèi hǎo le.
column3: Relax—I've prepared everything; it's all ready.

column1: 我记得刚才已经把饮料拿出来了，怎么不见了？
column2: Wǒ jìde gāngcái yǐjīng bǎ yǐnliào ná chūlai le, zěnme bú jiàn le?
column3: I remember I took the drinks out just now—how come they're gone?

column1: 我把饮料和酒都放进冰箱里了，客人来了再拿出来。
column2: Wǒ bǎ yǐnliào hé jiǔ dōu fàng jìn bīngxiāng li le, kèrén lái le zài ná chūlai.
column3: I put the drinks and wine back in the fridge—I'll take them out when the guests arrive.

column1: 音乐的声音合适吗？
column2: Yīnyuè de shēngyīn héshì ma?
column3: Is the music volume okay?

column1: 你把声音开得太大了，我去关小一点儿。
column2: Nǐ bǎ shēngyīn kāi de tài dà le, wǒ qù guān xiǎo yìdiǎnr.
column3: You've got the volume too loud—I'll go turn it down a bit.

column1: 好，那我们就等客人来吧。
column2: Hǎo, nà wǒmen jiù děng kèrén lái ba.
column3: Okay, then let's wait for the guests to arrive.

column1: 谢谢你们来参加我儿子的生日晚会，希望大家今晚玩得开心。
column2: Xièxie nǐmen lái cānjiā wǒ érzi de shēngrì wǎnhuì, xīwàng dàjiā jīnwǎn wán de kāixīn.
column3: Thank you all for coming to my son's birthday party—I hope everyone has fun tonight.

column1: 小明，生日快乐！我准备了一个小礼物，希望你喜欢！
column2: Xiǎomíng, shēngrì kuàilè! Wǒ zhǔnbèi le yí ge xiǎo lǐwù, xīwàng nǐ xǐhuan!
column3: Xiaoming, happy birthday! I got you a little gift—I hope you like it!

column1: 谢谢您，我可以打开吗？
column2: Xièxie nín, wǒ kěyǐ dǎkāi ma?
column3: Thank you—may I open it?

column1: 当然可以，你妈妈说你跟姐姐一样，都喜欢画画，对吗？
column2: Dāngrán kěyǐ, nǐ māma shuō nǐ gēn jiějie yíyàng, dōu xǐhuan huà huà, duì ma?
column3: Of course. Your mom said you like drawing, just like your sister—right?

column1: 对，我想做一名画家。啊！画板和画笔，这正是我需要的。我太喜欢了。
column2: Duì, wǒ xiǎng zuò yì míng huàjiā. À! Huàbǎn hé huàbǐ, zhè zhèng shì wǒ xūyào de. Wǒ tài xǐhuan le.
column3: Yes, I want to be a painter. Oh! A drawing board and brushes—that's exactly what I need. I love it.

column1: 我去把盘子拿过来，咱们一边吃蛋糕、一边聊天儿吧。
column2: Wǒ qù bǎ pánzi ná guòlai, zánmen yìbiān chī dàngāo, yìbiān liáotiānr ba.
column3: I'll go get the plates—let's eat cake and chat.

column1: 我的新邻居是来自英国的夫妻。上周我去他们家做客了。他们做了很多好吃的，还准备了英国的红茶。那天我跟他们一边喝红茶，一边聊天儿，直到十二点多才回家。他们年轻的时候喜欢旅游，他家有一张世界地图，上面每一个红点都是他们去过的地方。后来，他们感到东方的文化很特别，就开始学习中文。今天是小明的生日，我请他们到我家玩，来看中国人的家，也尝尝中国菜。
column2: Wǒ de xīn línjū shì láizì Yīngguó de fūqī. Shàng zhōu wǒ qù tāmen jiā zuòkè le. Tāmen zuò le hěn duō hǎochī de, hái zhǔnbèi le Yīngguó de hóngchá. Nà tiān wǒ gēn tāmen yìbiān hē hóngchá, yìbiān liáotiānr, zhídào shí'èr diǎn duō cái huí jiā. Tāmen niánqīng de shíhou xǐhuan lǚyóu, tā jiā yǒu yì zhāng shìjiè dìtú, shàngmiàn měi yí ge hóng diǎn dōu shì tāmen qùguo de dìfang. Hòulái, tāmen gǎndào dōngfāng de wénhuà hěn tèbié, jiù kāishǐ xuéxí Zhōngwén. Jīntiān shì Xiǎomíng de shēngrì, wǒ qǐng tāmen dào wǒ jiā wán, lái kàn Zhōngguórén de jiā, yě chángchang Zhōngguó cài.
column3: My new neighbors are a couple from England. Last week I visited their home. They made lots of delicious food and prepared English black tea. That day I drank black tea and chatted with them until past twelve before going home. When they were young they liked to travel; they have a world map at home, and every red dot on it is a place they've been. Later, they felt Eastern culture was special and began learning Chinese. Today is Xiaoming's birthday, so I invited them to my home to play, to see a Chinese family's home and taste Chinese food.

column1: 我借的这本词典最好今天还，但是我没时间去。
column2: Wǒ jiè de zhè běn cídiǎn zuìhǎo jīntiān huán, dànshì wǒ méi shíjiān qù.
column3: This dictionary I borrowed should really be returned today, but I don't have time to go.

column1: 下午我只有两节课，可以帮你去图书馆还书。
column2: Xiàwǔ wǒ zhǐ yǒu liǎng jié kè, kěyǐ bāng nǐ qù túshūguǎn huán shū.
column3: I only have two classes this afternoon—I can return the book at the library for you.

column1: 那太谢谢了。你能再帮我借本书吗？
column2: Nà tài xièxie le. Nǐ néng zài bāng wǒ jiè běn shū ma?
column3: Thank you so much. Could you also borrow a book for me?

column1: 行，你告诉我书名。
column2: Xíng, nǐ gàosu wǒ shūmíng.
column3: Sure—tell me the title.

column1: 我把名字写在纸上吧。我去了好几次图书馆，这本书都被别人借走了。
column2: Wǒ bǎ míngzi xiě zài zhǐ shàng ba. Wǒ qù le hǎojǐ cì túshūguǎn, zhè běn shū dōu bèi biéren jiè zǒu le.
column3: I'll write the title on paper. I went to the library several times, but this book had always been borrowed by someone else.

column1: 《名人的故事》？我有这本书。明天我借给你吧。
column2: Míngrén de gùshi? Wǒ yǒu zhè běn shū. Míngtiān wǒ jiè gěi nǐ ba.
column3: Stories of Famous People? I have this book. I'll lend it to you tomorrow.

column1: 今天下课早，你一会儿做什么？
column2: Jīntiān xiàkè zǎo, nǐ yíhuìr zuò shénme?
column3: Class ended early today—what are you doing later?

column1: 我今天忙得很，要先去图书馆借书，然后去游泳。
column2: Wǒ jīntiān máng de hěn, yào xiān qù túshūguǎn jiè shū, ránhòu qù yóuyǒng.
column3: I'm really busy today—I need to borrow a book at the library first, then go swimming.

column1: 咱们一起走吧，我想去图书馆看看中文报纸。
column2: Zánmen yìqǐ zǒu ba, wǒ xiǎng qù túshūguǎn kànkan Zhōngwén bàozhǐ.
column3: Let's go together—I want to read Chinese newspapers at the library.

column1: 等等，我的校园卡不见了，没有卡进不去图书馆。
column2: Děngdeng, wǒ de xiàoyuánkǎ bú jiàn le, méiyǒu kǎ jìn bú qù túshūguǎn.
column3: Wait—my campus card is missing; without it I can't get into the library.

column1: 你想想上一次用是什么时候？
column2: Nǐ xiǎngxiang shàng yí cì yòng shì shénme shíhou?
column3: Think about when you last used it.

column1: 我忘记了，可能被我放在家里了。
column2: Wǒ wàngjì le, kěnéng bèi wǒ fàng zài jiā li le.
column3: I've forgotten—maybe I left it at home.

column1: 进不去图书馆也没关系，上网看看有没有电子书。
column2: Jìn bú qù túshūguǎn yě méi guānxi, shàngwǎng kànkan yǒu méiyǒu diànzǐshū.
column3: It's okay if you can't get into the library—check online for an e-book.

column1: 不行，我必须去，我还得帮李文还书呢。
column2: Bù xíng, wǒ bìxū qù, wǒ hái děi bāng Lǐ Wén huán shū ne.
column3: No, I have to go—I still need to return a book for Li Wen.

column1: 下周学校有晚会，你知道吗？
column2: Xià zhōu xuéxiào yǒu wǎnhuì, nǐ zhīdào ma?
column3: There's a school party next week—did you know?

column1: 知道，我和几个女生要表演一个节目。你也参加吗？
column2: Zhīdào, wǒ hé jǐ ge nǚshēng yào biǎoyǎn yí ge jiémù. Nǐ yě cānjiā ma?
column3: Yes—some other girls and I are going to perform an act. Are you taking part too?

column1: 我想唱中文歌，但是还没找到人一起表演，不知道怎么办。
column2: Wǒ xiǎng chàng Zhōngwén gē, dànshì hái méi zhǎodào rén yìqǐ biǎoyǎn, bù zhīdào zěnme bàn.
column3: I want to sing a Chinese song, but I haven't found anyone to perform with—I don't know what to do.

column1: 找不到人，你就一个人唱吧。
column2: Zhǎobudào rén, nǐ jiù yí ge rén chàng ba.
column3: If you can't find anyone, just sing solo.

column1: 一想到要在校长、老师和那么多同学面前表演，我就有些紧张。
column2: Yì xiǎngdào yào zài xiàozhǎng, lǎoshī hé nàme duō tóngxué miànqián biǎoyǎn, wǒ jiù yǒuxiē jǐnzhāng.
column3: Just thinking about performing in front of the principal, teachers, and so many classmates makes me a bit nervous.

column1: 紧张什么啊，我们都喜欢听你唱歌，你要相信自己。
column2: Jǐnzhāng shénme a, wǒmen dōu xǐhuan tīng nǐ chànggē, nǐ yào xiāngxìn zìjǐ.
column3: What's there to be nervous about? We all love hearing you sing—you have to believe in yourself.

column1: 昨天是我们学校的新年晚会，每个班级的同学都表演节目了。晚会是八点开始的，差不多十二点才结束。我一个晚上跟大家一起又唱又跳，开心极了，也累坏了。我最喜欢的节目是留学生们跳舞，最后老师和校长也被叫起来一块儿跳，特别有意思。过几天学校的网站上会有晚会的视频，我打算再看一遍。
column2: Zuótiān shì wǒmen xuéxiào de xīnnián wǎnhuì, měi ge bānjí de tóngxué dōu biǎoyǎn jiémù le. Wǎnhuì shì bā diǎn kāishǐ de, chàbuduō shí'èr diǎn cái jiéshù. Wǒ yí ge wǎnshang gēn dàjiā yìqǐ yòu chàng yòu tiào, kāixīn jí le, yě lèihuài le. Wǒ zuì xǐhuan de jiémù shì liúxuéshēngmen tiàowǔ, zuìhòu lǎoshī hé xiàozhǎng yě bèi jiào qǐlai yíkuàir tiào, tèbié yǒu yìsi. Guò jǐ tiān xuéxiào de wǎngzhàn shàng huì yǒu wǎnhuì de shìpín, wǒ dǎsuàn zài kàn yí biàn.
column3: Yesterday was our school's New Year party, and students from every class performed. The party started at eight and didn't end until nearly twelve. I sang and danced with everyone all evening—I was thrilled, and also worn out. My favorite act was the international students' dance; at the end, the teachers and principal were even pulled up to dance too, which was really fun. In a few days there'll be a video of the party on the school website, and I plan to watch it again.

column1: 您搬到蓝天小区一段时间了，觉得怎么样？
column2: Nín bān dào Lántiān Xiǎoqū yí duàn shíjiān le, juéde zěnmeyàng?
column3: You've lived in Lantian residential complex for a while now—how do you find it?

column1: 小区环境挺好的，附近买东西也很方便，过马路就是超市。
column2: Xiǎoqū huánjìng tǐng hǎo de, fùjìn mǎi dōngxi yě hěn fāngbiàn, guò mǎlù jiù shì chāoshì.
column3: The complex has a nice environment, and shopping nearby is convenient—cross the street and there's a supermarket.

column1: 平时孩子们在哪儿玩？
column2: Píngshí háizimen zài nǎr wán?
column3: Where do the children usually play?

column1: 小区里有很多树，孩子们放学后就在树下做游戏。你想买房子吗？
column2: Xiǎoqū li yǒu hěn duō shù, háizimen fàngxué hòu jiù zài shù xià zuò yóuxì. Nǐ xiǎng mǎi fángzi ma?
column3: There are lots of trees in the complex, and the kids play games under them after school. Are you thinking of buying a place?

column1: 是。我想买一个大房子，让我爸妈过来跟我一起住。
column2: Shì. Wǒ xiǎng mǎi yí ge dà fángzi, ràng wǒ bà mā guòlai gēn wǒ yìqǐ zhù.
column3: Yes. I want to buy a big house so my parents can come live with me.

column1: 蓝天小区的老人挺多的，这几年小区根据他们的需要，有了很多变化。
column2: Lántiān Xiǎoqū de lǎorén tǐng duō de, zhè jǐ nián xiǎoqū gēnjù tāmen de xūyào, yǒu le hěn duō biànhuà.
column3: Lantian complex has quite a few elderly people, and in recent years it's made many changes to meet their needs.

column1: 真不错！过几天我去蓝天小区看看。
column2: Zhēn búcuò! Guò jǐ tiān wǒ qù Lántiān Xiǎoqū kànkan.
column3: That's great! In a few days I'll go take a look at Lantian complex.

column1: 假期我想去南京旅游，但是我不太了解那里。
column2: Jiàqī wǒ xiǎng qù Nánjīng lǚyóu, dànshì wǒ bú tài liǎojiě nàli.
column3: I want to travel to Nanjing over the holiday, but I don't know much about it.

column1: 我虽然不是南京人，可是我是在南京上的大学，可以说是半个南京人。
column2: Wǒ suīrán bú shì Nánjīng rén, kěshì wǒ shì zài Nánjīng shàng de dàxué, kěyǐ shuō shì bàn ge Nánjīng rén.
column3: Although I'm not from Nanjing, I went to university there, so you could say I'm half a Nanjing local.

column1: 太好了！你快给我介绍一下南京吧。
column2: Tài hǎo le! Nǐ kuài gěi wǒ jièshào yíxià Nánjīng ba.
column3: Great! Tell me about Nanjing.

column1: 南京有两千年以上的历史，有老城、老街，还有很多有名的景点，每年去旅游的游客特别多。
column2: Nánjīng yǒu liǎngqiān nián yǐshàng de lìshǐ, yǒu lǎo chéng, lǎo jiē, háiyǒu hěn duō yǒumíng de jǐngdiǎn, měi nián qù lǚyóu de yóukè tèbié duō.
column3: Nanjing has over two thousand years of history, with an old city, old streets, and many famous attractions—huge numbers of tourists visit every year.

column1: 除了这些以外，你再告诉我一些外地人不知道的地方。
column2: Chúle zhèxiē yǐwài, nǐ zài gàosu wǒ yìxiē wàidì rén bù zhīdào de dìfang.
column3: Besides these, tell me about some places that out-of-towners don't know about.

column1: 那太多了，我得一点儿一点儿给您讲。
column2: Nà tài duō le, wǒ děi yìdiǎnr yìdiǎnr gěi nín jiǎng.
column3: There are so many—I'll have to tell you bit by bit.

column1: 行，下班后我请你吃晚饭，咱们边吃边聊。
column2: Xíng, xiàbān hòu wǒ qǐng nǐ chī wǎnfàn, zánmen biān chī biān liáo.
column3: Sure—after work I'll treat you to dinner, and we'll talk while we eat.

column1: 小明，中国有一条大河，它的名字跟颜色有关系，你知道是什么河吗？
column2: Xiǎomíng, Zhōngguó yǒu yì tiáo dà hé, tā de míngzi gēn yánsè yǒu guānxi, nǐ zhīdào shì shénme hé ma?
column3: Xiaoming, China has a great river whose name is related to a color—do you know which river it is?

column1: 我知道，是黄河！
column2: Wǒ zhīdào, shì Huáng Hé!
column3: I know—it's the Yellow River!

column1: 你说对了。我再问问你，你知道它为什么叫黄河吗？
column2: Nǐ shuō duì le. Wǒ zài wènwen nǐ, nǐ zhīdào tā wèishénme jiào Huáng Hé ma?
column3: You're right. Let me ask you another: do you know why it's called the Yellow River?

column1: 因为河水看起来是黄色的，所以叫这个名字。黄河是中国最长的河吗？
column2: Yīnwèi héshuǐ kàn qǐlai shì huángsè de, suǒyǐ jiào zhège míngzi. Huáng Hé shì Zhōngguó zuì cháng de hé ma?
column3: Because the water looks yellow, so it got this name. Is the Yellow River China's longest river?

column1: 不是。黄河虽然不是最长的河，可是在历史上很重要。
column2: Bú shì. Huáng Hé suīrán bú shì zuì cháng de hé, kěshì zài lìshǐ shàng hěn zhòngyào.
column3: No. Although the Yellow River isn't the longest, it's very important in history.

column1: 这个我知道。很久以前，很多中国人都住在黄河边上。
column2: Zhège wǒ zhīdào. Hěn jiǔ yǐqián, hěn duō Zhōngguórén dōu zhù zài Huáng Hé biān shàng.
column3: I know this. Long ago, many Chinese people lived along the Yellow River.

column1: 对。在我们中国人看来，黄河像妈妈一样，养了我们几千年。
column2: Duì. Zài wǒmen Zhōngguórén kànlái, Huáng Hé xiàng māma yíyàng, yǎng le wǒmen jǐqiān nián.
column3: Right. To us Chinese, the Yellow River is like a mother—it has nourished us for thousands of years.

column1: 我小时候住在北京的西北边，有一条非常有名的河经过那里。我家就住在河边。那里有高高的大树和绿绿的草地。春天，河边的花都开了，看起来特别漂亮。还记得小时候，一到夏天我就去河里游泳。长大以后，遇到什么不开心的事情，我就去河边的树下坐着，听听鸟叫，看看河水，跟遇见的朋友聊聊天儿，难过的事情不一会儿就忘了。那是我最喜欢的地方。
column2: Wǒ xiǎoshíhou zhù zài Běijīng de xīběibian, yǒu yì tiáo fēicháng yǒumíng de hé jīngguò nàli. Wǒ jiā jiù zhù zài hé biān. Nàli yǒu gāogāo de dà shù hé lǜlǜ de cǎodì. Chūntiān, hé biān de huā dōu kāi le, kàn qǐlai tèbié piàoliang. Hái jìde xiǎoshíhou, yí dào xiàtiān wǒ jiù qù hé li yóuyǒng. Zhǎng dà yǐhòu, yùdào shénme bù kāixīn de shìqing, wǒ jiù qù hé biān de shù xià zuòzhe, tīngting niǎo jiào, kànkan héshuǐ, gēn yùjiàn de péngyou liáoliao tiānr, nánguò de shìqing bù yíhuìr jiù wàng le. Nà shì wǒ zuì xǐhuan de dìfang.
column3: When I was little I lived in the northwest of Beijing, where a very famous river passed through. My home was right by the river. There were tall trees and green grass. In spring, the flowers by the river bloomed and looked especially beautiful. I still remember that as a child, come summer, I'd go swimming in the river. As I grew up, whenever I ran into something upsetting, I'd go sit under the trees by the river, listen to the birds, watch the water, and chat with friends I met—my troubles would be forgotten in no time. That was my favorite place.

column1: 这只小猫你们养了多久了？
column2: Zhè zhī xiǎo māo nǐmen yǎng le duōjiǔ le?
column3: How long have you had this kitten?

column1: 已经一年多了。第一天看见它的时候，它又脏又小。
column2: Yǐjīng yì nián duō le. Dì-yī tiān kànjiàn tā de shíhou, tā yòu zāng yòu xiǎo.
column3: Over a year now. The first day I saw it, it was dirty and tiny.

column1: 现在它变得又干净又漂亮了。
column2: Xiànzài tā biàn de yòu gānjìng yòu piàoliang le.
column3: Now it's become clean and pretty.

column1: 是啊。它还特别可爱，一会儿在你脚边睡觉，一会儿在你身上爬。
column2: Shì a. Tā hái tèbié kě'ài, yíhuìr zài nǐ jiǎo biān shuìjiào, yíhuìr zài nǐ shēn shàng pá.
column3: Yeah. It's really cute too—one moment sleeping by your feet, the next climbing on you.

column1: 你们把它照顾得真好。
column2: Nǐmen bǎ tā zhàogù de zhēn hǎo.
column3: You've taken really good care of it.

column1: 它就好像我们的孩子，我们照顾它，它也认得我们了。
column2: Tā jiù hǎoxiàng wǒmen de háizi, wǒmen zhàogù tā, tā yě rènde wǒmen le.
column3: It's just like our child—we take care of it, and it knows us now.

column1: 妈妈，我们家也养一只小猫吧。
column2: Māma, wǒmen jiā yě yǎng yì zhī xiǎo māo ba.
column3: Mom, let's get a kitten too.

column1: 咱们没时间照顾，还是别养了，我周末带你们去北京动物园看动物吧。
column2: Zánmen méi shíjiān zhàogù, háishi bié yǎng le, wǒ zhōumò dài nǐmen qù Běijīng dòngwùyuán kàn dòngwù ba.
column3: We don't have time to look after one—let's not. I'll take you to the Beijing Zoo to see animals this weekend.

column1: 妈妈，大熊猫这个名字很奇怪，它们跟猫有什么关系？
column2: Māma, dà xióngmāo zhège míngzi hěn qíguài, tāmen gēn māo yǒu shénme guānxi?
column3: Mom, the name "giant panda" is strange—what do they have to do with cats?

column1: 这个问题问得好。它们跟猫没什么关系，其实应该叫大猫熊。
column2: Zhège wèntí wèn de hǎo. Tāmen gēn māo méi shénme guānxi, qíshí yīnggāi jiào dà māoxióng.
column3: Good question. They have little to do with cats—actually they should be called "big cat-bears."

column1: 大熊猫为什么只吃竹子不吃肉？
column2: Dà xióngmāo wèishénme zhǐ chī zhúzi bù chī ròu?
column3: Why do giant pandas only eat bamboo and not meat?

column1: 它们跟人一样，也可以吃肉，但是对肉不感兴趣。
column2: Tāmen gēn rén yíyàng, yě kěyǐ chī ròu, dànshì duì ròu bù gǎn xìngqù.
column3: Like humans, they can eat meat too, but they're just not interested in it.

column1: 大熊猫为什么是中国的国宝？
column2: Dà xióngmāo wèishénme shì Zhōngguó de guóbǎo?
column3: Why are giant pandas China's national treasure?

column1: 全世界只有中国有野生大熊猫，中国是大熊猫的家。
column2: Quán shìjiè zhǐyǒu Zhōngguó yǒu yěshēng dà xióngmāo, Zhōngguó shì dà xióngmāo de jiā.
column3: China is the only place in the world with wild giant pandas—China is their home.

column1: 我听说有的熊猫出国了，他们去哪儿了？
column2: Wǒ tīngshuō yǒude xióngmāo chū guó le, tāmen qù nǎr le?
column3: I heard some pandas have gone abroad—where did they go?

column1: 关于这个问题，我得慢慢给你讲。
column2: Guānyú zhège wèntí, wǒ děi mànmàn gěi nǐ jiǎng.
column3: As for that, I'll have to explain it to you slowly.

column1: 弟弟，你真是“十万个为什么”。
column2: Dìdi, nǐ zhēn shì "shí wàn ge wèishénme".
column3: Little brother, you really are a "hundred thousand whys."

column1: 这只大熊猫一会儿爬上去，一会儿跳下来，可爱极了！
column2: Zhè zhī dà xióngmāo yíhuìr pá shàngqu, yíhuìr tiào xiàlai, kě'ài jí le!
column3: This giant panda climbs up one moment and jumps down the next—it's so cute!

column1: 它好像还没吃饱，站起来张着嘴找吃的呢。
column2: Tā hǎoxiàng hái méi chībǎo, zhàn qǐlai zhāngzhe zuǐ zhǎo chī de ne.
column3: It doesn't seem full yet—it's standing up with its mouth open, looking for food.

column1: 它身边那只熊猫半天没动，是不是在睡觉呢？
column2: Tā shēnbiān nà zhī xióngmāo bàntiān méi dòng, shì bu shì zài shuìjiào ne?
column3: The panda next to it hasn't moved for a while—is it sleeping?

column1: 我看不见它的脸，可能是吧。一般来说，熊猫每天要睡很多次觉。
column2: Wǒ kànbujiàn tā de liǎn, kěnéng shì ba. Yìbān lái shuō, xióngmāo měi tiān yào shuì hěn duō cì jiào.
column3: I can't see its face—probably. Generally, pandas sleep many times a day.

column1: 对，除了睡觉以外，很多时间都在吃东西。
column2: Duì, chúle shuìjiào yǐwài, hěn duō shíjiān dōu zài chī dōngxi.
column3: Right—apart from sleeping, they spend a lot of time eating.

column1: 大熊猫的生活真舒服啊！
column2: Dà xióngmāo de shēnghuó zhēn shūfu a!
column3: Giant pandas really have a comfortable life!

column1: 妈妈，您帮我和这两只大熊猫照一张照片吧。
column2: Māma, nín bāng wǒ hé zhè liǎng zhī dà xióngmāo zhào yì zhāng zhàopiàn ba.
column3: Mom, take a photo of me with these two giant pandas.

column1: 今天我带小雪和小明去动物园玩了。北京动物园是中国很有名的动物园，里面有非常多的动物，当然，大人和孩子最喜爱的还是大熊猫。每天有很多游客去熊猫馆，他们带着相机去给可爱的大熊猫拍照。动物园早上七点半开门，晚上七点关门，冬天比夏天游客少，所以也比平时早关门一个小时。如果第一次来北京旅游，跟家人一起去北京动物园是个不错的选择。
column2: Jīntiān wǒ dài Xiǎoxuě hé Xiǎomíng qù dòngwùyuán wán le. Běijīng dòngwùyuán shì Zhōngguó hěn yǒumíng de dòngwùyuán, lǐmiàn yǒu fēicháng duō de dòngwù, dāngrán, dàren hé háizi zuì xǐ'ài de háishi dà xióngmāo. Měi tiān yǒu hěn duō yóukè qù xióngmāo guǎn, tāmen dàizhe xiàngjī qù gěi kě'ài de dà xióngmāo pāizhào. Dòngwùyuán zǎoshang qī diǎn bàn kāimén, wǎnshang qī diǎn guānmén, dōngtiān bǐ xiàtiān yóukè shǎo, suǒyǐ yě bǐ píngshí zǎo guānmén yí ge xiǎoshí. Rúguǒ dì-yī cì lái Běijīng lǚyóu, gēn jiārén yìqǐ qù Běijīng dòngwùyuán shì ge búcuò de xuǎnzé.
column3: Today I took Xiaoxue and Xiaoming to the zoo. The Beijing Zoo is a very famous zoo in China with a huge variety of animals; of course, what adults and children love most is the giant panda. Every day many visitors go to the panda house, bringing cameras to photograph the adorable pandas. The zoo opens at 7:30 a.m. and closes at 7 p.m.; there are fewer visitors in winter than in summer, so it also closes an hour earlier than usual. If it's your first time traveling to Beijing, going to the Beijing Zoo with family is a good choice.

column1: 别再向前走了，李老师的办公室已经到了。
column2: Bié zài xiàng qián zǒu le, Lǐ lǎoshī de bàngōngshì yǐjīng dào le.
column3: Don't go any further—we've reached Teacher Li's office.

column1: 你进去吧，我在楼梯那儿等你。我害怕见李老师。
column2: Nǐ jìnqu ba, wǒ zài lóutī nàr děng nǐ. Wǒ hàipà jiàn Lǐ lǎoshī.
column3: You go in—I'll wait for you by the stairs. I'm afraid to see Teacher Li.

column1: 怎么回事？
column2: Zěnme huí shì?
column3: What's the matter?

column1: 最近我做错了好几件事，我怕李老师生气。
column2: Zuìjìn wǒ zuòcuò le hǎojǐ jiàn shì, wǒ pà Lǐ lǎoshī shēngqì.
column3: I've done several things wrong lately, and I'm afraid Teacher Li will be angry.

column1: 你想多了，做错事情是很常见的。
column2: Nǐ xiǎng duō le, zuòcuò shìqing shì hěn chángjiàn de.
column3: You're overthinking it—making mistakes is very common.

column1: 我把简单的事情做错了，李老师一定觉得我不认真。
column2: Wǒ bǎ jiǎndān de shìqing zuòcuò le, Lǐ lǎoshī yídìng juéde wǒ bú rènzhēn.
column3: I got simple things wrong—Teacher Li must think I'm not being careful.

column1: 有的人虽然很聪明，但是会在简单的事情中出错，因为他们认为事情简单，就不会认真去做了。
column2: Yǒude rén suīrán hěn cōngming, dànshì huì zài jiǎndān de shìqing zhōng chūcuò, yīnwèi tāmen rènwéi shìqing jiǎndān, jiù bú huì rènzhēn qù zuò le.
column3: Some people, though smart, make mistakes on simple things, because they think the task is easy and stop doing it carefully.

column1: 你说的就是我，以后我要多向认真的人学习。
column2: Nǐ shuō de jiù shì wǒ, yǐhòu wǒ yào duō xiàng rènzhēn de rén xuéxí.
column3: That's exactly me—from now on I'll learn more from people who are careful.

column1: 太阳从西边出来了？这几天怎么总是在图书馆看见你？

column2: Dàxué shēnghuó mǎshàng jiù yào jiéshù le, wǒ zuìjìn jīngcháng bèi wèn dào yí ge wèntí——"nǐ yǐhòu xiǎng zuò shénme", zhège wèntí zhēn bù róngyì huídá. Wǒ yě wèn le jǐ ge tóngxué, dàjiā xuǎnzé de fāngxiàng dōu bùtóng. Yǒude xiǎng jìxù zài xuéxiào xuéxí, yǒude dǎsuàn chū guó liúxué, hái yǒude juédìng xiān zhǎo gōngzuò. Wǒ rènwéi zhǐyǒu xiǎng qīngchu zìjǐ zhēnzhèng xǐhuan shénme, cái néng zuò chū zuì héshì de xuǎnzé. Duì wǒ lái shuō, xiǎng qīngchu "zhēnzhèng xǐhuan shénme" shì ge nántí.
column3: College life is about to end, and lately I've often been asked one question—"What do you want to do in the future?"—and it's really not easy to answer. I asked several classmates, and everyone's chosen direction is different. Some want to keep studying at school, some plan to study abroad, and others decide to find a job first. I believe only by figuring out what you truly love can you make the most suitable choice. For me, figuring out "what I truly love" is a tough problem.

Lǐ Wén gāozhōng shí hěn xiǎng xué yī, cóng nà shí qǐ jiù nǔlì xuéxí. Gāosān de shíhou, yīnwèi chéngjì tèbié hǎo, tā dédào le chū guó liúxué de jīhuì. Zài tā shēnshang, wǒ dǒngdé le, zhǐyào yìzhí jiānchí, jiù néng wánchéng zìjǐ de mùbiāo. Wǒ xiāngxìn, tā yǐhòu yídìng huì fāzhǎn de gèng hǎo.
column3: On this trip to China, what made me happiest was meeting Li Wen's parents. They showed me photos of Li Wen when he was born and told me many stories from his past. In high school Li Wen really wanted to study medicine, and from then on he studied hard. In his senior year, because his grades were excellent, he got the chance to study abroad. From him, I've come to understand that as long as you keep persevering, you can reach your goals. I believe he'll surely do even better in the future.

column1: 今天星期六，我们去了一雪姐姐家。姐姐家的两个孩子很有礼貌，我们一进门，就马上和我们打招呼。
column2: Jīntiān xīngqīliù, wǒmen qù le Yīxuě jiějie jiā. Jiějie jiā de liǎng ge háizi hěn yǒu lǐmào, wǒmen yí jìn mén, jiù mǎshàng hé wǒmen dǎ zhāohu.
column3: Today is Saturday, and we went to Yixue's home. Her two children are very polite—the moment we came in, they greeted us right away.

column1: 在姐姐家，我们也聊到了孩子的教育。姐姐说，以前他们和很多家长一样，觉得孩子上个好大学，人生才是成功的。所以，他们只关心孩子的分数，结果孩子压力特别大，每天都很不开心。后来，他们认识到，教育的目的不是让孩子考高分，而是帮助孩子养成好习惯。于是，他们做出改变，每天都给孩子留出时间外出锻炼身体，或者看些自己感兴趣的书。
column2: Zài jiějie jiā, wǒmen yě liáodào le háizi de jiàoyù. Jiějie shuō, yǐqián tāmen hé hěn duō jiāzhǎng yíyàng, juéde háizi shàng ge hǎo dàxué, rénshēng cái shì chénggōng de. Suǒyǐ, tāmen zhǐ guānxīn háizi de fēnshù, jiéguǒ háizi yālì tèbié dà, měi tiān dōu hěn bù kāixīn. Hòulái, tāmen rènshi dào, jiàoyù de mùdì bú shì ràng háizi kǎo gāofēn, ér shì bāngzhù háizi yǎngchéng hǎo xíguàn. Yúshì, tāmen zuòchū gǎibiàn, měi tiān dōu gěi háizi liúchū shíjiān wàichū duànliàn shēntǐ, huòzhě kàn xiē zìjǐ gǎn xìngqù de shū.
column3: At her home we also got talking about raising children. She said they used to think like a lot of parents—that a child's life is only a success if he gets into a good university. So they cared only about his grades, and the result was that he was under enormous pressure and unhappy every day. Later they came to see that the point of education is not to make a child score high marks, but to help him build good habits. So they made a change: every day they set aside time for him to go out and exercise, or to read something he is interested in.

column1: 我觉得他们的做法真棒。
column2: Wǒ juéde tāmen de zuòfǎ zhēn bàng.
column3: I think what they are doing is great.

column1: “学而不厌”是两千多年前中国教育家孔子说过的话，意思是人要一直坚持学习，就是说，学习是人一生的事情，要活到老学到老才有意义。在世界快速变化的今天，“学而不厌”变得更加重要。
column2: Xué ér bú yàn shì liǎngqiān duō nián qián Zhōngguó jiàoyùjiā Kǒngzǐ shuō guo de huà, yìsi shì rén yào yìzhí jiānchí xuéxí, jiùshì shuō, xuéxí shì rén yìshēng de shìqing, yào huó dào lǎo xué dào lǎo cái yǒu yìyì. Zài shìjiè kuàisù biànhuà de jīntiān, "xué ér bú yàn" biàn de gèngjiā zhòngyào.
column3: Never tire of learning is something Confucius, the Chinese educator, said more than two thousand years ago. It means you should keep learning all the time—that is, learning is a lifelong matter, and it only has meaning if you keep it up as long as you live. column2: Zuòwéi yì nián li zuì zhòngyào de chuántǒng jiérì, Chūn Jié duì Zhōngguórén lái shuō yǒuzhe tèbié de yìyì. Chūn Jié dàolái shí, rénmen bùguǎn zài nǎlǐ, dōu xiǎng huí jiā guònián. Chūn Jié qián yě zuì máng, jì yào zhǔnbèi niánhuò, dǎsǎo wèishēng, yòu yào zhǔnbèi niányèfàn. Chúxī zhè tiān wǎnshang, yìjiā rén yìbiān chī niányèfàn, yìbiān kàn Chūnwǎn. Língdiǎn yí dào, dàjiā hùxiāng zhù xīnnián kuàilè, dàochù dōu shì xìngfú de xiàoshēng.
column3: As the most important traditional festival of the year, Spring Festival means something special to Chinese people. When it comes round, people want to go home for it no matter where they are. The days before are the busiest: there are New Year goods to buy, cleaning to do, and the New Year's Eve dinner to prepare. On New Year's Eve the whole family eats that dinner while watching the Spring Festival Gala. At the stroke of midnight everyone wishes each other a happy New Year, and there is happy laughter everywhere.

column1: 每当回忆起童年，我最美好的记忆很多也发生在过年时。虽然现在已人到中年，离开了家，但是春节仍然是我最喜欢的节日，过年时也更想父母、兄弟姐妹。
column2: Měi dāng huíyì qǐ tóngnián, wǒ zuì měihǎo de jìyì hěn duō yě fāshēng zài guònián shí. Suīrán xiànzài yǐ rén dào zhōngnián, líkāi le jiā, dànshì Chūn Jié réngrán shì wǒ zuì xǐhuan de jiérì, guònián shí yě gèng xiǎng fùmǔ, xiōngdì jiěmèi.
column3: Whenever I think back to my childhood, many of my happiest memories come from Spring Festival. I am middle-aged now and have left home, but Spring Festival is still my favorite holiday, and at New Year I miss my parents and my brothers and sisters more than ever.

Whether it is a coat, a pair of trousers or even a pair of socks, she compares carefully before deciding whether to buy.

Lìrú: yǒuxiē shìqing, zài kèběn shang xué bùrú zìjǐ zuò yí biàn, yīnwèi zhǐyǒu zài zuò de shíhou, cái huì fāxiàn yǒu hěn duō xìjié xūyào zhùyì; hái yǒu yìxiē wèntí, zài shū shang zhǎo bu dào dá'àn, zhǐ néng tōngguò rìcháng gōngzuò mànmàn lǐjiě. Zài zhèyàng de guòchéng zhōng, xuésheng nénggòu duì xué dào de zhīshi yǒu gèng hǎo de rènshi, yě gèng qīngchu zìjǐ de zhíyè fāzhǎn fāngxiàng.
column3: During an internship students often find that what they learned in class is not quite the same as the actual work. For example, with some things, reading about them in a textbook is not as good as doing them once yourself, because only in the doing do you notice all the details that need attention; and some questions have no answer in a book—you can only come to understand them gradually through daily work. Through this process students gain a better grasp of what they have learned and a clearer sense of where their careers are heading.

column2: Suīrán biànhuà jīngcháng dǎluàn jìhuà, gěi wǒmen dàilái búbiàn, shènzhì ràng rén gǎndào shīwàng, dàn zhèxiē biànhuà yěxǔ huì gěi shēnghuó dàilái xīn de kěnéng. column3: Many changes in life cannot be known in advance; what we have to do is learn to accept them, adapt to them, and find new solutions within them. This not only trains our ability to solve problems in different situations, it also makes our lives easier.

When I finished, I decided to gather up all the articles and diary entries I have written since coming to China and produce a book of text and pictures—An Eastern Travel Diary—to introduce China to the world once again. At the same time I want to go on studying Chinese and Chinese culture, and apply for a master's course in Chinese language and literature.

column1: 来中国留学后，白家月、安妮和陈天中常外出旅行，从中了解中国。他们还总结出几点旅行经验：
column2: Lái Zhōngguó liúxué hòu, Bái Jiāyuè, Ānnī hé Chén Tiānzhōng cháng wàichū lǚxíng, cóngzhōng liǎojiě Zhōngguó. Tāmen hái zǒngjié chū jǐ diǎn lǚxíng jīngyàn:
column3: Since coming to China to study, Bai Jiayue, Annie and Chen Tianzhong have often travelled, getting to know China along the way. They have also drawn a few travel lessons from it:

column1: 第一，好计划是成功的一半。旅行前，要了解目的地天气、道路交通特点等，安排好每天的活动，保证所有人对计划都没意见。准备越细，烦恼越少。
column2: Dì-yī, hǎo jìhuà shì chénggōng de yíbàn. Lǚxíng qián, yào liǎojiě mùdìdì tiānqì, dàolù jiāotōng tèdiǎn děng, ānpái hǎo měi tiān de huódòng, bǎozhèng suǒyǒu rén duì jìhuà dōu méi yìjiàn. Zhǔnbèi yuè xì, fánnǎo yuè shǎo.
column3: First, a good plan is half the battle. Before you travel, find out about the weather at your destination, the roads and transport and so on, plan each day's activities, and make sure everyone is happy with the plan. The more carefully you prepare, the fewer the headaches.

column1: 第二，节假日早点儿订机票、酒店和各种门票，否则很难订到。
column2: Dì-èr, jiéjiàrì zǎo diǎnr dìng jīpiào, jiǔdiàn hé gèzhǒng ménpiào, fǒuzé hěn nán dìngdào.
column3: Second, over public holidays book flights, hotels and tickets early, or you won't get them.

column1: 第三，转机会比直飞更便宜。此次去西双版纳，在西安转机，机票价格比直飞便宜了百分之四十多。虽然有些累，但是累就累点儿吧，花更少的钱去看更多的地方，很值得，节省下来的钱就当是给自己的大“红包”了。
column2: Dì-sān, zhuǎnjī huì bǐ zhífēi gèng piányi. Cǐ cì qù Xīshuāngbǎnnà, zài Xī'ān zhuǎnjī, jīpiào jiàgé bǐ zhífēi piányi le bǎifēnzhī sìshí duō. Suīrán yǒuxiē lèi, dànshì lèi jiù lèi diǎnr ba, huā gèng shǎo de qián qù kàn gèng duō de dìfang, hěn zhíde, jiéshěng xiàlai de qián jiù dāng shì gěi zìjǐ de dà "hóngbāo" le.
column3: Third, connecting flights are cheaper than direct ones. For this trip to Xishuangbanna we change at Xi'an, and the fare is over forty percent cheaper than flying direct. It is a bit tiring, but a little tiredness is fine: spending less to see more is well worth it, and the money saved is like a big "red envelope" to yourself.

column1: 王一飞常对她的学生说：“读万卷书，行万里路。你们要是想多了解中国，就不能只通过读书，还要多出门旅行；否则只能认识课本里的中国。”
column2: Wáng Yīfēi cháng duì tā de xuésheng shuō: "Dú wàn juàn shū, xíng wàn lǐ lù. Nǐmen yàoshi xiǎng duō liǎojiě Zhōngguó, jiù bù néng zhǐ tōngguò dúshū, hái yào duō chūmén lǚxíng; fǒuzé zhǐ néng rènshi kèběn li de Zhōngguó."
column3: Wang Yifei often tells her students: "Read ten thousand books, travel ten thousand miles. If you want to understand China better, you can't do it through books alone—you have to get out and travel; otherwise you'll only know the China of the textbook."

column1: 旅行，不仅能看到自然美景，还能近距离感受不同的历史文化。比如，白家月等人想了解少数民族泼水节，就去了西双版纳；泼水节上，导游向他们解释说，被泼的水越多，新的一年就会越健康、幸福。安妮喜欢唐诗，就来到西安，在那里遇到导游扮演的“对诗人”，对诗人说上句，游客就能说出下句。

column2: Qián duàn shíjiān, Yáng Tónglè de tóngshì tánchéng le yì bǐ búcuò de shēngyi. Gāng kāishǐ, zhè wèi tóngshì yě yùdào le yìxiē kùnnan. Ná hé kèhù jiāoliú lái shuō, suīrán tā néng bǎ chǎnpǐn de yōuquēdiǎn shuō de hěn qīngchu, dàn shíjì xiàoguǒ bìng bù lǐxiǎng. Yáng Tónglè gàosu tā, zhè shì yīnwèi tā jièshào de fāngshì dōu yíyàng. Qíshí, bùtóng niánlíng, bùtóng xìngbié de kèhù duì chǎnpǐn de guānzhùdiǎn shì bù yíyàng de.
column3: A while ago a colleague of Yang Tongle's closed a good deal. At first she had run into difficulties. Take talking to customers: although she could explain the product's strengths and weaknesses clearly, it didn't work as well as she had hoped. Yang Tongle told her this was because she pitched it the same way every time. In fact customers of different ages and genders care about different things.

column1: 于是，这位同事又认真地进行了几次市场调查，了解不同客户的想法。后来她在面对不同客户时，能根据他们的情况介绍产品，效果一下就好了很多。
column2: Yúshì, zhè wèi tóngshì yòu rènzhēn de jìnxíng le jǐ cì shìchǎng diàochá, liǎojiě bùtóng kèhù de xiǎngfǎ. Hòulái tā zài miànduì bùtóng kèhù shí, néng gēnjù tāmen de qíngkuàng jièshào chǎnpǐn, xiàoguǒ yíxià jiù hǎo le hěn duō.
column3: So she carried out several more careful market surveys to learn how different customers think. After that she was able to tailor her pitch to each customer, and the results improved dramatically.

column1: 有的年轻人经常换工作，总觉得下一份工作会更好。但是，适应新工作往往需要比较长的时间。如果总是换工作，不但很难积累经验，还可能会使自己的发展受到影响。
column2: Yǒude niánqīngrén jīngcháng huàn gōngzuò, zǒng juéde xià yí fèn gōngzuò huì gèng hǎo. Dànshì, shìyìng xīn gōngzuò wǎngwǎng xūyào bǐjiào cháng de shíjiān. Rúguǒ zǒngshì huàn gōngzuò, búdàn hěn nán jīlěi jīngyàn, hái kěnéng huì shǐ zìjǐ de fāzhǎn shòudào yǐngxiǎng.
column3: Some young people change jobs often, always feeling the next one will be better. But settling into a new job usually takes quite a while. If you keep moving, it is hard to build experience and your career may suffer.

column1: 我认为，年轻人刚进入社会时，不能只关心工资的高低，更要重视学习。比如，学习课本中没有的专业知识，了解公司的管理方式，学会和同事有效交流，等等。只有把这些基础打好，提高工作能力，今后才会有更好的发展机会。
column2: Wǒ rènwéi, niánqīngrén gāng jìnrù shèhuì shí, bù néng zhǐ guānxīn gōngzī de gāodī, gèng yào zhòngshì xuéxí. Bǐrú, xuéxí kèběn zhōng méiyǒu de zhuānyè zhīshi, liǎojiě gōngsī de guǎnlǐ fāngshì, xuéhuì hé tóngshì yǒuxiào jiāoliú, děngděng. Zhǐyǒu bǎ zhèxiē jīchǔ dǎ hǎo, tígāo gōngzuò nénglì, jīnhòu cái huì yǒu gèng hǎo de fāzhǎn jīhuì.
column3: I think that when young people first enter the workforce they shouldn't focus only on salary—learning matters more. For example, picking up professional knowledge that isn't in textbooks, understanding how the company is run, learning to communicate effectively with colleagues, and so on. Only by laying these foundations and improving your ability will better opportunities come later.

column2: Tǐng máng de. Yǐqián wǒ zǒng juéde niánqīng shí yào duō xué duō gàn, suǒyǐ cānjiā le gōngsī li de hěn duō xiàngmù, jīngcháng jiābān, áoyè, shēntǐ yě liàng qǐ le hóngdēng.
column3: Quite busy. I used to think that while you're young you should learn and do as much as possible, so I joined lots of company projects, often worked overtime and stayed up late—and my health started flashing warning signs.

column1: 还是别给自己太大压力，否则，失去健康就不值得了。

column1: 是啊，后来我就不接那么多项目了。我发现暂停下来、好好休息之后，我能把工作做得更快更好。

column3: Exactly—after that I stopped taking on so many projects. I found that pausing and resting properly let me work faster and better.

column1: 对，该工作时就工作，该放松时就要放松。
column2: Duì, gāi gōngzuò shí jiù gōngzuò, gāi fàngsōng shí jiù yào fàngsōng.
column3: Right—work when it's time to work, and relax when it's time to relax.

column1: 是的，现在我周末常来郊区，在好山好水好风景中放松自己。
column2: Shì de, xiànzài wǒ zhōumò cháng lái jiāoqū, zài hǎo shān hǎo shuǐ hǎo fēngjǐng zhōng fàngsōng zìjǐ.
column3: Yes—now I often come out to the countryside at weekends and unwind among the hills, the water and the scenery.

column1: 以前杨同乐总觉得自己年轻，就应该多学多干、积累经验。很多年轻人和他想法一样。但是，由于工作紧张，他们经常加班、熬夜，休息不够，结果工作效率下降，健康也受到了影响。
column2: Yǐqián Yáng Tónglè zǒng juéde zìjǐ niánqīng, jiù yīnggāi duō xué duō gàn, jīlěi jīngyàn. Hěn duō niánqīngrén hé tā xiǎngfǎ yíyàng. Dànshì, yóuyú gōngzuò jǐnzhāng, tāmen jīngcháng jiābān, áoyè, xiūxi bú gòu, jiéguǒ gōngzuò xiàolǜ xiàjiàng, jiànkāng yě shòudào le yǐngxiǎng.
column3: Yang Tongle used to think that because he was young he should learn and do as much as he could and build experience. Many young people think the same. But with the pressure of work they often did overtime, stayed up late and didn't rest enough, so their efficiency dropped and their health suffered.

column1: 现在越来越多的人认识到，跟一直加班相比，休息好了再工作，效率更高。因此，很多人开始做出改变，提醒自己减轻压力、多多放松。比如，杨同乐周末时或者与朋友们去郊区游玩，在大自然美丽的景色中好好放松自己；或者就在家里安安静静地看看书。休息好了，再回去上班时，心情愉快，工作效率也更高。
column2: Xiànzài yuè lái yuè duō de rén rènshi dào, gēn yìzhí jiābān xiāngbǐ, xiūxi hǎo le zài gōngzuò, xiàolǜ gèng gāo. Yīncǐ, hěn duō rén kāishǐ zuòchū gǎibiàn, tíxǐng zìjǐ jiǎnqīng yālì, duōduō fàngsōng. Bǐrú, Yáng Tónglè zhōumò shí huòzhě yǔ péngyoumen qù jiāoqū yóuwán, zài dàzìrán měilì de jǐngsè zhōng hǎohāo fàngsōng zìjǐ; huòzhě jiù zài jiā li ān'ānjìngjìng de kànkan shū. Xiūxi hǎo le, zài huíqu shàngbān shí, xīnqíng yúkuài, gōngzuò xiàolǜ yě gèng gāo.
column3: More and more people now realize that resting first and then working is more efficient than constant overtime. So many are making changes and reminding themselves to ease the pressure and relax more. Yang Tongle, for instance, either goes out to the countryside with friends at weekends and unwinds amid beautiful scenery, or just reads quietly at home. Well rested, he goes back to work in good spirits and gets more done.

column1: 一到周末，很多人都喜欢外出游玩。你一般去哪里呢？
column2: Yí dào zhōumò, hěn duō rén dōu xǐhuan wàichū yóuwán. Nǐ yìbān qù nǎlǐ ne?

column1: 我生活在中国的首都——北京。在北京，周末的时候，有人会在市区公园走走，看看眼前的美景；有人喜欢去参观长城、故宫等有名的景点，放松心情的同时，也能了解历史文化。北京交通很方便，所以我和家人更爱乘坐公交车去郊区，偶尔也会自己开车。郊区有山有水，还有很多农家乐，吃、玩、住，都十分方便。
column2: Wǒ shēnghuó zài Zhōngguó de shǒudū — Běijīng. Zài Běijīng, zhōumò de shíhou, yǒu rén huì zài shìqū gōngyuán zǒuzou, kànkan yǎnqián de měijǐng; yǒu rén xǐhuan qù cānguān Chángchéng, Gùgōng děng yǒumíng de jǐngdiǎn, fàngsōng xīnqíng de tóngshí, yě néng liǎojiě lìshǐ wénhuà. Běijīng jiāotōng hěn fāngbiàn, suǒyǐ wǒ hé jiārén gèng ài chéngzuò gōngjiāochē qù jiāoqū, ǒu'ěr yě huì zìjǐ kāichē. Jiāoqū yǒu shān yǒu shuǐ, hái yǒu hěn duō nóngjiālè, chī, wán, zhù, dōu shífēn fāngbiàn.
column3: I live in Beijing, China's capital. At weekends some people stroll in the city parks and enjoy the views; others like visiting famous sights such as the Great Wall and the Palace Museum, relaxing while learning about history and culture. Getting around Beijing is easy, so my family and I prefer to take the bus out to the countryside, and occasionally we drive. There are hills and water out there, and plenty of farm guesthouses, so eating, playing and staying over are all very convenient.

column1: 在我看来，不管去哪里玩，实际上都是为了放松。也可以说，只要能放松，去哪儿都合适。
column2: Zài wǒ kàn lái, bùguǎn qù nǎlǐ wán, shíjì shang dōu shì wèile fàngsōng. Yě kěyǐ shuō, zhǐyào néng fàngsōng, qù nǎr dōu héshì.
column3: The way I see it, wherever you go, the point is to relax. You could also say that as long as you can relax, anywhere will do.

column1: 广州和哈尔滨，一个在南方，一个在北方，两个城市之间的距离有三千多公里，气候也大不相同。广州基本上没有冬天，而哈尔滨的冬天一般会从十月开始，到第二年的三四月才结束。广州四季开满鲜花，所以又叫“花城”；哈尔滨冬天冰雪多，所以也叫“冰城”。
column2: Guǎngzhōu hé Hā'ěrbīn, yí ge zài nánfāng, yí ge zài běifāng, liǎng ge chéngshì zhī jiān de jùlí yǒu sānqiān duō gōnglǐ, qìhòu yě dà bù xiāngtóng. column3: Guangzhou is in the south and Harbin in the north, more than three thousand kilometres apart, and their climates are utterly different. Guangzhou has almost no winter, while Harbin's usually begins in October and does not end until March or April the following year. Guangzhou is in flower all year round, so it is also called the "Flower City"; Harbin has so much ice and snow in winter that it is known as the "Ice City."

column1: 此外，两地的方言也不一样。哈尔滨方言和普通话听起来比较像，而广州方言和普通话差别较大。如果广州人和哈尔滨人都只使用自己的方言，那么交流就很困难，甚至还可能引起误会。其实，中国很多地方都有自己的方言，所以，为了顺利交流，中国人从小都要学习普通话。
column2: Cǐwài, liǎng dì de fāngyán yě bù yíyàng. Hā'ěrbīn fāngyán hé pǔtōnghuà tīng qǐlai bǐjiào xiàng, ér Guǎngzhōu fāngyán hé pǔtōnghuà chābié jiào dà. column1: 很多女孩子羡慕浪漫的爱情。那什么是浪漫呢？年轻人说：“浪漫是她想要月亮时，你不会给她星星”；中年人说：“浪漫是即使晚上加班到零点，到家时，自己家里也还亮着灯”；老年人说：“浪漫其实就像歌中唱的那样，‘我能想到最浪漫的事，就是和你一起慢慢变老。’”其实，让我们感动的，就是生活中简单的爱情。有时候，简单就是最大的幸福。
column2: Hěn duō nǚháizi xiànmù làngmàn de àiqíng. Nà shénme shì làngmàn ne? Niánqīngrén shuō: "Làngmàn shì tā xiǎng yào yuèliang shí, nǐ bú huì gěi tā xīngxing"; zhōngniánrén shuō: "Làngmàn shì jíshǐ wǎnshang jiābān dào líng diǎn, dào jiā shí, zìjǐ jiā li yě hái liàngzhe dēng"; lǎoniánrén shuō: "Làngmàn qíshí jiù xiàng gē zhōng chàng de nàyàng, 'wǒ néng xiǎngdào zuì làngmàn de shì, jiù shì hé nǐ yìqǐ mànmàn biàn lǎo.'" Qíshí, ràng wǒmen gǎndòng de, jiù shì shēnghuó zhōng jiǎndān de àiqíng. Yǒu shíhou, jiǎndān jiù shì zuì dà de xìngfú.
column3: Many girls long for romantic love. So what is romance? Young people say: "Romance is when she wants the moon, you don't give her the stars"; middle-aged people say: "Romance is when, even after working overtime until midnight, you come home and the light is still on"; old people say: "Romance is really just like the song goes: 'The most romantic thing I can think of is growing old slowly with you.'" In fact, what moves us is the simple love in everyday life. Sometimes simplicity is the greatest happiness.

column1: 说到结婚，人们就会很自然地想起爱情。爱情是结婚的重要原因，但两个人共同生活，不仅需要浪漫的爱情，更需要性格上互相吸引。
column2: Shuōdào jiéhūn, rénmen jiù huì hěn zìrán de xiǎngqǐ àiqíng. Àiqíng shì jiéhūn de zhòngyào yuányīn, dàn liǎng ge rén gòngtóng shēnghuó, bùjǐn xūyào làngmàn de àiqíng, gèng xūyào xìnggé shang hùxiāng xīyǐn.
column3: When it comes to marriage, people naturally think of love. Love is an important reason to marry, but for two people to live together, they need not only romantic love but, even more, to be attracted to each other's personalities.

column1: 我丈夫是个很幽默的人。即使是很普通的事情，从他嘴里说出来也会变得很有意思。在我难过的时候，他总是有办法让我高兴起来。而且他的脾气也不错，结婚快十年了，我们俩几乎没因为什么事红过脸，很多人都特别羡慕我们。
column2: Wǒ zhàngfu shì ge hěn yōumò de rén. Jíshǐ shì hěn pǔtōng de shìqing, cóng tā zuǐ li shuō chulai yě huì biàn de hěn yǒu yìsi. Zài wǒ nánguò de shíhou, tā zǒngshì yǒu bànfǎ ràng wǒ gāoxìng qilai. Érqiě tā de píqi yě búcuò, jiéhūn kuài shí nián le, wǒmen liǎ jīhū méi yīnwèi shénme shì hóngguo liǎn, hěn duō rén dōu tèbié xiànmù wǒmen.
column3: My husband is a very humorous person. Even the most ordinary things become interesting when he says them. When I'm sad, he always finds a way to cheer me up. He's also good-tempered: we've been married almost ten years and have hardly ever quarreled over anything. Lots of people really envy us.

column1: 来中国快一年了，你适应这儿的生活了吗？
column2: Lái Zhōngguó kuài yì nián le, nǐ shìyìng zhèr de shēnghuó le ma?
column3: You've been in China almost a year. Have you adapted to life here?

column1: 开始有点儿不习惯，后来就慢慢适应了，最近我还交了一个中国朋友。
column2: Kāishǐ yǒudiǎnr bù xíguàn, hòulái jiù mànmàn shìyìng le, zuìjìn wǒ hái jiāole yí ge Zhōngguó péngyou.
column3: At first I wasn't quite used to it, but later I slowly adapted. Recently I even made a Chinese friend.

column1: 那就好，快给我讲讲你新交的中国朋友。
column2: Nà jiù hǎo, kuài gěi wǒ jiǎngjiang nǐ xīn jiāo de Zhōngguó péngyou.
column3: That's good. Quick, tell me about your new Chinese friend.

column1: 我们是在图书馆认识的。平时我们常常一起看书、逛街、踢足球。有时候他还给我发一些幽默短信。
column2: Wǒmen shì zài túshūguǎn rènshi de. Píngshí wǒmen chángcháng yìqǐ kàn shū, guàngjiē, tī zúqiú. Yǒu shíhou tā hái gěi wǒ fā yìxiē yōumò duǎnxìn.
column3: We met at the library. Usually we read, go shopping, and play soccer together. Sometimes he sends me funny text messages too.

column1: 你的这个朋友真不错！下次介绍我们认识认识，怎么样？
column2: Nǐ de zhège péngyou zhēn búcuò! Xià cì jièshào wǒmen rènshi rènshi, zěnmeyàng?
column3: This friend of yours sounds great! Next time, introduce us, OK?

column1: 没问题！我们下午要去踢足球，正好一起去吧。
column2: Méi wèntí! Wǒmen xiàwǔ yào qù tī zúqiú, zhènghǎo yìqǐ qù ba.
column3: No problem! We're going to play soccer this afternoon, so you can come along.

column1: 星期天同学聚会，你能来吗？
column2: Xīngqītiān tóngxué jùhuì, nǐ néng lái ma?
column3: There's a class reunion on Sunday. Can you come?

column1: 能来。班里同学你联系得怎么样了？来多少人？
column2: Néng lái. Bān li tóngxué nǐ liánxì de zěnmeyàng le? Lái duōshao rén?
column3: Yes, I can. How's it going contacting our classmates? How many people are coming?

column1: 差不多一半儿吧，张远还专门从国外飞回来呢。
column2: Chàbuduō yíbànr ba, Zhāng Yuǎn hái zhuānmén cóng guówài fēi huilai ne.
column3: About half, I think. Zhang Yuan is even flying back from abroad specially for it.

column1: 是吗？毕业都快十年了，真想大家啊！对了，今天早上，我在地铁站遇到了王静，她毕业后就去上海工作了，她这次是来旅游的。
column2: Shì ma? Bìyè dōu kuài shí nián le, zhēn xiǎng dàjiā a! Duì le, jīntiān zǎoshang, wǒ zài dìtiězhàn yùdàole Wáng Jìng, tā bìyè hòu jiù qù Shànghǎi gōngzuò le, tā zhè cì shì lái lǚyóu de.
column3: Really? It's been almost ten years since we graduated. I really miss everyone! Oh, right, this morning I ran into Wang Jing at the subway station. She went to work in Shanghai after graduating, and she's here on a trip this time.

column1: 那太好了！麻烦你跟她联系一下，请她一起来参加同学聚会。聚会就在学校门口那个饭店，六点半。别迟到啊！
column2: Nà tài hǎo le! Máfan nǐ gēn tā liánxì yíxià, qǐng tā yìqǐ lái cānjiā tóngxué jùhuì. Jùhuì jiù zài xuéxiào ménkǒu nàge fàndiàn, liù diǎn bàn. Bié chídào a!
column3: That's great! Could you please contact her and invite her to the reunion too? It's at the restaurant by the school gate, at six thirty. Don't be late!

column1: 放心吧。星期天六点半见！
column2: Fàngxīn ba. Xīngqītiān liù diǎn bàn jiàn!
column3: Don't worry. See you Sunday at six thirty!

column1: 这是什么时候的照片？你真年轻！
column2: Zhè shì shénme shíhou de zhàopiàn? Nǐ zhēn niánqīng!
column3: When was this photo taken? You look so young!

column1: 这是上大学时的照片。一看到这张照片，我就想起过去那段快乐的日子，好像重新回到了校园。
column2: Zhè shì shàng dàxué shí de zhàopiàn. Yí kàndào zhè zhāng zhàopiàn, wǒ jiù xiǎngqǐ guòqù nà duàn kuàilè de rìzi, hǎoxiàng chóngxīn huídàole xiàoyuán.
column3: This is a photo from my college days. As soon as I see it, I remember those happy days, as if I were back on campus again.

column1: 旁边这个人一定是你的好朋友吧？你们现在还联系吗？
column2: Pángbiān zhège rén yídìng shì nǐ de hǎo péngyou ba? Nǐmen xiànzài hái liánxì ma?
column3: The person next to you must be your good friend, right? Do you still keep in touch?

column1: 当然了，尽管已经毕业这么多年，我们还是经常联系的，每次都有说不完的话。
column2: Dāngrán le, jǐnguǎn yǐjīng bìyè zhème duō nián, wǒmen háishi jīngcháng liánxì de, měi cì dōu yǒu shuō bu wán de huà.
column3: Of course. Even though we graduated so many years ago, we still keep in touch often, and every time we have endless things to talk about.

column1: 真羡慕你！我上大学时最好的朋友去了南方工作，我们俩已经好久没联系了。我一会儿就给她打个电话。
column2: Zhēn xiànmù nǐ! Wǒ shàng dàxué shí zuì hǎo de péngyou qùle nánfāng gōngzuò, wǒmen liǎ yǐjīng hǎojiǔ méi liánxì le. Wǒ yíhuìr jiù gěi tā dǎ ge diànhuà.
column3: I really envy you! My best friend from college went to work in the south, and we haven't been in touch for a long time. I'll give her a call in a bit.

column1: 对。要知道，能有一个真正的朋友，有一段真正的友谊，是多么不容易！
column2: Duì. Yào zhīdào, néng yǒu yí ge zhēnzhèng de péngyou, yǒu yí duàn zhēnzhèng de yǒuyì, shì duōme bù róngyì!
column3: Right. You know, how hard it is to have a true friend and a true friendship!

column1: 每个人都需要朋友，朋友可以丰富我们的生活。离开朋友，我们的生活一定会非常无聊。那么，怎样才能交到更多的朋友呢？当然，要有好脾气。一个脾气不好的人虽然不一定让人讨厌，但是却很难跟人交朋友。因为没有人会喜欢跟一个总是容易生气的人在一起。我们还要经常跟周围的人交流。交流能让人们互相了解，如果有共同的兴趣、爱好或者习惯，就更容易成为朋友了。
column2: Měi ge rén dōu xūyào péngyou, péngyou kěyǐ fēngfù wǒmen de shēnghuó. Líkāi péngyou, wǒmen de shēnghuó yídìng huì fēicháng wúliáo. Nàme, zěnyàng cái néng jiāodào gèng duō de péngyou ne? Dāngrán, yào yǒu hǎo píqi. Yí ge píqi bù hǎo de rén suīrán bù yídìng ràng rén tǎoyàn, dànshì què hěn nán gēn rén jiāo péngyou. Yīnwèi méiyǒu rén huì xǐhuan gēn yí ge zǒngshì róngyì shēngqì de rén zài yìqǐ. Wǒmen hái yào jīngcháng gēn zhōuwéi de rén jiāoliú. Jiāoliú néng ràng rénmen hùxiāng liǎojiě, rúguǒ yǒu gòngtóng de xìngqù, àihào huòzhě xíguàn, jiù gèng róngyì chéngwéi péngyou le.
column3: Everyone needs friends; friends enrich our lives. Without friends, our lives would surely be very boring. So how can we make more friends? Of course, you need a good temper. A bad-tempered person isn't necessarily disliked, but finds it hard to make friends, because nobody likes being around someone who gets angry easily. We should also communicate often with the people around us. Communication helps people understand each other, and if they share interests, hobbies, or habits, it's even easier to become friends.

column1: 人的一生可以什么也没有，但不能没有朋友，而且必须要有自己真正的朋友。什么是真正的朋友？不同的人会有不同的理解。有些人觉得朋友就是能和自己一起快乐的人；有些人觉得朋友应该像镜子，能帮自己看到缺点。而我的理解是：当你遇到困难的时候，真正的朋友会站出来，及时给你帮助；当你无聊或者难过的时候，真正的朋友会陪在你身边，想办法让你感到幸福。
column2: Rén de yìshēng kěyǐ shénme yě méiyǒu, dàn bù néng méiyǒu péngyou, érqiě bìxū yào yǒu zìjǐ zhēnzhèng de péngyou. Shénme shì zhēnzhèng de péngyou? Bùtóng de rén huì yǒu bùtóng de lǐjiě. Yǒuxiē rén juéde péngyou jiù shì néng hé zìjǐ yìqǐ kuàilè de rén; yǒuxiē rén juéde péngyou yīnggāi xiàng jìngzi, néng bāng zìjǐ kàndào quēdiǎn. Ér wǒ de lǐjiě shì: dāng nǐ yùdào kùnnan de shíhou, zhēnzhèng de péngyou huì zhàn chulai, jíshí gěi nǐ bāngzhù; dāng nǐ wúliáo huòzhě nánguò de shíhou, zhēnzhèng de péngyou huì péi zài nǐ shēnbiān, xiǎng bànfǎ ràng nǐ gǎndào xìngfú.
column3: In life you can go without everything else, but not without friends—and you must have true friends of your own. What is a true friend? Different people understand it differently. Some think a friend is someone you can be happy with; others think a friend should be like a mirror, helping you see your faults. My understanding is this: when you run into difficulties, a true friend will step forward and help you right away; when you're bored or sad, a true friend will stay by your side and find ways to make you feel happy.

column1: 你上午的面试怎么样？
column2: Nǐ shàngwǔ de miànshì zěnmeyàng?
column3: How was your interview this morning?

column1: 还可以，他们问的问题都挺容易的，就是我有点儿紧张。
column2: Hái kěyǐ, tāmen wèn de wèntí dōu tǐng róngyì de, jiù shì wǒ yǒudiǎnr jǐnzhāng.
column3: Not bad. The questions they asked were pretty easy; I was just a bit nervous.

column1: 面试的时候，一定要对自己有信心，要相信自己的能力。
column2: Miànshì de shíhou, yídìng yào duì zìjǐ yǒu xìnxīn, yào xiāngxìn zìjǐ de nénglì.
column3: In an interview, you must have confidence in yourself and believe in your own abilities.

column1: 你说得对！3月15号上午8点在学校体育馆还有一个招聘会，你去吗？
column2: Nǐ shuō de duì! Sān yuè shíwǔ hào shàngwǔ bā diǎn zài xuéxiào tǐyùguǎn hái yǒu yí ge zhāopìnhuì, nǐ qù ma?
column3: You're right! There's also a job fair in the school gym at 8 a.m. on March 15th. Are you going?

column1: 我还没决定呢。
column2: Wǒ hái méi juédìng ne.
column3: I haven't decided yet.

column1: 听说这次招聘会提供的工作机会很多，我们一起去看看吧。
column2: Tīngshuō zhè cì zhāopìnhuì tígōng de gōngzuò jīhuì hěn duō, wǒmen yìqǐ qù kànkan ba.
column3: I heard this job fair is offering lots of job opportunities. Let's go take a look together.

column1: 小林，这次招聘不是小李负责吗？
column2: Xiǎo Lín, zhè cì zhāopìn bú shì Xiǎo Lǐ fùzé ma?
column3: Xiao Lin, isn't Xiao Li in charge of the hiring this time?

column1: 本来是小李负责的，但是他突然生病住院了，所以就交给我来做了。
column2: Běnlái shì Xiǎo Lǐ fùzé de, dànshì tā tūrán shēngbìng zhùyuàn le, suǒyǐ jiù jiāo gěi wǒ lái zuò le.
column3: Originally Xiao Li was in charge, but he suddenly got sick and was hospitalized, so it was handed over to me.

column1: 哦，这次应聘的人多吗？
column2: Ò, zhè cì yìngpìn de rén duō ma?
column3: Oh, are there many applicants this time?

column1: 经理，这次来应聘的一共有15人。经过笔试和面试，有两个不错。这是他们的材料，您看看。
column2: Jīnglǐ, zhè cì lái yìngpìn de yígòng yǒu shíwǔ rén. Jīngguò bǐshì hé miànshì, yǒu liǎng ge búcuò. Zhè shì tāmen de cáiliào, nín kànkan.
column3: Manager, fifteen people applied this time. After the written test and the interview, two of them are quite good. Here are their materials; please take a look.

column1: 这两个人的能力都比较符合我们的要求。你通知他们下周一上午九点来我办公室吧。
column2: Zhè liǎng ge rén de nénglì dōu bǐjiào fúhé wǒmen de yāoqiú. Nǐ tōngzhī tāmen xià zhōuyī shàngwǔ jiǔ diǎn lái wǒ bàngōngshì ba.
column3: Both of these people's abilities fit our requirements fairly well. Tell them to come to my office at nine next Monday morning.

column1: 好的，那我马上跟他们联系。
column2: Hǎo de, nà wǒ mǎshàng gēn tāmen liánxì.
column3: OK, I'll contact them right away.

column1: 王静，好久不见了！大学毕业后就没联系了，你现在在哪儿工作呢？
column2: Wáng Jìng, hǎojiǔ bú jiàn le! Dàxué bìyè hòu jiù méi liánxì le, nǐ xiànzài zài nǎr gōngzuò ne?
column3: Wang Jing, long time no see! We haven't been in touch since college graduation. Where are you working now?

column1: 我一毕业就去上海当律师了。
column2: Wǒ yí bìyè jiù qù Shànghǎi dāng lǜshī le.
column3: As soon as I graduated, I went to Shanghai to work as a lawyer.

column1: 你对现在的工作一定非常满意吧？
column2: Nǐ duì xiànzài de gōngzuò yídìng fēicháng mǎnyì ba?
column3: You must be very satisfied with your current job, right?

column1: 我很喜欢现在的工作，因为我学的就是法律专业，而且同事们都很喜欢我。另外，收入也不错。
column2: Wǒ hěn xǐhuan xiànzài de gōngzuò, yīnwèi wǒ xué de jiù shì fǎlǜ zhuānyè, érqiě tóngshìmen dōu hěn xǐhuan wǒ. Lìngwài, shōurù yě búcuò.
column3: I really like my current job, because law is exactly what I studied, and my colleagues all like me. Besides, the pay is good too.

column1: 星期天咱们同学聚会，你能来参加吗？
column2: Xīngqītiān zánmen tóngxué jùhuì, nǐ néng lái cānjiā ma?
column3: We're having a class reunion on Sunday. Can you come?

column1: 能来。虽然这次来北京，时间安排得很紧张，但我一定借这次机会去跟大家见见面。
column2: Néng lái. Suīrán zhè cì lái Běijīng, shíjiān ānpái de hěn jǐnzhāng, dàn wǒ yídìng jiè zhè cì jīhuì qù gēn dàjiā jiànjian miàn.
column3: Yes, I can. Although my schedule on this trip to Beijing is very tight, I'll definitely take this chance to see everyone.

column1: 面试的时候，经理对我印象不错，还通知我明天就可以上班了。真没想到，找工作这么顺利。你想知道面试需要注意什么吗？首先，要穿正式的衣服，这会给面试者留下一个好的印象，让他觉得你是一个认真的人。其次，应聘时不要紧张。回答问题时，说得不要太快，声音也不要太小，要相信自己有能力做好。当然，最重要的是回答问题要诚实。
column2: Miànshì de shíhou, jīnglǐ duì wǒ yìnxiàng búcuò, hái tōngzhī wǒ míngtiān jiù kěyǐ shàngbān le. Zhēn méi xiǎngdào, zhǎo gōngzuò zhème shùnlì. Nǐ xiǎng zhīdào miànshì xūyào zhùyì shénme ma? Shǒuxiān, yào chuān zhèngshì de yīfu, zhè huì gěi miànshìzhě liúxià yí ge hǎo de yìnxiàng, ràng tā juéde nǐ shì yí ge rènzhēn de rén. Qícì, yìngpìn shí bú yào jǐnzhāng. Huídá wèntí shí, shuō de bú yào tài kuài, shēngyīn yě bú yào tài xiǎo, yào xiāngxìn zìjǐ yǒu nénglì zuò hǎo. Dāngrán, zuì zhòngyào de shì huídá wèntí yào chéngshí.
column3: In the interview, the manager had a good impression of me and even told me I could start work tomorrow. I never expected job hunting to go so smoothly. Do you want to know what to pay attention to in an interview? First, wear formal clothes; this leaves a good impression on the interviewer and makes them think you're a serious person. Second, don't be nervous when applying. When answering questions, don't speak too fast or too quietly, and believe you're capable of doing well. Of course, the most important thing is to answer questions honestly.

column1: 第一印象就是在第一次见面时给别人留下的印象。虽然第一印象不总是对的，但如果想改变却很困难。你给别人的第一印象会影响他们以后对你的感觉和判断。所以，给第一次见面的同事留下好的印象，以后的工作可能会更顺利；给第一次见面的顾客留下好的印象，你可能会卖出更多的东西。但是，如果第一次见面给别人留下像不准时这样的坏印象，那么以后就很难让别人相信你。所以不管是上课、上班，还是与别人约会，准时都非常重要。
column2: Dì-yī yìnxiàng jiù shì zài dì-yī cì jiànmiàn shí gěi biérén liúxià de yìnxiàng. Suīrán dì-yī yìnxiàng bù zǒngshì duì de, dàn rúguǒ xiǎng gǎibiàn què hěn kùnnan. Nǐ gěi biérén de dì-yī yìnxiàng huì yǐngxiǎng tāmen yǐhòu duì nǐ de gǎnjué hé pànduàn. Suǒyǐ, gěi dì-yī cì jiànmiàn de tóngshì liúxià hǎo de yìnxiàng, yǐhòu de gōngzuò kěnéng huì gèng shùnlì; gěi dì-yī cì jiànmiàn de gùkè liúxià hǎo de yìnxiàng, nǐ kěnéng huì mài chu gèng duō de dōngxi. Dànshì, rúguǒ dì-yī cì jiànmiàn gěi biérén liúxià xiàng bù zhǔnshí zhèyàng de huài yìnxiàng, nàme yǐhòu jiù hěn nán ràng biérén xiāngxìn nǐ. Suǒyǐ bùguǎn shì shàngkè, shàngbān, háishi yǔ biérén yuēhuì, zhǔnshí dōu fēicháng zhòngyào.
column3: A first impression is the impression you leave on others the first time you meet. Although first impressions aren't always right, they're very hard to change. The first impression you make affects how people feel about and judge you later. So if you leave a good impression on a colleague the first time you meet, your work may go more smoothly afterward; if you leave a good impression on a customer the first time, you may sell more. But if you leave a bad impression the first time—such as being late—it'll be hard to get people to trust you later. So whether it's going to class, going to work, or meeting someone, being on time is very important.

column1: 听说你又换工作了？今年已经换了三次工作了吧？
column2: Tīngshuō nǐ yòu huàn gōngzuò le? Jīnnián yǐjīng huànle sān cì gōngzuò le ba?
column3: I heard you changed jobs again? That's already three times this year, isn't it?

column1: 别提了！我以为新工作比以前的好，没想到还没有以前好呢。
column2: Bié tí le! Wǒ yǐwéi xīn gōngzuò bǐ yǐqián de hǎo, méi xiǎngdào hái méiyǒu yǐqián hǎo ne.
column3: Don't mention it! I thought the new job would be better than the old one, but it turns out it's not even as good.

column1: 上次那份工作你只做了两个月就离开了。其实，完全适应一个新的工作需要一年时间，所以，经常换工作不一定好。
column2: Shàng cì nà fèn gōngzuò nǐ zhǐ zuòle liǎng ge yuè jiù líkāi le. Qíshí, wánquán shìyìng yí ge xīn de gōngzuò xūyào yì nián shíjiān, suǒyǐ, jīngcháng huàn gōngzuò bù yídìng hǎo.
column3: You only did your last job for two months before leaving. Actually, it takes a year to fully adapt to a new job, so changing jobs often isn't necessarily good.

column1: 我也明白。但是那份工作的收入太少了。
column2: Wǒ yě míngbai. Dànshì nà fèn gōngzuò de shōurù tài shǎo le.
column3: I understand that too. But that job paid too little.

column1: 你才到新公司，不要太急着赚钱，多学习才是最重要的。
column2: Nǐ cái dào xīn gōngsī, bú yào tài jízhe zhuànqián, duō xuéxí cái shì zuì zhòngyào de.
column3: You've only just joined the new company. Don't be in too much of a hurry to make money; learning as much as you can is what matters most.

column1: 好。我一定会努力把现在这份工作做好。
column2: Hǎo. Wǒ yídìng huì nǔlì bǎ xiànzài zhè fèn gōngzuò zuò hǎo.
column3: OK. I'll definitely work hard to do this job well.

column1: 那份调查还要多长时间才能做完？
column2: Nà fèn diàochá hái yào duō cháng shíjiān cái néng zuò wán?
column3: How much longer will it take to finish that survey?

column1: 按原来的计划应该是两周，但是我们可以提前完成，周末保证做完。
column2: Àn yuánlái de jìhuà yīnggāi shì liǎng zhōu, dànshì wǒmen kěyǐ tíqián wánchéng, zhōumò bǎozhèng zuò wán.
column3: According to the original plan it should take two weeks, but we can finish early. We guarantee it'll be done by the weekend.

column1: 虽然最近工作很忙，但你们也要注意身体啊。
column2: Suīrán zuìjìn gōngzuò hěn máng, dàn nǐmen yě yào zhùyì shēntǐ a.
column3: Although work is busy lately, you should still take care of your health.

column1: 谢谢您！现在有很多事情等着我做，真不知道该先做哪个好。
column2: Xièxie nín! Xiànzài yǒu hěn duō shìqing děngzhe wǒ zuò, zhēn bù zhīdào gāi xiān zuò nǎge hǎo.
column3: Thank you! I have so many things waiting for me to do right now; I really don't know which to do first.

column1: 每天早上我都把当天计划要做的事情写在笔记本上，提醒自己安排好时间。你也可以试试这样做。
column2: Měi tiān zǎoshang wǒ dōu bǎ dàngtiān jìhuà yào zuò de shìqing xiě zài bǐjìběn shang, tíxǐng zìjǐ ānpái hǎo shíjiān. Nǐ yě kěyǐ shìshi zhèyàng zuò.
column3: Every morning I write down the things I plan to do that day in my notebook, to remind myself to manage my time well. You could try doing that too.

column1: 这个办法真不错！这样我就不会手忙脚乱了。
column2: Zhège bànfǎ zhēn búcuò! Zhèyàng wǒ jiù bú huì shǒumáng jiǎoluàn le.
column3: That's a great idea! That way I won't be in such a rush and a muddle.

column1: 什么事让你这么高兴啊？
column2: Shénme shì ràng nǐ zhème gāoxìng a?
column3: What's made you so happy?

column1: 我们和上次那个公司的生意终于谈成了。
column2: Wǒmen hé shàng cì nàge gōngsī de shēngyi zhōngyú tán chéng le.
column3: We finally closed the deal with that company from last time.

column1: 太好了！你工作那么努力，公司会越来越好的。
column2: Tài hǎo le! Nǐ gōngzuò nàme nǔlì, gōngsī huì yuè lái yuè hǎo de.
column3: That's great! You work so hard; the company will keep getting better and better.

column1: 我原来以为做生意很简单，后来才发现其实并不容易，现在赚钱越来越难了。
column2: Wǒ yuánlái yǐwéi zuò shēngyi hěn jiǎndān, hòulái cái fāxiàn qíshí bìng bù róngyì, xiànzài zhuànqián yuè lái yuè nán le.
column3: I used to think doing business was simple, but later I found it's actually not easy at all. Making money is getting harder and harder these days.

column1: 慢慢来，万事开头难，重要的是要多积累经验。
column2: Mànmàn lái, wànshì kāitóu nán, zhòngyào de shì yào duō jīlěi jīngyàn.
column3: Take it slow—every beginning is hard. What's important is to build up more experience.

column1: 我相信经过我们大家的努力，公司的生意会越做越大，一切都会好的。
column2: Wǒ xiāngxìn jīngguò wǒmen dàjiā de nǔlì, gōngsī de shēngyi huì yuè zuò yuè dà, yíqiè dōu huì hǎo de.
column3: I believe that with everyone's hard work, the company's business will keep growing, and everything will be fine.

column1: 我们今年的工作都已经按照计划完成了。这一段时间，尽管工作很紧张，中间也遇到了很多困难，但是因为有大家的努力，我们成功地解决了问题，顺利地完成了工作，非常感谢大家对我的帮助！另外，马经理让我告诉大家一个好消息，因为大家按时完成了工作，公司决定这个月给每人多发三千元奖金。感谢大家这三个多月的努力工作，希望明年能有更大的成绩！
column2: Wǒmen jīnnián de gōngzuò dōu yǐjīng ànzhào jìhuà wánchéng le. Zhè yí duàn shíjiān, jǐnguǎn gōngzuò hěn jǐnzhāng, zhōngjiān yě yùdàole hěn duō kùnnan, dànshì yīnwèi yǒu dàjiā de nǔlì, wǒmen chénggōng de jiějuéle wèntí, shùnlì de wánchéngle gōngzuò, fēicháng gǎnxiè dàjiā duì wǒ de bāngzhù! Lìngwài, Mǎ jīnglǐ ràng wǒ gàosu dàjiā yí ge hǎo xiāoxi, yīnwèi dàjiā ànshí wánchéngle gōngzuò, gōngsī juédìng zhège yuè gěi měi rén duō fā sānqiān yuán jiǎngjīn. Gǎnxiè dàjiā zhè sān ge duō yuè de nǔlì gōngzuò, xīwàng míngnián néng yǒu gèng dà de chéngjì!
column3: We've completed all of this year's work according to plan. During this period, although the work was intense and we ran into many difficulties along the way, thanks to everyone's efforts we solved the problems and finished the work smoothly. Thank you all very much for your help! Also, Manager Ma asked me to share some good news: because everyone finished the work on time, the company has decided to give each person an extra 3,000-yuan bonus this month. Thank you for more than three months of hard work, and I hope we achieve even more next year!

column1: 年轻人刚开始工作的时候，不要太急着赚钱，不要眼睛里只有工资和奖金。在工作的前几年，重要的是丰富自己的工作经验，学习与同事交流的方法，积累专业知识，这些比收入重要多了。但是很多时候，我们不得不去做一些自己不愿意做甚至是非常不喜欢的工作。这时，我们最需要的就是对工作的责任心。一个人即使能力再高，经验再丰富，如果对工作没有责任心，也很难把工作做好。
column2: Niánqīngrén gāng kāishǐ gōngzuò de shíhou, bú yào tài jízhe zhuànqián, bú yào yǎnjing li zhǐyǒu gōngzī hé jiǎngjīn. Zài gōngzuò de qián jǐ nián, zhòngyào de shì fēngfù zìjǐ de gōngzuò jīngyàn, xuéxí yǔ tóngshì jiāoliú de fāngfǎ, jīlěi zhuānyè zhīshi, zhèxiē bǐ shōurù zhòngyào duō le. Dànshì hěn duō shíhou, wǒmen bùdébù qù zuò yìxiē zìjǐ bú yuànyì zuò shènzhì shì fēicháng bù xǐhuan de gōngzuò. Zhè shí, wǒmen zuì xūyào de jiù shì duì gōngzuò de zérènxīn. Yí ge rén jíshǐ nénglì zài gāo, jīngyàn zài fēngfù, rúguǒ duì gōngzuò méiyǒu zérènxīn, yě hěn nán bǎ gōngzuò zuò hǎo.
column3: When young people first start working, they shouldn't be in too much of a hurry to make money or have eyes only for salary and bonuses. In the first few years, what matters is building up work experience, learning how to communicate with colleagues, and accumulating professional knowledge—these are far more important than income. But often we have to do work we don't want to do, or even really dislike. At times like that, what we need most is a sense of responsibility toward our work. No matter how capable or experienced a person is, without a sense of responsibility it's hard to do the job well.

column1: 小姐，您好！您想买什么家具？需要我为您介绍一下吗？
column2: Xiǎojiě, nín hǎo! Nín xiǎng mǎi shénme jiājù? Xūyào wǒ wèi nín jièshào yíxià ma?
column3: Hello, miss! What furniture would you like to buy? Would you like me to show you around?

column1: 谢谢，我想买沙发。
column2: Xièxie, wǒ xiǎng mǎi shāfā.
column3: Thanks, I'd like to buy a sofa.

column1: 您看这个沙发怎么样？现在正在打折，比平时便宜了一千块。
column2: Nín kàn zhège shāfā zěnmeyàng? Xiànzài zhèngzài dǎzhé, bǐ píngshí piányi le yìqiān kuài.
column3: What do you think of this sofa? It's on sale right now—a thousand yuan cheaper than usual.

column1: 价格还可以，就是不知道质量有没有保证。
column2: Jiàgé hái kěyǐ, jiù shì bù zhīdào zhìliàng yǒu méiyǒu bǎozhèng.
column3: The price is OK; I just don't know whether the quality is guaranteed.

column1: 您放心，质量肯定不“打折”，这种沙发是今年最流行的。有很多种颜色可以选择，您可以看一下。
column2: Nín fàngxīn, zhìliàng kěndìng bù "dǎzhé", zhè zhǒng shāfā shì jīnnián zuì liúxíng de. Yǒu hěn duō zhǒng yánsè kěyǐ xuǎnzé, nín kěyǐ kàn yíxià.
column3: Don't worry, the quality definitely isn't "discounted." This kind of sofa is the most popular this year. There are lots of colors to choose from; have a look.

column1: 这个蓝色的看上去不错，就要这个吧。
column2: Zhège lánsè de kàn shangqu búcuò, jiù yào zhège ba.
column3: This blue one looks nice. I'll take this one.

column1: 咱家的冰箱太旧了，商场正好打折，我们顺便也买一台吧。
column2: Zán jiā de bīngxiāng tài jiù le, shāngchǎng zhènghǎo dǎzhé, wǒmen shùnbiàn yě mǎi yì tái ba.
column3: Our fridge is too old, and the mall happens to have a sale. Let's buy one while we're at it.

column1: 今天买的东西太多了。再说，这个月家里已经花了五千多了。
column2: Jīntiān mǎi de dōngxi tài duō le. Zàishuō, zhège yuè jiā li yǐjīng huāle wǔqiān duō le.
column3: We've bought too much today. Besides, we've already spent over five thousand this month.

column1: 这么多？你不会是记错了吧？
column2: Zhème duō? Nǐ bú huì shì jì cuò le ba?
column3: That much? You haven't got it wrong, have you?

column1: 没错。上个星期光买沙发就花了两千多。
column2: Méi cuò. Shàng ge xīngqī guāng mǎi shāfā jiù huāle liǎngqiān duō.
column3: No, it's right. Last week the sofa alone cost over two thousand.

column1: 但是咱家的冰箱实在太旧了，制冷效果也不太好了，还是买个新的吧。
column2: Dànshì zán jiā de bīngxiāng shízài tài jiù le, zhìlěng xiàoguǒ yě bú tài hǎo le, háishi mǎi ge xīn de ba.
column3: But our fridge really is too old, and it doesn't cool well anymore. Let's just buy a new one.

column1: 那好吧，我带的现金不够，用你的信用卡吧。
column2: Nà hǎo ba, wǒ dài de xiànjīn bú gòu, yòng nǐ de xìnyòngkǎ ba.
column3: All right then. I didn't bring enough cash, so let's use your credit card.

column1: 李老师邀请咱们去他家做客，给他带点儿什么礼物好呢？
column2: Lǐ lǎoshī yāoqǐng zánmen qù tā jiā zuòkè, gěi tā dài diǎnr shénme lǐwù hǎo ne?
column3: Mr. Li has invited us to his home. What kind of gift should we bring him?

column1: 他很喜欢葡萄酒，我们就给他买两瓶葡萄酒吧。
column2: Tā hěn xǐhuan pútaojiǔ, wǒmen jiù gěi tā mǎi liǎng píng pútaojiǔ ba.
column3: He likes wine a lot. Let's buy him two bottles of wine.

column1: 可是这里有这么多种，你知道哪种好吗？
column2: Kěshì zhèlǐ yǒu zhème duō zhǒng, nǐ zhīdào nǎ zhǒng hǎo ma?
column3: But there are so many kinds here. Do you know which one is good?

column1: 我觉得这种不错，你看它酒瓶做得都这么艺术。而且电视上经常有它的广告，我想味道应该不错。
column2: Wǒ juéde zhè zhǒng búcuò, nǐ kàn tā jiǔpíng zuò de dōu zhème yìshù. Érqiě diànshì shang jīngcháng yǒu tā de guǎnggào, wǒ xiǎng wèidao yīnggāi búcuò.
column3: I think this kind is good—look how artistic even the bottle is. And it's often advertised on TV, so I think it should taste good.

column1: 广告只会介绍优点，却不会说它的缺点。实际上，很多东西并不像广告上说的那么好，所以不能完全相信广告。
column2: Guǎnggào zhǐ huì jièshào yōudiǎn, què bú huì shuō tā de quēdiǎn. Shíjìshang, hěn duō dōngxi bìng bú xiàng guǎnggào shang shuō de nàme hǎo, suǒyǐ bù néng wánquán xiāngxìn guǎnggào.
column3: Ads only tell you the good points, never the bad ones. In fact, many things aren't as good as the ads say, so you can't completely trust advertising.

column1: 你说得也对。
column2: Nǐ shuō de yě duì.
column3: You have a point.

column1: 买衣服只考虑价格当然不好，但是只考虑买好看的也不一定对。我买衣服的标准是“只买对的，不买贵的”。第一，自己穿着舒服；第二，衣服的质量要好，而且又不能太贵。对我来说，衣服的样子流行不流行并不是很重要。很多年龄大的人喜欢在打折的时候买便宜的衣服，但对那些衣服是不是适合自己却考虑得不多。这点是我理解不了的，因为如果不适合自己，即使花钱很少，也是一种浪费。
column2: Mǎi yīfu zhǐ kǎolǜ jiàgé dāngrán bù hǎo, dànshì zhǐ kǎolǜ mǎi hǎokàn de yě bù yídìng duì. Wǒ mǎi yīfu de biāozhǔn shì "zhǐ mǎi duì de, bù mǎi guì de". Dì-yī, zìjǐ chuānzhe shūfu; dì-èr, yīfu de zhìliàng yào hǎo, érqiě yòu bù néng tài guì. Duì wǒ lái shuō, yīfu de yàngzi liúxíng bu liúxíng bìng bú shì hěn zhòngyào. Hěn duō niánlíng dà de rén xǐhuan zài dǎzhé de shíhou mǎi piányi de yīfu, dàn duì nàxiē yīfu shì bu shì shìhé zìjǐ què kǎolǜ de bù duō. Zhè diǎn shì wǒ lǐjiě bu liǎo de, yīnwèi rúguǒ bú shìhé zìjǐ, jíshǐ huāqián hěn shǎo, yě shì yì zhǒng làngfèi.
column3: Of course it's not good to consider only price when buying clothes, but considering only looks isn't necessarily right either. My standard for buying clothes is "buy what's right, not what's expensive." First, they should be comfortable to wear; second, the quality should be good, without being too expensive. For me, whether the style is fashionable isn't very important. Many older people like to buy cheap clothes on sale, but don't think much about whether the clothes suit them. That's something I can't understand, because if they don't suit you, even if you spend very little, it's still a waste.

column1: 现在网上购物变得越来越流行了，年轻人尤其喜欢在网上买东西。在网上几乎什么都可以买到，你可以上网买书、买衣服、买包，还可以买家具、买手机。网上购物能够受到人们的喜爱，原因主要有两个：首先，网上的东西很多，而且比去商店买便宜，这是吸引人们购买的主要原因。其次，人们可以在任何时间上网购买自己喜欢的东西，卖家可以把你买的东西寄到你办公室或者家里，非常方便。
column2: Xiànzài wǎng shang gòuwù biàn de yuè lái yuè liúxíng le, niánqīngrén yóuqí xǐhuan zài wǎng shang mǎi dōngxi. Zài wǎng shang jīhū shénme dōu kěyǐ mǎidào, nǐ kěyǐ shàngwǎng mǎi shū, mǎi yīfu, mǎi bāo, hái kěyǐ mǎi jiājù, mǎi shǒujī. First, there's a huge range of goods online, and it's cheaper than buying in a store—this is the main thing that attracts people. Second, people can go online at any time to buy what they like, and the seller can mail it to your office or home, which is very convenient.
