column1: 人们常说“一分钱一分货”，意思是东西的质量和价格有很大的关系，也可以说“便宜没好货，好货不便宜”。一般情况下，你花的钱越多，买的东西也就越好。其实也不一定都是这样的。有的时候，质量很好的东西也会很便宜。例如，春天来了，冬天的衣服就会打折，质量很好，还很便宜，花很少的钱就可以买到。一到节日，商场也会举办各种各样的活动，降低价格，这个时候我们也可以买到又便宜又好的东西。
column2: Rénmen cháng shuō "yì fēn qián yì fēn huò", yìsi shì dōngxi de zhìliàng hé jiàgé yǒu hěn dà de guānxi, yě kěyǐ shuō "piányi méi hǎo huò, hǎo huò bù piányi". Yìbān qíngkuàng xià, nǐ huā de qián yuè duō, mǎi de dōngxi yě jiù yuè hǎo. Qíshí yě bù yídìng dōu shì zhèyàng de. Yǒu de shíhou, zhìliàng hěn hǎo de dōngxi yě huì hěn piányi. Lìrú, chūntiān lái le, dōngtiān de yīfu jiù huì dǎzhé, zhìliàng hěn hǎo, hái hěn piányi, huā hěn shǎo de qián jiù kěyǐ mǎidào. Yí dào jiérì, shāngchǎng yě huì jǔbàn gèzhǒng gèyàng de huódòng, jiàngdī jiàgé, zhège shíhou wǒmen yě kěyǐ mǎidào yòu piányi yòu hǎo de dōngxi.
column3: People often say "you get what you pay for," meaning quality and price are closely related. You could also say "cheap things aren't good, and good things aren't cheap." Generally, the more you spend, the better what you buy. But actually it isn't always so. Sometimes high-quality things can be cheap too. For example, when spring comes, winter clothes go on sale: good quality and cheap, so you can get them for very little money. And whenever a holiday comes, malls hold all kinds of events and lower prices, so at those times we can also buy things that are both cheap and good.

column1: 每个人都希望自己健康，那么什么才是健康呢？过去，人们认为健康就是指身体不生病。但是，现在人们认识到，健康还指精神上的健康。只有身体和精神都健康，才算是真正的健康。有一位教授用数字来说明健康有多么重要：要是健康是1，其他都是1后面的0；如果没有1，不管有多少0也没用。所以我们平时一定要注意锻炼，别等健康出问题了才后悔。
column2: Měi ge rén dōu xīwàng zìjǐ jiànkāng, nàme shénme cái shì jiànkāng ne? Guòqù, rénmen rènwéi jiànkāng jiù shì zhǐ shēntǐ bù shēngbìng. Yǒu yí wèi jiàoshòu yòng shùzì lái shuōmíng jiànkāng yǒu duōme zhòngyào: yàoshi jiànkāng shì yī, qítā dōu shì yī hòumiàn de líng; rúguǒ méiyǒu yī, bùguǎn yǒu duōshao líng yě méi yòng. column3: Everyone hopes to be healthy, so what exactly is health? In the past, people thought health just meant not being physically ill. But now people realize that health also means mental health. Only when both body and mind are healthy is it true health. A professor used numbers to show how important health is: if health is the 1, everything else is the 0s after it; without the 1, no number of 0s is of any use. So we must make a habit of exercising, and not wait until our health has problems to regret it.

column1: 我听一位医生说过一句话：“最好的医生是自己，最好的药是时间，最好的运动是散步。”前两条我理解得不深，最后一条我完全同意。散步是生活中最简单的锻炼方法，既可以活动身体，又可以减肥，而且不会像跑步那样辛苦。晚饭后，一家人一起出去散散步，是一件很幸福的事情。肚子吃饱了需要活动，家人忙了一天需要交流，夫妻说说一天的工作能加深感情，听孩子谈谈学校里有意思的事，一天的烦恼就都跑掉了。

Qián liǎng tiáo wǒ lǐjiě de bù shēn, zuìhòu yì tiáo wǒ wánquán tóngyì. I don't fully understand the first two, but I completely agree with the last. Walking is the simplest form of exercise in daily life: it gets your body moving and helps you lose weight, and it isn't as tiring as running. Going out for a walk together as a family after dinner is a very happy thing. A full stomach needs some activity, family members need to talk after a busy day, a husband and wife chatting about their work can deepen their bond, and listening to the kids talk about fun things at school makes all the day's worries disappear.

column2: Cǎo lǜ le, nà shì shēngmìng de yánsè; huā kāi le, nà shì dàzìrán de lǐwù. Shēnghuó zhōng bù quēshǎo měi, quēshǎo de shì fāxiàn měi de yǎnjing. Chuāng wài shì shénme yàngzi, wǒmen wúfǎ gǎibiàn, dàn wǒmen kěyǐ xuǎnzé zhàn zài nǎge chuānghu qián. We can't change what it looks like outside the window, but we can choose which window to stand in front of. Choose a window that brings us happiness—only then can we choose the right mood and the right attitude toward life.

column1: 科学研究证明，女孩子对衣服颜色的选择往往与她们的性格有关。喜欢穿白色衣服的女孩子性格比较阳光，生活态度积极向上是她们的共同特点；而喜欢穿红色衣服的女孩子性格比较浪漫。颜色也会影响人的心情，不同的颜色会给我们带来不同的感情变化。红色让人变得热情；黄色和白色让人心情愉快；黑色却容易让人感到伤心；人们在看到蓝色时会觉得很舒服，变得安静下来；绿色让我们的眼睛得到休息。

Hóngsè ràng rén biàn de rèqíng; huángsè hé báisè ràng rén xīnqíng yúkuài; hēisè què róngyì ràng rén gǎndào shāngxīn; rénmen zài kàndào lánsè shí huì juéde hěn shūfu, biàn de ānjìng xialai; lǜsè ràng wǒmen de yǎnjing dédào xiūxi.
column3: Scientific research has shown that the colors girls choose for their clothes are often related to their personality. Girls who like wearing white tend to be sunny, and a positive, upbeat attitude toward life is what they have in common; girls who like wearing red tend to be romantic. Colors also affect people's moods, and different colors bring us different emotional changes. Red makes people passionate; yellow and white make people cheerful; black, however, easily makes people feel sad; when people see blue they feel comfortable and calm down; and green lets our eyes rest.

column3: If there's something you want to do, go and do it bravely. Don't worry about the outcome, and don't think about whether you might fail. If you care too much about results, failure will bring you a lot of distress. We should focus on the process of doing things; that way, along the way you'll discover the joy of solving problems, which nothing else can give you. Even if you fail in the end, it doesn't matter, because at least you tried, and we can also draw useful lessons from failure. With this accumulated experience, success will naturally come closer and closer.

column1: 每一个人都希望成功，可是很多时候，在成功之前会遇到很多困难。有些人遇到困难就放弃，而有些人遇到困难却想办法解决它。对困难的态度不同，结果也是不一样的。爱迪生就是在找了上千种材料后才找到了能点亮电灯的材料。取得成功的人往往都经历过许多失败，他们和普通人的区别就是他们都坚持了下来。所以就算只有1%的希望，我们也要做出100%的努力。困难只是暂时的，“阳光总在风雨后”，只有我们勇敢地面对困难，才能有希望取得成功。
column2: Měi yí ge rén dōu xīwàng chénggōng, kěshì hěn duō shíhou, zài chénggōng zhīqián huì yùdào hěn duō kùnnan. Yǒuxiē rén yùdào kùnnan jiù fàngqì, ér yǒuxiē rén yùdào kùnnan què xiǎng bànfǎ jiějué tā. Duì kùnnan de tàidu bù tóng, jiéguǒ yě shì bù yíyàng de. Àidíshēng jiùshì zài zhǎo le shàng qiān zhǒng cáiliào hòu cái zhǎodào le néng diǎnliàng diàndēng de cáiliào. Qǔdé chénggōng de rén wǎngwǎng dōu jīnglì guo xǔduō shībài, tāmen hé pǔtōng rén de qūbié jiùshì tāmen dōu jiānchí le xialai. Suǒyǐ jiùsuàn zhǐ yǒu bǎi fēn zhī yī de xīwàng, wǒmen yě yào zuò chū bǎi fēn zhī bǎi de nǔlì. Kùnnan zhǐ shì zànshí de, "yángguāng zǒng zài fēngyǔ hòu", zhǐyǒu wǒmen yǒnggǎn de miànduì kùnnan, cái néng yǒu xīwàng qǔdé chénggōng.
column3: Everyone hopes to succeed, but very often you run into many difficulties before success. Some people give up when they meet difficulties, while others find ways to overcome them. Different attitudes toward difficulty lead to different results. Edison only found a material that could light an electric bulb after trying more than a thousand kinds. People who succeed have usually been through many failures; what sets them apart from ordinary people is that they kept going. So even if there's only a 1% chance, we should make a 100% effort. Difficulties are only temporary—"the sunshine always comes after the storm"—and only if we face difficulties bravely can we hope to succeed.

column1: 礼拜天有空儿吗？陪我去逛街怎么样？我想去给丈夫买个生日礼物。
column2: Lǐbàitiān yǒu kòngr ma? Péi wǒ qù guàngjiē zěnmeyàng? Wǒ xiǎng qù gěi zhàngfu mǎi ge shēngrì lǐwù.
column3: Are you free on Sunday? How about coming shopping with me? I want to buy my husband a birthday present.

column1: 我可能去不了，最近事情多。
column2: Wǒ kěnéng qù bu liǎo, zuìjìn shìqing duō.
column3: I probably can't go—I've had a lot going on lately.

column1: 你最近是不是工作特别忙？
column2: Nǐ zuìjìn shì bu shì gōngzuò tèbié máng?
column3: Have you been especially busy at work lately?

column1: 我现在上有老，下有小。除了工作以外，家里还有母亲和儿子需要照顾。
column2: Wǒ xiànzài shàng yǒu lǎo, xià yǒu xiǎo. Chúle gōngzuò yǐwài, jiā li hái yǒu mǔqīn hé érzi xūyào zhàogù.
column3: Right now I have both an elderly parent and a child to care for. Besides work, I have to look after my mother and my son at home.

column1: 真是辛苦啊！你最近脸色不太好，是不是哪儿不舒服？要注意身体啊。
column2: Zhēn shì xīnkǔ a! Nǐ zuìjìn liǎnsè bú tài hǎo, shì bu shì nǎr bù shūfu? Yào zhùyì shēntǐ a.
column3: That must be really hard! You haven't looked too well lately—are you feeling unwell somewhere? Take care of yourself.

column1: 没事儿，谢谢！不过现在我很幸福，因为在母亲面前我可以做一个永远长不大的孩子；在孩子面前我又是个能照顾他的母亲，这让我有了努力的方向。
column2: Méi shìr, xièxie! Búguò xiànzài wǒ hěn xìngfú, yīnwèi zài mǔqīn miànqián wǒ kěyǐ zuò yí ge yǒngyuǎn zhǎng bu dà de háizi; zài háizi miànqián wǒ yòu shì ge néng zhàogù tā de mǔqīn, zhè ràng wǒ yǒu le nǔlì de fāngxiàng.
column3: I'm fine, thanks! Actually I'm very happy now, because in front of my mother I can be a child who never grows up, and in front of my child I'm a mother who can take care of him. That gives me something to work toward.

column1: 你看人家王老师，刚来这儿工作三年就当了教授，还有个好妻子，真让人羡慕！
column2: Nǐ kàn rénjia Wáng lǎoshī, gāng lái zhèr gōngzuò sān nián jiù dāng le jiàoshòu, hái yǒu ge hǎo qīzi, zhēn ràng rén xiànmù!
column3: Look at Professor Wang—he's only worked here three years and he's already a full professor, plus he has a wonderful wife. I really envy him!

column1: 其实，你在别人眼中也是很幸福的，只是你自己没有发现。
column2: Qíshí, nǐ zài biérén yǎn zhōng yě shì hěn xìngfú de, zhǐshì nǐ zìjǐ méiyǒu fāxiàn.
column3: Actually, in other people's eyes you're very fortunate too—you just haven't realized it yourself.

column1: 是吗？我哪能跟王老师比啊？
column2: Shì ma? Wǒ nǎ néng gēn Wáng lǎoshī bǐ a?
column3: Really? How could I compare with Professor Wang?

column1: 你有一个漂亮的女儿，还那么优秀，硕士毕业后就当了翻译。
column2: Nǐ yǒu yí ge piàoliang de nǚ'ér, hái nàme yōuxiù, shuòshì bìyè hòu jiù dāng le fānyì.
column3: You have a beautiful daughter who's so outstanding—she became a translator right after finishing her master's.

column1: 我女儿确实不错，记得她刚拿到第一个月工资时，就兴奋地拉着我和她爸俩去商场，给我们买礼物，那时我和她爸心里别提多美了！
column2: Wǒ nǚ'ér quèshí búcuò, jìde tā gāng nádào dì-yī ge yuè gōngzī shí, jiù xīngfèn de lāzhe wǒ hé tā bà liǎ qù shāngchǎng, gěi wǒmen mǎi lǐwù, nà shí wǒ hé tā bà xīnli bié tí duō měi le!
column3: My daughter really is great. I remember when she got her first month's salary, she excitedly dragged her dad and me to the mall to buy us presents. You can't imagine how happy her dad and I were!

column1: 所以说每个人有每个人的生活，不用羡慕别人。你羡慕别人的时候，他们可能也正在羡慕你呢。
column2: Suǒyǐ shuō měi ge rén yǒu měi ge rén de shēnghuó, búyòng xiànmù biérén. Nǐ xiànmù biérén de shíhou, tāmen kěnéng yě zhèngzài xiànmù nǐ ne.
column3: That's why I say everyone has their own life, and there's no need to envy others. While you're envying other people, they may well be envying you.

column1: 你觉得在选择职业时，收入重要吗？
column2: Nǐ juéde zài xuǎnzé zhíyè shí, shōurù zhòngyào ma?
column3: Do you think income is important when choosing a career?

column1: 在我看来，赚钱多少不是最重要的，兴趣才是关键。只有做自己喜欢的事，才会觉得幸福，将来也会有更好的发展。
column2: Zài wǒ kànlái, zhuàn qián duōshao bú shì zuì zhòngyào de, xìngqù cái shì guānjiàn. Zhǐyǒu zuò zìjǐ xǐhuan de shì, cái huì juéde xìngfú, jiānglái yě huì yǒu gèng hǎo de fāzhǎn.
column3: In my view, how much money you make isn't the most important thing—interest is the key. Only by doing what you like will you feel happy, and you'll also have better prospects in the future.

column1: 我也这么想。如果我带着热情去做自己喜欢的工作，就不会感到累。不过，现在什么东西都那么贵，生活压力太大了，没有钱也不会过得幸福啊！
column2: Wǒ yě zhème xiǎng. Rúguǒ wǒ dàizhe rèqíng qù zuò zìjǐ xǐhuan de gōngzuò, jiù bú huì gǎndào lèi. Búguò, xiànzài shénme dōngxi dōu nàme guì, shēnghuó yālì tài dà le, méiyǒu qián yě bú huì guò de xìngfú a!
column3: I think so too. If I do work I like with enthusiasm, I won't feel tired. But everything is so expensive now and life is so stressful—without money you can't live happily either!

column1: 幸福其实很简单，它不是只要有钱就能买到的。我觉得工作结束回家后，洗个热水澡，然后躺在床上看看书，听听音乐，困了睡睡觉，就很幸福。
column2: Xìngfú qíshí hěn jiǎndān, tā bú shì zhǐyào yǒu qián jiù néng mǎidào de. Wǒ juéde gōngzuò jiéshù huí jiā hòu, xǐ ge rèshuǐzǎo, ránhòu tǎng zài chuáng shang kànkan shū, tīngting yīnyuè, kùn le shuìshui jiào, jiù hěn xìngfú.
column3: Happiness is actually very simple; it's not something you can buy just by having money. For me, coming home after work, taking a hot shower, then lying in bed reading a bit, listening to some music, and sleeping when I get tired—that's happiness.

column1: 你说的也对。如果能找到一份自己既感兴趣，收入又不错的工作，那就最好了。
column2: Nǐ shuō de yě duì. Rúguǒ néng zhǎodào yí fèn zìjǐ jì gǎn xìngqù, shōurù yòu búcuò de gōngzuò, nà jiù zuì hǎo le.
column3: You have a point. If you can find a job that you're interested in and that also pays well, that would be ideal.

column1: 有的人希望穿得再好一些，房子再大一些，认为经济条件越好人就越幸福。其实有很多富人过得并不愉快，而有些穷人却过得很快乐。有钱不一定幸福，因为很多东西都是不能用钱买到的，例如时间、感情、生活经历等。但是，从另外一个方面看，如果没钱，也很难过得幸福。当你生病了，如果由于缺钱而不能及时去看医生，你的健康都很难得到保证，就更别说幸福了。
column2: Yǒu de rén xīwàng chuān de zài hǎo yìxiē, fángzi zài dà yìxiē, rènwéi jīngjì tiáojiàn yuè hǎo rén jiù yuè xìngfú. Qíshí yǒu hěn duō fùrén guò de bìng bù yúkuài, ér yǒuxiē qióngrén què guò de hěn kuàilè. Yǒu qián bù yídìng xìngfú, yīnwèi hěn duō dōngxi dōu shì bù néng yòng qián mǎidào de, lìrú shíjiān, gǎnqíng, shēnghuó jīnglì děng. Dànshì, cóng lìngwài yí ge fāngmiàn kàn, rúguǒ méi qián, yě hěn nán guò de xìngfú. Dāng nǐ shēngbìng le, rúguǒ yóuyú quē qián ér bù néng jíshí qù kàn yīshēng, nǐ de jiànkāng dōu hěn nán dédào bǎozhèng, jiù gèng bié shuō xìngfú le.
column3: Some people want to dress a little better and have a slightly bigger house, believing that the better off they are, the happier they'll be. In fact, many rich people aren't happy at all, while some poor people live very happily. Having money doesn't necessarily mean happiness, because many things can't be bought with money, such as time, feelings, and life experience. But looking at it from another angle, without money it's also hard to live happily. When you're sick, if you can't see a doctor in time because you lack money, even your health can hardly be guaranteed, let alone your happiness.

column1: 什么是幸福？有的人认为，工资高、能赚钱就是幸福；有的人认为，心情放松、身体健康才是幸福；也有人认为，能帮助别人就是一种幸福。还有人说，小时候幸福是一件东西，比如一块橡皮、一块糖，得到了就很幸福；长大后幸福是一种态度，生活的态度决定了我们幸福感的高低。那怎样才算是真正的幸福？其实，幸福并没有一个标准答案，每个人对幸福都有不同的理解。不管你认为幸福是什么，只要你用心去找，就一定能发现它。
column2: Shénme shì xìngfú? Yǒu de rén rènwéi, gōngzī gāo, néng zhuàn qián jiùshì xìngfú; yǒu de rén rènwéi, xīnqíng fàngsōng, shēntǐ jiànkāng cái shì xìngfú; yě yǒu rén rènwéi, néng bāngzhù biérén jiùshì yì zhǒng xìngfú. Hái yǒu rén shuō, xiǎo shíhou xìngfú shì yí jiàn dōngxi, bǐrú yí kuài xiàngpí, yí kuài táng, dédào le jiù hěn xìngfú; zhǎngdà hòu xìngfú shì yì zhǒng tàidu, shēnghuó de tàidu juédìng le wǒmen xìngfúgǎn de gāodī. Nà zěnyàng cái suàn shì zhēnzhèng de xìngfú? Qíshí, xìngfú bìng méiyǒu yí ge biāozhǔn dá'àn, měi ge rén duì xìngfú dōu yǒu bù tóng de lǐjiě. Bùguǎn nǐ rènwéi xìngfú shì shénme, zhǐyào nǐ yòngxīn qù zhǎo, jiù yídìng néng fāxiàn tā.
column3: What is happiness? Some people think a high salary and making money is happiness; some think a relaxed mind and good health are true happiness; and some think being able to help others is a kind of happiness. Others say that as a child, happiness is a thing—an eraser or a piece of candy—and getting it makes you happy; as an adult, happiness is an attitude, and our attitude toward life determines how happy we feel. So what counts as real happiness? In fact, there's no standard answer; everyone understands happiness differently. Whatever you think happiness is, as long as you look for it with your heart, you'll surely find it.

column1: 你来中国才一年，汉语就说得这么流利，真厉害！
column2: Nǐ lái Zhōngguó cái yì nián, Hànyǔ jiù shuō de zhème liúlì, zhēn lìhai!
column3: You've only been in China a year and you already speak Chinese so fluently—that's amazing!

column1: 谢谢！其实我的语法不太好，很多句子说得都不太准确。
column2: Xièxie! Qíshí wǒ de yǔfǎ bú tài hǎo, hěn duō jùzi shuō de dōu bú tài zhǔnquè.
column3: Thanks! Actually my grammar isn't very good, and a lot of my sentences aren't quite accurate.

column1: 但是我看你跟中国人交流没什么问题，你是怎么做到的？
column2: Dànshì wǒ kàn nǐ gēn Zhōngguó rén jiāoliú méi shénme wèntí, nǐ shì zěnme zuòdào de?
column3: But you seem to have no trouble communicating with Chinese people. How did you do it?

column1: 平时多交一些中国朋友，经常和他们聊天儿，听说能力自然就能得到很大的提高。另外，我建议你坚持看中文报纸，这样能学到很多新词语。
column2: Píngshí duō jiāo yìxiē Zhōngguó péngyou, jīngcháng hé tāmen liáotiānr, tīng shuō nénglì zìrán jiù néng dédào hěn dà de tígāo. Lìngwài, wǒ jiànyì nǐ jiānchí kàn Zhōngwén bàozhǐ, zhèyàng néng xuédào hěn duō xīn cíyǔ.
column3: Make more Chinese friends and chat with them often, and your listening and speaking will naturally improve a lot. Also, I suggest you keep reading Chinese newspapers—that way you'll learn lots of new words.

column1: 你太厉害了！连中文报纸都看得懂。
column2: Nǐ tài lìhai le! Lián Zhōngwén bàozhǐ dōu kàn de dǒng.
column3: You're amazing! You can even understand Chinese newspapers.

column1: 刚开始肯定有困难，不过遇到不认识的词语，你可以查词典，然后写在本子上，有空儿就拿出来复习一下，慢慢地就会发现中文报纸也没那么难了。
column2: Gāng kāishǐ kěndìng yǒu kùnnan, búguò yùdào bú rènshi de cíyǔ, nǐ kěyǐ chá cídiǎn, ránhòu xiě zài běnzi shang, yǒu kòngr jiù ná chulai fùxí yíxià, mànmàn de jiù huì fāxiàn Zhōngwén bàozhǐ yě méi nàme nán le.
column3: It's definitely hard at first, but when you come across words you don't know, you can look them up in a dictionary and write them in a notebook, then take it out to review whenever you have time. Gradually you'll find Chinese newspapers aren't that hard after all.

column1: 考试结束了，你对自己的成绩满意吗？
column2: Kǎoshì jiéshù le, nǐ duì zìjǐ de chéngjì mǎnyì ma?
column3: The exam is over. Are you satisfied with your results?

column1: 说真的，我不太满意。这次阅读考试的题太多了，我没做完。
column2: Shuō zhēn de, wǒ bú tài mǎnyì. Zhè cì yuèdú kǎoshì de tí tài duō le, wǒ méi zuò wán.
column3: Honestly, not really. There were too many questions on the reading test this time, and I didn't finish.

column1: 两个小时的时间应该来得及吧？
column2: Liǎng ge xiǎoshí de shíjiān yīnggāi láidejí ba?
column3: Two hours should have been enough time, right?

column1: 这次主要是因为我先做了比较难、比较复杂的题，结果花了太多时间，后面简单的题我虽然会，可是时间来不及，最后只好放弃了。
column2: Zhè cì zhǔyào shì yīnwèi wǒ xiān zuò le bǐjiào nán, bǐjiào fùzá de tí, jiéguǒ huā le tài duō shíjiān, hòumiàn jiǎndān de tí wǒ suīrán huì, kěshì shíjiān láibují, zuìhòu zhǐhǎo fàngqì le.
column3: This time it was mainly because I did the harder, more complicated questions first and ended up spending too much time. Although I could do the easy ones at the end, I ran out of time and had to give up on them.

column1: 其实我考得也不怎么样。有几个填空题不会做，有几个选择题，实在想不出来该选哪个，就随便猜了一个答案，结果一个都没猜对。
column2: Qíshí wǒ kǎo de yě bù zěnmeyàng. Yǒu jǐ ge tiánkòngtí bú huì zuò, yǒu jǐ ge xuǎnzétí, shízài xiǎng bu chūlái gāi xuǎn nǎge, jiù suíbiàn cāi le yí ge dá'àn, jiéguǒ yí ge dōu méi cāi duì.
column3: Actually I didn't do very well either. There were a few fill-in-the-blank questions I couldn't do, and for a few multiple-choice questions I just couldn't work out which to pick, so I guessed at random—and didn't get a single one right.

column1: 看来要想考好，不但要认真复习，还得注意考试的方法，否则，会做的题也没时间做了。
column2: Kànlái yào xiǎng kǎo hǎo, búdàn yào rènzhēn fùxí, hái děi zhùyì kǎoshì de fāngfǎ, fǒuzé, huì zuò de tí yě méi shíjiān zuò le.
column3: It seems that to do well on exams, you not only have to review carefully but also pay attention to exam technique; otherwise you won't even have time for the questions you can do.

column1: 你的客厅里怎么到处是书啊？这些书你都喜欢看吗？
column2: Nǐ de kètīng li zěnme dàochù shì shū a? Zhèxiē shū nǐ dōu xǐhuan kàn ma?
column3: Why are there books all over your living room? Do you like reading all of these?

column1: 当然，我每天都要看书。无论是普通杂志，还是著名小说，只要打开它们，就会发现，世界上有那么多有意思的事情，有那么多不一样的生活。
column2: Dāngrán, wǒ měi tiān dōu yào kàn shū. Wúlùn shì pǔtōng zázhì, háishi zhùmíng xiǎoshuō, zhǐyào dǎkāi tāmen, jiù huì fāxiàn, shìjiè shang yǒu nàme duō yǒu yìsi de shìqing, yǒu nàme duō bù yíyàng de shēnghuó.
column3: Of course. I read every day. Whether it's an ordinary magazine or a famous novel, as soon as you open it you discover that the world is full of interesting things and so many different ways of living.

column1: 想不到你工作那么忙，还能每天坚持阅读。
column2: Xiǎng bu dào nǐ gōngzuò nàme máng, hái néng měi tiān jiānchí yuèdú.
column3: I'd never have guessed that with such a busy job you still manage to read every day.

column1: 如果3分钟读一页书，半个小时就可以读10页。每天花半个小时来读书，一个月就可以读300页，差不多就是一本书了。

column1: 坚持阅读，除了能增加知识外，还能帮助我减轻压力，人也会变得轻松起来。

column1: 根据调查，阅读能力好的人，不但容易找到工作，而且工资也比较高。怎么才能有效提高自己的阅读能力呢？做读书笔记就是其中一种好方法。读书笔记有很多种，最简单的就是把自己喜欢或者觉得有用的词语和句子记下来。另外，在看完一篇文章或一本书之后，还可以把它的主要内容和自己的想法写下来。然而，你不能完全相信书本上的内容，要有自己的看法和判断。坚持做读书笔记，对提高阅读能力有很大帮助。
column2: Gēnjù diàochá, yuèdú nénglì hǎo de rén, búdàn róngyì zhǎodào gōngzuò, érqiě gōngzī yě bǐjiào gāo. Zěnme cái néng yǒuxiào tígāo zìjǐ de yuèdú nénglì ne? Zuò dúshū bǐjì jiùshì qízhōng yì zhǒng hǎo fāngfǎ. Dúshū bǐjì yǒu hěn duō zhǒng, zuì jiǎndān de jiùshì bǎ zìjǐ xǐhuan huòzhě juéde yǒuyòng de cíyǔ hé jùzi jì xialai. Lìngwài, zài kàn wán yì piān wénzhāng huò yì běn shū zhīhòu, hái kěyǐ bǎ tā de zhǔyào nèiróng hé zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ xiě xialai. Rán'ér, nǐ bù néng wánquán xiāngxìn shūběn shang de nèiróng, yào yǒu zìjǐ de kànfǎ hé pànduàn. Jiānchí zuò dúshū bǐjì, duì tígāo yuèdú nénglì yǒu hěn dà bāngzhù.
column3: According to surveys, people with good reading skills not only find jobs more easily but also earn higher salaries. How can you effectively improve your reading ability? Keeping reading notes is one good method. There are many kinds of reading notes; the simplest is to write down words and sentences you like or find useful. Also, after finishing an article or a book, you can write down its main content and your own thoughts. However, you shouldn't completely believe what's in books—you need your own views and judgment. Keeping reading notes consistently is a great help in improving reading ability.

column1: “读书好，读好书，好读书”。虽然这句话只用了三个相同的汉字，但是不同的顺序却表示了不同的意思。首先，“读书好”说的是读书有很多好处；其次，每个人的时间都是有限的，不可能把世界上每一本书都读完，所以要读好的书；最后，“好读书”就是要养成阅读的习惯，使读书真正成为自己的兴趣爱好。阅读有许多好处，它能丰富你的知识，让你找到解决问题的办法；同时，它还会丰富你的情感，使你的生活更精彩。所以，让阅读成为你的习惯吧！
column2: Dúshū hǎo, dú hǎo shū, hào dúshū. Suīrán zhè jù huà zhǐ yòng le sān ge xiāngtóng de Hànzì, dànshì bù tóng de shùnxù què biǎoshì le bù tóng de yìsi. Shǒuxiān, "dúshū hǎo" shuō de shì dúshū yǒu hěn duō hǎochù; qícì, měi ge rén de shíjiān dōu shì yǒuxiàn de, bù kěnéng bǎ shìjiè shang měi yì běn shū dōu dú wán, suǒyǐ yào dú hǎo de shū; zuìhòu, "hào dúshū" jiùshì yào yǎngchéng yuèdú de xíguàn, shǐ dúshū zhēnzhèng chéngwéi zìjǐ de xìngqù àihào. Yuèdú yǒu xǔduō hǎochù, tā néng fēngfù nǐ de zhīshi, ràng nǐ zhǎodào jiějué wèntí de bànfǎ; tóngshí, tā hái huì fēngfù nǐ de qínggǎn, shǐ nǐ de shēnghuó gèng jīngcǎi. Suǒyǐ, ràng yuèdú chéngwéi nǐ de xíguàn ba!
column3: Reading is good, read good books, love reading. Although this saying uses only the same three characters, their different orders express different meanings. First, "reading is good" means reading has many benefits. Second, everyone's time is limited and no one can read every book in the world, so you should read good books. Finally, "love reading" means forming the habit of reading so that it truly becomes your hobby. Reading has many benefits: it enriches your knowledge and helps you find ways to solve problems; at the same time, it enriches your emotions and makes your life more colorful. So make reading your habit!

Yǒu de rén xīnli zěnme xiǎng, zuǐ shang jiù zěnme shuō, jíshǐ shì biérén de quēdiǎn, tā yě huì zhíjiē shuō chulai, zhèyàng de rén suīrán hěn chéngshí, dànshì kěnéng huì yǐnqǐ biérén de wùhuì; yǒu de rén suīrán yě kàndào le biérén de quēdiǎn, dàn què bú huì zhíjiē zhǐ chulai, ér shì tōngguò bié de fāngfǎ lái tíxǐng, ràng tā rènshi dào zìjǐ de quēdiǎn, zhèyàng de rén huì ràng rén juéde gèng yǒuhǎo.

Some people say exactly what they think—even about others' shortcomings, they'll say it straight out. Such people are honest, but they may cause misunderstandings. Others also see people's shortcomings but don't point them out directly; instead they remind them in other ways so they realize their faults themselves. People like that come across as friendlier.

column1: 无论做什么事情，都要注意方法，学习尤其是这样。使用正确的方法，我们做起事来能“事半功倍”，也就是说，能节约时间，用较少的力气，取得更好的效果。相反，如果方法不对，可能花五倍甚至十倍的时间都不能完成任务，结果变成了“事倍功半”。有一点需要提醒大家，别人的方法也许很有效，但是并不一定适合自己。因此，我们应该在听取别人意见的同时，仔细考虑一下，再根据不同的情况选择不同的方法，这样才能达到最好的效果。

column3: Whatever you do, you need to pay attention to method—especially when studying. With the right method, we can "get twice the result with half the effort": that is, save time, use less energy, and get better results. On the other hand, if the method is wrong, you might spend five or even ten times as long and still not finish the task, ending up with "twice the effort for half the result." One thing I should remind everyone: other people's methods may be effective, but they won't necessarily suit you. So while listening to others' advice, we should think it over carefully and then choose different methods for different situations. Only then can we achieve the best results.

column3: Chopsticks have a history of more than 3,000 years in China. However, if you think every Chinese person uses chopsticks correctly, you're wrong. Someone did a survey on the internet and found that one in every six Chinese people holds chopsticks the wrong way. If you want to use chopsticks correctly, then practice hard.

column1: 茶在中国有几千年的历史，是中国最常见的饮料。最早的时候，茶只是被当作一种药，而不是饮料。后来，随着人们对茶的认识的加深，慢慢开始把它当作解渴的饮料，这才慢慢有了中国的茶文化。在中国，喝茶是一种十分普遍的生活习惯。对很多中国人来说，喝茶已成为他们生活中不可缺少的一部分。但是有的饮料虽然名字叫“茶”，却并不是真正的茶。比如广东省的人爱喝的“凉茶”，它的味道稍微有点儿苦，其实是一种用中药做成的饮料。
column2: Chá zài Zhōngguó yǒu jǐ qiān nián de lìshǐ, shì Zhōngguó zuì chángjiàn de yǐnliào. Zuì zǎo de shíhou, chá zhǐ shì bèi dàngzuò yì zhǒng yào, ér bú shì yǐnliào. Hòulái, suízhe rénmen duì chá de rènshi de jiāshēn, mànmàn kāishǐ bǎ tā dàngzuò jiěkě de yǐnliào, zhè cái mànmàn yǒu le Zhōngguó de chá wénhuà. Zài Zhōngguó, hē chá shì yì zhǒng shífēn pǔbiàn de shēnghuó xíguàn. Duì hěn duō Zhōngguó rén lái shuō, hē chá yǐ chéngwéi tāmen shēnghuó zhōng bùkě quēshǎo de yí bùfen. Dànshì yǒu de yǐnliào suīrán míngzi jiào "chá", què bìng bú shì zhēnzhèng de chá. Bǐrú Guǎngdōng Shěng de rén ài hē de "liángchá", tā de wèidao shāowēi yǒudiǎnr kǔ, qíshí shì yì zhǒng yòng zhōngyào zuò chéng de yǐnliào.
column3: Tea has a history of several thousand years in China and is the most common drink there. At first, tea was only used as a medicine, not a drink. Later, as people came to understand tea better, they gradually began to treat it as a thirst-quenching drink, and that's how Chinese tea culture slowly developed. In China, drinking tea is a very common habit. For many Chinese people, drinking tea has become an indispensable part of life. But some drinks called "tea" aren't really tea at all. For example, the "herbal tea" that people in Guangdong Province love tastes slightly bitter—it's actually a drink made from traditional Chinese medicine.

Although this is a small thing, doing so reduces the number of plastic bags used and plays a big role in protecting the environment.

column1: 保护地球环境，并不是一件离我们很远、很难做到的事情。实际上，我们只需注意一下身边的小事就可以。例如，夏天把空调的温度开得高一些，出门时记得关空调和电脑，这样可以节约用电；少开车，多骑车或者乘坐地铁和公共汽车，这样能降低空气污染；还有养成把垃圾丢进垃圾桶的习惯什么的。这些是我们每个人都能够做到的小事，但却有实实在在的效果。地球是我们共同的家，只有大家共同努力，减少污染、保护环境，才能使我们的家变得更美丽。

column3: Protecting the Earth's environment isn't something far away from us or hard to do. In fact, we only need to pay attention to the little things around us. For example, set the air conditioner a bit higher in summer, and remember to turn off the air conditioner and computer when you go out—that saves electricity; drive less and ride a bike or take the subway and bus more—that reduces air pollution; and get into the habit of putting rubbish in the bin, and so on. These are small things each of us can do, but they have real effects. The Earth is our shared home. Only if everyone works together to reduce pollution and protect the environment can we make our home more beautiful.

column2: Kànlái háishi wǒ de jiàoyù fāngfǎ yǒu wèntí. Píngshí kàn tā zuò shìqing màn, zǒng xiǎng tì tā zuò, yǐhòu děi ràng tā xuéhuì ānpái shíjiān, zìjǐ de shìqing zìjǐ zuò.
column3: It seems the problem is really my way of raising her. Usually when I see her being slow, I always want to do things for her. From now on I'll have to let her learn to plan her time and do her own things herself.

column3: I remember when my daughter was little and I took her to the hospital for a shot, at first she was so scared she was about to cry. So I quietly told the nurse that my daughter was very brave and not afraid of shots at all, and as soon as she heard that, she stopped crying.

column1: 原来鼓励和表扬对小孩儿挺有用的，下次我也试试。
column2: Yuánlái gǔlì hé biǎoyáng duì xiǎoháir tǐng yǒuyòng de, xià cì wǒ yě shìshi.
column3: So encouragement and praise really work on little kids. I'll try it next time too.

column1: 不过表扬也是一门艺术，表扬千万不要太多，过多的表扬可能会给孩子带来压力。不仅起不到鼓励的作用，还可能让孩子怀疑自己的能力，变得没有信心。
column2: Búguò biǎoyáng yě shì yì mén yìshù, biǎoyáng qiānwàn bú yào tài duō, guò duō de biǎoyáng kěnéng huì gěi háizi dàilái yālì. Bùjǐn qǐ bu dào gǔlì de zuòyòng, hái kěnéng ràng háizi huáiyí zìjǐ de nénglì, biàn de méiyǒu xìnxīn.
column3: But praise is also an art. You must never praise too much—too much praise can put pressure on a child. Not only does it fail to encourage, it may also make the child doubt his own ability and lose confidence.

column1: 那怎么表扬孩子才会更有效果呢？
column2: Nà zěnme biǎoyáng háizi cái huì gèng yǒu xiàoguǒ ne?
column3: Then how should you praise a child so it's more effective?

column1: 我认为表扬要及时，而且表扬不仅仅要看结果，更要看过程，这样才能鼓励他的积极性，让他变得勇敢，不怕困难。
column2: Wǒ rènwéi biǎoyáng yào jíshí, érqiě biǎoyáng bù jǐnjǐn yào kàn jiéguǒ, gèng yào kàn guòchéng, zhèyàng cái néng gǔlì tā de jījíxìng, ràng tā biàn de yǒnggǎn, bú pà kùnnan.
column3: I think praise should be timely, and it shouldn't just look at the result but even more at the process. Only then can it encourage his enthusiasm and make him brave and unafraid of difficulties.

column1: 有的孩子在得不到自己想要的东西的时候，会通过哭、扔东西或者故意敲打来引起父母的注意。在这种情况下，建议父母先不要生气，应该停下手中的事情，陪孩子整理整理东西，和他们聊聊天儿，弄清楚他们的问题。父母的关心，可以让孩子心情愉快起来。教育孩子应该选择合适的教育方法，最好不要为了解决问题而骗孩子，这是因为儿童缺少判断能力，看到父母骗人，他们也会学着说假话。
column2: Yǒude háizi zài dé bu dào zìjǐ xiǎng yào de dōngxi de shíhou, huì tōngguò kū, rēng dōngxi huòzhě gùyì qiāodǎ lái yǐnqǐ fùmǔ de zhùyì. Zài zhè zhǒng qíngkuàng xià, jiànyì fùmǔ xiān bú yào shēngqì, yīnggāi tíngxià shǒu zhōng de shìqing, péi háizi zhěnglǐ zhěnglǐ dōngxi, hé tāmen liáoliao tiānr, nòng qīngchu tāmen de wèntí. Fùmǔ de guānxīn, kěyǐ ràng háizi xīnqíng yúkuài qilai. Jiàoyù háizi yīnggāi xuǎnzé héshì de jiàoyù fāngfǎ, zuìhǎo bú yào wèile jiějué wèntí ér piàn háizi, zhè shì yīnwèi értóng quēshǎo pànduàn nénglì, kàndào fùmǔ piàn rén, tāmen yě huì xuézhe shuō jiǎhuà.
column3: When some children can't get what they want, they try to get their parents' attention by crying, throwing things, or deliberately banging on things. In this situation, parents are advised not to get angry first, but to stop what they're doing, help the child tidy things up, chat with them, and figure out what the problem is. Parents' care can put a child in a happy mood. In raising children you should choose a suitable method, and it's best not to deceive children just to solve a problem, because children lack judgment; when they see their parents lie, they will learn to tell lies too.

column1: 七岁左右的儿童普遍好动，坐不住，所以老师在教这个年龄段的孩子时，一定要想办法引起他们的兴趣。只有让他们觉得你教的内容有趣，他们才会愿意努力学习。当孩子不明白时，应该多鼓励他，不要用“懒”“笨”“粗心”这种词批评他，这样对他们的正常发展不好。而且，对不同性格的孩子要使用不同的教育方法。如果孩子比较骄傲，应该让他明白还有很多知识需要学习；要是孩子性格有些害羞，就要经常鼓励他说出自己的看法，这样才能让每一个孩子都健康地发展。
column2: Qī suì zuǒyòu de értóng pǔbiàn hàodòng, zuò bu zhù, suǒyǐ lǎoshī zài jiāo zhège niánlíngduàn de háizi shí, yídìng yào xiǎng bànfǎ yǐnqǐ tāmen de xìngqù. Zhǐyǒu ràng tāmen juéde nǐ jiāo de nèiróng yǒuqù, tāmen cái huì yuànyì nǔlì xuéxí. Dāng háizi bù míngbai shí, yīnggāi duō gǔlì tā, bú yào yòng "lǎn" "bèn" "cūxīn" zhè zhǒng cí pīpíng tā, zhèyàng duì tāmen de zhèngcháng fāzhǎn bù hǎo. Érqiě, duì bù tóng xìnggé de háizi yào shǐyòng bù tóng de jiàoyù fāngfǎ. Rúguǒ háizi bǐjiào jiāo'ào, yīnggāi ràng tā míngbai hái yǒu hěn duō zhīshi xūyào xuéxí; yàoshi háizi xìnggé yǒuxiē hàixiū, jiù yào jīngcháng gǔlì tā shuōchū zìjǐ de kànfǎ, zhèyàng cái néng ràng měi yí ge háizi dōu jiànkāng de fāzhǎn.
column3: Children around seven are generally restless and can't sit still, so when teachers teach children of this age, they must find ways to spark their interest. Only when they find what you teach interesting will they be willing to study hard. When a child doesn't understand, you should encourage him more and not criticize him with words like "lazy," "stupid," or "careless"—that is bad for their normal development. Moreover, children with different personalities need different teaching methods. If a child is rather proud, you should help him understand there is still a lot of knowledge to learn; if a child is a bit shy, you should often encourage him to express his own views. Only this way can every child develop healthily.

column3: It's not only people in society who compete with each other—the various plants in a forest compete too, and that's not strange at all. Plants compete for sunlight, air, and water. Some tall plants can often get more sunlight, air, and water, while the remaining shorter plants can only grow beneath these tall ones. Because climate conditions differ, the shapes of plant leaves around the world are also very different. In warm places with plenty of water, leaves tend to grow big and thick; in places with very strong sunlight and little water, leaves grow thin and long.

column3: People today, especially college students, have begun to use computers widely, and their lives can no longer do without them. According to a survey, when 70% of people run into a problem, the first thing they think of is to look for the answer online.

column1: 我昨天晚上做了一个特别奇怪的梦，梦到自己正在一座桥上走，走着走着，突然开过来一辆车，非常危险，接着又梦见我跳到车上，跟警察一起抓住了一个坏人。
column2: Wǒ zuótiān wǎnshang zuòle yí ge tèbié qíguài de mèng, mèngdào zìjǐ zhèngzài yí zuò qiáo shang zǒu, zǒuzhe zǒuzhe, tūrán kāi guolai yí liàng chē, fēicháng wēixiǎn, jiēzhe yòu mèngjiàn wǒ tiàodào chē shang, gēn jǐngchá yìqǐ zhuāzhùle yí ge huàirén.

column1: 每个人都会做梦，区别只是有多有少。有的人睡醒之后还记得梦里的事情，有的人却记不清楚了。你之所以觉得从来没做过梦，只不过是忘记了。
column2: Měi ge rén dōu huì zuòmèng, qūbié zhǐ shì yǒu duō yǒu shǎo. Yǒude rén shuìxǐng zhīhòu hái jìde mèng li de shìqing, yǒude rén què jì bu qīngchu le. Nǐ zhīsuǒyǐ juéde cónglái méi zuòguo mèng, zhǐbuguò shì wàngjì le.
column3: Everyone dreams; the only difference is how much. Some people still remember what happened in their dreams after waking up, while others can't remember clearly. The reason you feel you've never dreamed is simply that you forgot.

column1: 你说的有道理，我一般都是一觉睡到天亮。很多人认为做梦是上天要告诉他们将来会发生的一些事情，可能上天不想让我知道吧。
column2: Nǐ shuō de yǒu dàoli, wǒ yìbān dōu shì yí jiào shuìdào tiān liàng. Hěn duō rén rènwéi zuòmèng shì shàngtiān yào gàosu tāmen jiānglái huì fāshēng de yìxiē shìqing, kěnéng shàngtiān bù xiǎng ràng wǒ zhīdào ba.
column3: You have a point. I usually sleep straight through until dawn. Many people believe dreams are Heaven's way of telling them things that will happen in the future—maybe Heaven doesn't want me to know.

column1: 一般晚上睡觉时，身体感觉到什么，梦里就可能出现什么。例如，睡觉时如果感觉冷，就可能梦见下雪；如果感觉口渴，可能会梦见喝水。科学家们一直在对梦进行研究，但是关于梦，仍然还有很多问题没有找到答案。
column2: Yìbān wǎnshang shuìjiào shí, shēntǐ gǎnjué dào shénme, mèng li jiù kěnéng chūxiàn shénme. Lìrú, shuìjiào shí rúguǒ gǎnjué lěng, jiù kěnéng mèngjiàn xià xuě; rúguǒ gǎnjué kǒu kě, kěnéng huì mèngjiàn hē shuǐ. Kēxuéjiāmen yìzhí zài duì mèng jìnxíng yánjiū, dànshì guānyú mèng, réngrán hái yǒu hěn duō wèntí méiyǒu zhǎodào dá'àn.
column3: Generally, whatever your body feels while you sleep at night may show up in your dreams. For example, if you feel cold while sleeping, you may dream of snow; if you feel thirsty, you may dream of drinking water. Scientists have long been researching dreams, but there are still many questions about dreams that haven't been answered.

column1: 现在手机不但价格降低了，而且作用也越来越大，打电话、发短信已经成了人们普遍使用的联系方法。除此以外，你还可以用它来听音乐、看电影、阅读、玩儿游戏、付款购物等，这大大方便了人们的生活。举一个例子，迷路时，只要用手机地图查一下地址，马上就能知道怎么去那个地点。现在的手机更像是一部可以拿在手中的电脑，现代人的生活已经越来越离不开手机了。
column2: Xiànzài shǒujī búdàn jiàgé jiàngdī le, érqiě zuòyòng yě yuè lái yuè dà, dǎ diànhuà, fā duǎnxìn yǐjīng chéngle rénmen pǔbiàn shǐyòng de liánxì fāngfǎ. Chú cǐ yǐwài, nǐ hái kěyǐ yòng tā lái tīng yīnyuè, kàn diànyǐng, yuèdú, wánr yóuxì, fùkuǎn gòuwù děng, zhè dàdà fāngbiànle rénmen de shēnghuó. Jǔ yí ge lìzi, mílù shí, zhǐyào yòng shǒujī dìtú chá yíxià dìzhǐ, mǎshàng jiù néng zhīdào zěnme qù nàge dìdiǎn. Xiànzài de shǒujī gèng xiàng shì yí bù kěyǐ ná zài shǒu zhōng de diànnǎo, xiàndàirén de shēnghuó yǐjīng yuè lái yuè lí bu kāi shǒujī le.
column3: Today mobile phones have not only become cheaper but also more and more useful. Making calls and sending text messages have become the common ways people keep in touch. Besides that, you can use one to listen to music, watch movies, read, play games, pay and shop, and so on, which makes people's lives much more convenient. For example, when you're lost, you just look up the address on a phone map and immediately know how to get there. Today's phones are more like a computer you can hold in your hand; modern people's lives depend more and more on their phones.

column1: 21世纪，我们的生活发生了巨大变化。几千公里以外的国家，以前坐船需要几个月，现在乘坐飞机不过十几个小时。原来寄信需要好几天，现在连邮局都不用去，只要在家里上网发个电子邮件，用不了一分钟，远处的朋友就能收到，比写信封用的时间都短。以前外地的新闻要几天后才能知道，现在只要打开网站，任何信息都可以在第一时间获得。现代科学技术的发展让世界变得越来越小，所以现在人们都把地球叫作“地球村”。
column2: Èrshíyī shìjì, wǒmen de shēnghuó fāshēngle jùdà biànhuà. Jǐ qiān gōnglǐ yǐwài de guójiā, yǐqián zuò chuán xūyào jǐ ge yuè, xiànzài chéngzuò fēijī búguò shí jǐ ge xiǎoshí. Yuánlái jì xìn xūyào hǎo jǐ tiān, xiànzài lián yóujú dōu bú yòng qù, zhǐyào zài jiā li shàngwǎng fā ge diànzǐ yóujiàn, yòng bu liǎo yì fēnzhōng, yuǎnchù de péngyou jiù néng shōudào, bǐ xiě xìnfēng yòng de shíjiān dōu duǎn. Yǐqián wàidì de xīnwén yào jǐ tiān hòu cái néng zhīdào, xiànzài zhǐyào dǎkāi wǎngzhàn, rènhé xìnxī dōu kěyǐ zài dì-yī shíjiān huòdé. Xiàndài kēxué jìshù de fāzhǎn ràng shìjiè biàn de yuè lái yuè xiǎo, suǒyǐ xiànzài rénmen dōu bǎ dìqiú jiàozuò "dìqiúcūn".
column3: In the 21st century, our lives have changed enormously. Traveling to a country thousands of kilometers away used to take months by ship; now it's only a dozen or so hours by plane. Sending a letter used to take several days; now you don't even need to go to the post office—just go online at home and send an email, and in less than a minute a friend far away receives it, taking even less time than writing the address on an envelope. News from other places used to take days to reach us; now you just open a website and any information can be had right away. The development of modern science and technology has made the world smaller and smaller, so people now call the earth a "global village."

column3: Many foreigners think all Chinese people know kung fu and ping-pong, but in fact it's just that a lot of Chinese people love these two sports. Chinese people especially love playing ping-pong, and in China you'll find ping-pong tables everywhere. Sports like ping-pong, badminton, and running don't require much in the way of conditions, so they've all become good choices for people to exercise. People often say "life lies in movement," so many people go to the gym to play a few games as soon as the weekend comes. The name "pingpang" is also interesting: "ping" and "pang" are the sounds the ball makes when it's hit. When watching a ping-pong match, especially when a player is serving, the audience should be quiet; talking loudly or leaving your seat and walking around is prohibited.

column3: China stretches about 5,500 kilometers from north to south, so the climate differs greatly between north and south. Every year around March and April, if you take a train from the north to travel in the south, you'll notice along the way that different places have different scenery: the trees outside the window turn green one after another; it may still be snowing in the north, while the south is already green everywhere. Southern food is very distinctive, especially the soups, which taste delicious, and many northerners love them. In addition, the languages of the south and north are also very different. For example, when you talk with people from Shanghai, you'll find that Shanghainese sounds just like a foreign language. Although Shanghai people can also speak Mandarin, if you listen carefully, you can still hear a Shanghai flavor.

column1: 一个人有时间一定要去旅行，旅行不仅能丰富一个人的经历，而且是很好的减压方法。但对我来说，最重要的是旅行能让我有机会尝到各地有名的小吃。放假的时候，我会收拾好行李，带上地图，买张火车票，向目的地出发。说起吃的东西，给我印象最深的是湖南菜。湖南菜的特点就是辣，与其他地方的辣不同，湖南菜的辣主要是咸辣、香辣和酸辣。虽然全国各地都有湖南饭馆儿，但最好还是直接去那里尝一尝。每次旅行结束后，我都会精神百倍地开始我的工作。

column3: When you have time, you should definitely travel. Travel not only enriches your experience but is also a great way to relieve stress. For me, though, the most important thing is that travel gives me the chance to taste famous snacks from all over. When I'm on vacation, I pack my luggage, bring a map, buy a train ticket, and set off for my destination. Speaking of food, what impressed me most is Hunan cuisine. Its defining feature is spiciness, but unlike the spiciness of other places, Hunan food is mainly salty-spicy, fragrant-spicy, and sour-spicy. Although there are Hunan restaurants all over the country, it's best to go there and taste it directly. Every time a trip ends, I start my work full of energy.

column2: Píngwěi jiào dì-yī duì fūqī shuōshuo tā liǎ shì rúhé ēn'ài de. Qīzi shuō, qián jǐ nián tā quánshēn tānhuàn le, yīshēng shuō tā zhàn qilai de kěnéngxìng hěn xiǎo. Biéren dōu juéde tā de zhàngfu huì gēn tā líhūn, tā yě xiǎng guo yào zìshā. Dàn zhàngfu yìzhí gǔlì tā, wèi tā bù zhī zhǎo le duōshao jiā yīyuàn, bìngqiě jǐ nián rú yí rì de zhàogù tā, cóng bú bàoyuàn. Zài zhàngfu de àihù hé nǔlì xià, tā zhōngyú yòu zhàn le qilai. Tā de gùshi shífēn gǎnrén, píngwěimen tīng le dōu hěn gǎndòng.
column3: The judges asked the first couple to tell how loving they were. The wife said that a few years ago she had become completely paralyzed, and the doctors said there was little chance she would ever stand again. Everyone thought her husband would divorce her, and she had even thought of killing herself. But her husband kept encouraging her, searched who knows how many hospitals for her, and cared for her day after day for years without ever complaining. Thanks to her husband's loving care and effort, she finally stood up again. Her story was very touching, and all the judges were moved when they heard it.

column1: 随后进来的是第二对夫妻，他俩说，十几年的婚姻生活中，他们从来没为任何事红过脸、吵过架，一直相亲相爱、相敬如宾。评委们听了暗暗点头。
column2: Suíhòu jìnlai de shì dì-èr duì fūqī, tā liǎ shuō, shí jǐ nián de hūnyīn shēnghuó zhōng, tāmen cónglái méi wèi rènhé shì hóng guo liǎn, chǎo guo jià, yìzhí xiāngqīn xiāng'ài, xiāngjìng rú bīn. Píngwěimen tīng le àn'àn diǎntóu.
column3: Next came the second couple. They said that in more than ten years of marriage they had never once had a heated word or a quarrel over anything; they had always loved each other dearly and treated each other with the respect due a guest. The judges quietly nodded as they listened.

column1: 轮到第三对夫妻了，却很长时间不见人。评委们等得有些不耐烦，就走出来看个究竟。只见第三对夫妻仍然坐在门口，男人的头靠在女人的肩膀上，睡着了。一个评委要上前喊醒那个男的，女的却伸出手指做了小声的动作，然后小心地从包里拿出纸笔，用左手歪歪扭扭写下一行字递给评委，而她的右肩一直让丈夫的脑袋靠着。评委们看那纸条上面写着：别出声，他昨晚没睡好。一个评委提起笔在后面续写了一句话：但是女士，我们得听你们夫妻俩的叙述啊！女人又写：那我们就不参加了。
column2: Lúndào dì-sān duì fūqī le, què hěn cháng shíjiān bú jiàn rén. Píngwěimen děng de yǒuxiē bú nàifán, jiù zǒu chulai kàn ge jiūjìng. Zhǐ jiàn dì-sān duì fūqī réngrán zuò zài ménkǒu, nánrén de tóu kào zài nǚrén de jiānbǎng shang, shuìzháo le. Yí ge píngwěi yào shàngqián hǎnxǐng nàge nán de, nǚ de què shēnchū shǒuzhǐ zuò le xiǎoshēng de dòngzuò, ránhòu xiǎoxīn de cóng bāo li náchū zhǐ bǐ, yòng zuǒshǒu wāiwāiniǔniǔ xiěxià yì háng zì dìgěi píngwěi, ér tā de yòu jiān yìzhí ràng zhàngfu de nǎodai kàozhe. Píngwěimen kàn nà zhǐtiáo shàngmiàn xiězhe: Bié chūshēng, tā zuówǎn méi shuìhǎo. Yí ge píngwěi tíqǐ bǐ zài hòumiàn xùxiě le yí jù huà: Dànshì nǚshì, wǒmen děi tīng nǐmen fūqī liǎ de xùshù a! Nǚrén yòu xiě: Nà wǒmen jiù bù cānjiā le.
column3: It was the third couple's turn, but for a long time nobody appeared. The judges grew a little impatient and went out to see what was going on. They saw the third couple still sitting by the door, the man's head resting on the woman's shoulder, fast asleep. One judge was about to step forward and wake the man, but the woman held up a finger in a "shh" gesture, then carefully took a pen and paper out of her bag, wrote a line in crooked characters with her left hand, and handed it to the judge, all the while letting her husband's head rest on her right shoulder. The note read: Please be quiet, he didn't sleep well last night. One judge picked up the pen and added a line below: But madam, we need to hear your story as a couple! The woman wrote again: Then we won't take part.

column1: 大家很吃惊，这个女人为了不影响丈夫睡觉，居然放弃这次机会！但评委们还是决定先不催他们，而是再等待一段时间。
column2: Dàjiā hěn chījīng, zhège nǚrén wèile bù yǐngxiǎng zhàngfu shuìjiào, jūrán fàngqì zhè cì jīhuì! Dàn píngwěimen háishi juédìng xiān bù cuī tāmen, ér shì zài děngdài yí duàn shíjiān.
column3: Everyone was astonished: so as not to disturb her husband's sleep, this woman was actually giving up the opportunity! Still, the judges decided not to hurry them for now, and to wait a while longer instead.

column1: 过了一会儿，男人醒了。评委们问他怎么那么累。男人不好意思地笑笑说：“我家住一楼，蚊子多。昨晚半夜我被蚊子叮醒了，我怕我老婆再被吵醒，所以后半夜就在为她赶蚊子。”
column2: Guò le yíhuìr, nánrén xǐng le. Píngwěimen wèn tā zěnme nàme lèi. Nánrén bù hǎoyìsi de xiàoxiao shuō: "Wǒ jiā zhù yī lóu, wénzi duō. Zuówǎn bànyè wǒ bèi wénzi dīngxǐng le, wǒ pà wǒ lǎopo zài bèi chǎoxǐng, suǒyǐ hòu bànyè jiù zài wèi tā gǎn wénzi."
column3: After a while the man woke up. The judges asked him why he was so tired. He smiled sheepishly and said, "We live on the ground floor, and there are lots of mosquitoes. In the middle of last night a mosquito bite woke me up, and I was afraid my wife would be woken up too, so I spent the rest of the night chasing the mosquitoes away from her."

column1: 最后的结果是，电台增加了两项奖项，将第一对夫妻评为“患难与共夫妻”，将第二对夫妻评为“相敬如宾夫妻”，而真正的“最恩爱夫妻”奖，却给了第三对夫妻。
column2: Zuìhòu de jiéguǒ shì, diàntái zēngjiā le liǎng xiàng jiǎngxiàng, jiāng dì-yī duì fūqī píngwéi "huànnàn yǔ gòng fūqī", jiāng dì-èr duì fūqī píngwéi "xiāngjìng rú bīn fūqī", ér zhēnzhèng de "zuì ēn'ài fūqī" jiǎng, què gěi le dì-sān duì fūqī.
column3: In the end, the station added two more awards: the first couple was named "the couple who share weal and woe", and the second "the couple who treat each other with respect", while the real "most loving couple" award went to the third couple.

column1: 父母一辈子住在农村老家，对老屋的感情，就像没断奶的孩子对母亲一样。因此长年以来，父母很少离开老屋，尽管姥姥、舅舅和姑姑都在城里，父母也坚决不在城里住。
column2: Fùmǔ yíbèizi zhù zài nóngcūn lǎojiā, duì lǎo wū de gǎnqíng, jiù xiàng méi duànnǎi de háizi duì mǔqīn yíyàng. Yīncǐ chángnián yǐlái, fùmǔ hěn shǎo líkāi lǎo wū, jǐnguǎn lǎolao, jiùjiu hé gūgu dōu zài chéng li, fùmǔ yě jiānjué bú zài chéng li zhù.
column3: My parents have lived their whole lives in our old home in the countryside, and their attachment to the old house is like an unweaned child's attachment to its mother. So for many years they rarely left it; even though my grandma, uncle and aunt all live in town, my parents firmly refused to live there.

column1: 去年，在我和妻子的努力下，我们终于用打工挣的钱，在县里买了一套新房。新房装修完，父母第一次走进新房时，高兴得不得了。妻子提出留一串钥匙给父母，可他们拒绝了。那天，父亲喝醉了，等他醒时，天色已晚。我和妻子强留父母在新房住一夜，第二天再回，但他们仍坚持坐上了最后一趟回老家的车。
column2: Qùnián, zài wǒ hé qīzi de nǔlì xià, wǒmen zhōngyú yòng dǎgōng zhèng de qián, zài xiàn li mǎi le yí tào xīnfáng. Xīnfáng zhuāngxiū wán, fùmǔ dì-yī cì zǒujìn xīnfáng shí, gāoxìng de bùdéliǎo. Qīzi tíchū liú yí chuàn yàoshi gěi fùmǔ, kě tāmen jùjué le. Nà tiān, fùqīn hēzuì le, děng tā xǐng shí, tiānsè yǐ wǎn. Wǒ hé qīzi qiǎng liú fùmǔ zài xīnfáng zhù yí yè, dì-èr tiān zài huí, dàn tāmen réng jiānchí zuòshang le zuìhòu yí tàng huí lǎojiā de chē.
column3: Last year, through my wife's and my hard work, we finally used the money we'd earned as migrant workers to buy a new apartment in the county town. When the renovation was done and my parents walked into the new home for the first time, they were overjoyed. My wife suggested leaving a set of keys with them, but they refused. That day my father got drunk, and by the time he woke up it was already late. My wife and I insisted they stay the night and go back the next day, but they still insisted on taking the last bus back home.

column1: 一段时间后，我和妻子又准备去外地打工，新房只能上锁空着。临走那天，父亲从老家赶来送我们。父亲悄悄把我拉到一边说：“你妈说了，你还是留一串新房的钥匙给我们，要是我和你妈什么时候想来了，就来住上几天，顺便给你们晒晒被子，打扫打扫卫生。”父亲说这话时，轻声细语，还红着脸，像个害羞的孩子。
column2: Yí duàn shíjiān hòu, wǒ hé qīzi yòu zhǔnbèi qù wàidì dǎgōng, xīnfáng zhǐ néng shàngsuǒ kòngzhe. Línzǒu nà tiān, fùqīn cóng lǎojiā gǎnlai sòng wǒmen. Fùqīn qiāoqiāo bǎ wǒ lā dào yìbiān shuō: "Nǐ mā shuō le, nǐ háishi liú yí chuàn xīnfáng de yàoshi gěi wǒmen, yàoshi wǒ hé nǐ mā shénme shíhou xiǎng lái le, jiù lái zhù shang jǐ tiān, shùnbiàn gěi nǐmen shàishai bèizi, dǎsǎo dǎsǎo wèishēng." Fùqīn shuō zhè huà shí, qīngshēng xìyǔ, hái hóngzhe liǎn, xiàng ge hàixiū de háizi.
column3: Some time later, my wife and I were getting ready to go work elsewhere again, so the new home would have to be locked up and left empty. On the day we left, my father hurried over from home to see us off. He quietly pulled me aside and said, "Your mom says you'd better leave us a set of keys to the new place after all. If your mom and I ever feel like coming, we can stay a few days, and air out your quilts and give the place a clean while we're at it." As he said this, he spoke softly and blushed, like a shy child.

column1: 转眼又是半年，我们回家时是一个深冬的夜里。下了长途车，儿子被冻得大哭。我和妻子想象着打开家门满是灰尘、冷冷清清的景象，觉得心里发寒。来到楼下，抬头一看，却发现自家亮着灯光。上了楼，开门的竟是微笑着的父母，温暖的气息立刻扑面而来：室内打扫得干干净净，暖气开着，水已温热，卧室床上的被子已铺好，厨房里飘来阵阵饭菜香。
column2: Zhuǎnyǎn yòu shì bàn nián, wǒmen huí jiā shí shì yí ge shēn dōng de yè li. Xià le chángtú chē, érzi bèi dòng de dà kū. Wǒ hé qīzi xiǎngxiàngzhe dǎkāi jiāmén mǎn shì huīchén, lěnglěngqīngqīng de jǐngxiàng, juéde xīnli fā hán. Láidào lóu xià, táitóu yí kàn, què fāxiàn zìjiā liàngzhe dēngguāng. Shàng le lóu, kāimén de jìng shì wēixiàozhe de fùmǔ, wēnnuǎn de qìxī lìkè pūmiàn ér lái: shìnèi dǎsǎo de gāngānjìngjìng, nuǎnqì kāizhe, shuǐ yǐ wēnrè, wòshì chuáng shang de bèizi yǐ pūhǎo, chúfáng li piāolai zhènzhèn fàncài xiāng.
column3: In the blink of an eye another half year passed, and we came home on a night in the depths of winter. When we got off the long-distance bus, our son was so cold he burst out crying. My wife and I pictured opening the door to a dusty, cold and empty home, and felt a chill in our hearts. But when we reached the building and looked up, we found the lights on in our apartment. We went upstairs, and to our surprise the door was opened by my smiling parents, and warmth hit us at once: the rooms were spotless, the heating was on, the water was already warm, the quilts on the bedroom bed were laid out, and wafts of delicious cooking drifted from the kitchen.

column1: 父亲说：“你妈昨天接到电话，知道你们今晚回来，今天来新房忙了一天了。”原来父母要我留下串钥匙，只是为了让我们回来时，能立刻感受到家的温暖！我鼻子一酸，流下了热泪……
column2: Fùqīn shuō: "Nǐ mā zuótiān jiēdào diànhuà, zhīdào nǐmen jīnwǎn huílai, jīntiān lái xīnfáng máng le yì tiān le." Yuánlái fùmǔ yào wǒ liúxià chuàn yàoshi, zhǐshì wèile ràng wǒmen huílai shí, néng lìkè gǎnshòu dào jiā de wēnnuǎn! Wǒ bízi yì suān, liúxià le rèlèi……
column3: My father said, "Your mom got the call yesterday and knew you were coming back tonight, so she's been at the new place busy all day." So my parents had asked me to leave them a set of keys only so that when we came back, we could feel the warmth of home right away! My nose stung, and warm tears ran down my face......

column1: 翟峰和妻子都是铁路工人，工作稳定，待遇不错。他们有房有车，从不用为生活发愁。可翟峰却不想一辈子过这样平静的生活。通过电视，翟峰迷上了帆船，他觉得帆船能带他撞开“世界之门”：只要有一艘船，就能航行在无边无际的海上，到任何自己想去的地方。
column2: Zhái Fēng hé qīzi dōu shì tiělù gōngrén, gōngzuò wěndìng, dàiyù búcuò. Tāmen yǒu fáng yǒu chē, cóng búyòng wèi shēnghuó fāchóu. Kě Zhái Fēng què bù xiǎng yíbèizi guò zhèyàng píngjìng de shēnghuó. Tōngguò diànshì, Zhái Fēng míshang le fānchuán, tā juéde fānchuán néng dài tā zhuàngkāi "shìjiè zhī mén": zhǐyào yǒu yì sōu chuán, jiù néng hángxíng zài wúbiān wújì de hǎi shang, dào rènhé zìjǐ xiǎng qù de dìfang.
column3: Zhai Feng and his wife were both railway workers, with stable jobs and good pay. They had a home and a car and never had to worry about making a living. But Zhai Feng didn't want to live such a quiet life forever. Through TV he became fascinated with sailboats; he felt a sailboat could carry him through the "door to the world": with just a boat, he could sail the boundless sea and go anywhere he wanted.

column1: 由于翟峰和妻子没有积蓄，于是卖房卖车，买下了一艘二手船，翟峰叫它“彩虹号”。出发前，翟峰自学了航海知识。然而，包括翟峰的父母，所有人都觉得，翟峰“疯了”。
column2: Yóuyú Zhái Fēng hé qīzi méiyǒu jīxù, yúshì mài fáng mài chē, mǎixià le yì sōu èrshǒu chuán, Zhái Fēng jiào tā "Cǎihóng Hào". Chūfā qián, Zhái Fēng zìxué le hánghǎi zhīshi. Rán'ér, bāokuò Zhái Fēng de fùmǔ, suǒyǒu rén dōu juéde, Zhái Fēng "fēng le".
column3: Since Zhai Feng and his wife had no savings, they sold their home and car and bought a second-hand boat, which Zhai Feng named the "Rainbow". Before setting off, he taught himself navigation. Yet everyone, including his own parents, thought he had "gone mad".

column1: 2012年11月24日，辞了职的翟峰和妻子带着休学的女儿，第一次驾驶帆船出海了。白天，翟峰和妻子轮流驾船。女儿在船上看书、学习、画画儿。下午海面平静时，翟峰会和妻子下海游泳或者钓鱼。该吃饭时，妻子会给全家人做一顿美味的海鲜。
column2: Èr líng yī èr nián shíyī yuè èrshísì rì, cí le zhí de Zhái Fēng hé qīzi dàizhe xiūxué de nǚ'ér, dì-yī cì jiàshǐ fānchuán chūhǎi le. Báitiān, Zhái Fēng hé qīzi lúnliú jià chuán. Nǚ'ér zài chuán shang kàn shū, xuéxí, huà huàr. Xiàwǔ hǎimiàn píngjìng shí, Zhái Fēng huì hé qīzi xià hǎi yóuyǒng huòzhě diàoyú. Gāi chīfàn shí, qīzi huì gěi quánjiā rén zuò yí dùn měiwèi de hǎixiān.
column3: On November 24, 2012, Zhai Feng and his wife, having quit their jobs, took their daughter, who had suspended her schooling, and sailed out to sea for the first time. During the day, Zhai Feng and his wife took turns steering the boat. Their daughter read, studied and drew pictures on board. In the afternoon, when the sea was calm, Zhai Feng and his wife would go swimming or fishing. At mealtimes, his wife would cook the whole family a delicious seafood meal.

column1: 傍晚是一家人最舒适的时候。干完活儿，一家人坐在一起，用电脑看看电影，或者聊聊天儿。这样的生活，是翟峰盼望已久的。以前陆地上的夜晚，他们在各自的房间，一家人没有更多的交流。
column2: Bàngwǎn shì yì jiā rén zuì shūshì de shíhou. Gàn wán huór, yì jiā rén zuò zài yìqǐ, yòng diànnǎo kànkan diànyǐng, huòzhě liáoliao tiānr. Zhèyàng de shēnghuó, shì Zhái Fēng pànwàng yǐ jiǔ de. Yǐqián lùdì shang de yèwǎn, tāmen zài gèzì de fángjiān, yì jiā rén méiyǒu gèng duō de jiāoliú.
column3: Evening was the family's most comfortable time. With the work done, they sat together, watched a movie on the computer or just chatted. This was the life Zhai Feng had long hoped for. In the past, on land, they spent their evenings in separate rooms and didn't talk much as a family.

column1: 中国有句老话：可上山，勿下海。美好的时刻过去后是一个个紧张的夜晚。一路上，翟峰一家经历了船身着火、漏水等大大小小十多次险情。他们最怕雷电交加的时刻，因为小船随时有可能被下一道闪电击到，一家三口只能紧紧拥抱在一起，希望闪电快快过去。
column2: Zhōngguó yǒu jù lǎohuà: Kě shàng shān, wù xià hǎi. Měihǎo de shíkè guòqu hòu shì yí gègè jǐnzhāng de yèwǎn. Yílù shang, Zhái Fēng yì jiā jīnglì le chuánshēn zháohuǒ, lòushuǐ děng dàdàxiǎoxiǎo shí duō cì xiǎnqíng. Tāmen zuì pà léidiàn jiāojiā de shíkè, yīnwèi xiǎo chuán suíshí yǒu kěnéng bèi xià yí dào shǎndiàn jīdào, yì jiā sān kǒu zhǐ néng jǐnjǐn yōngbào zài yìqǐ, xīwàng shǎndiàn kuàikuài guòqu.
column3: China has an old saying: go up the mountains if you must, but don't go out to sea. After the lovely moments came one tense night after another. Along the way, the Zhai family went through more than ten emergencies, big and small, such as the boat catching fire and springing leaks. What they feared most was thunderstorms, because the little boat could be struck by the next bolt of lightning at any moment; the three of them could only hold each other tight and hope the lightning would pass quickly.

column1: 在经历了八个月、航行了4000多海里之后，翟峰一家终于回到了家。
column2: Zài jīnglì le bā ge yuè, hángxíng le sìqiān duō hǎilǐ zhīhòu, Zhái Fēng yì jiā zhōngyú huídào le jiā.
column3: After eight months and more than 4,000 nautical miles, the Zhai family finally returned home.

column1: 翟峰相信，一切只是开始，航海就是他人生道路上一段长长的台阶，通向他想要的未来。“我和太太想要看看这个时代、这个世界到底是什么样子。人生有选择，一切可改变。”下一站，他们想去澳大利亚和新西兰。等待今年11月的北风南下之时，他们将再次出发。
column2: Zhái Fēng xiāngxìn, yíqiè zhǐshì kāishǐ, hánghǎi jiù shì tā rénshēng dàolù shang yí duàn chángcháng de táijiē, tōngxiàng tā xiǎng yào de wèilái. "Wǒ hé tàitai xiǎng yào kànkan zhège shídài, zhège shìjiè dàodǐ shì shénme yàngzi. Rénshēng yǒu xuǎnzé, yíqiè kě gǎibiàn." Xià yí zhàn, tāmen xiǎng qù Àodàlìyà hé Xīnxīlán. Děngdài jīnnián shíyī yuè de běifēng nánxià zhī shí, tāmen jiāng zàicì chūfā.
column3: Zhai Feng believes this is only the beginning: sailing is a long flight of steps on the road of his life, leading to the future he wants. "My wife and I want to see what this era and this world are really like. Life is full of choices, and everything can change." Next, they want to go to Australia and New Zealand. When the north wind blows south this November, they will set off again.

column1: 从前，大概在距今两千五百多年前的春秋时期，有一个人叫子路，他是孔子最年长的学生。流传至今的“百里背米”讲的就是他孝敬父母的故事。
column2: Cóngqián, dàgài zài jù jīn liǎngqiān wǔbǎi duō nián qián de Chūnqiū shíqī, yǒu yí ge rén jiào Zǐlù, tā shì Kǒngzǐ zuì niánzhǎng de xuésheng. Liúchuán zhìjīn de "bǎi lǐ bēi mǐ" jiǎng de jiù shì tā xiàojìng fùmǔ de gùshi.
column3: Long ago, in the Spring and Autumn period more than 2,500 years ago, there was a man named Zilu, Confucius's oldest student. The story "Carrying Rice a Hundred Li", which has been passed down to this day, tells of how he honored and served his parents.

column1: 子路的父母都是农民。由于连年的战争，家里生活非常困难。一天，子路从外面回来，听到父母在屋里说话：“活了大半辈子了，别说鱼肉，只要能饱饱地吃上一顿米饭，也就满足了！”子路听了，心里觉得十分惭愧。他暗下决心：“一定要让父母吃上米饭，不能再委屈他们了！”
column2: Zǐlù de fùmǔ dōu shì nóngmín. Yóuyú liánnián de zhànzhēng, jiāli shēnghuó fēicháng kùnnan. Yì tiān, Zǐlù cóng wàimiàn huílai, tīngdào fùmǔ zài wū li shuōhuà: "Huó le dà bànbèizi le, bié shuō yú ròu, zhǐyào néng bǎobǎo de chīshang yí dùn mǐfàn, yě jiù mǎnzú le!" Zǐlù tīng le, xīnli juéde shífēn cánkuì. Tā àn xià juéxīn: "Yídìng yào ràng fùmǔ chīshang mǐfàn, bù néng zài wěiqu tāmen le!"
column3: Zilu's parents were both farmers. Because of years of war, the family lived in great hardship. One day Zilu came home and heard his parents talking inside: "We've lived most of our lives; never mind fish or meat—if we could just have one full meal of rice, we'd be content!" Hearing this, Zilu felt deeply ashamed. He secretly resolved: "I must let my parents eat rice; I can't let them go without any longer!"

column1: 子路打听到百里之外有个有钱人，家里缺干活儿的人，决定去试一试。那家主人见他身体结实，就留下了他。子路干起活来十分勤奋，主人很喜欢这个小伙子。半年后，当子路要回家时，发现主人给的银子比他应该得到的多了许多，子路老老实实地告诉了主人。主人笑着说：“孩子，工钱没算错，你做事勤快，这是我给你加的奖金。”
column2: Zǐlù dǎting dào bǎi lǐ zhī wài yǒu ge yǒuqián rén, jiāli quē gàn huór de rén, juédìng qù shì yi shì. Nà jiā zhǔrén jiàn tā shēntǐ jiēshi, jiù liúxià le tā. Zǐlù gàn qi huó lai shífēn qínfèn, zhǔrén hěn xǐhuan zhège xiǎohuǒzi. Bàn nián hòu, dāng Zǐlù yào huí jiā shí, fāxiàn zhǔrén gěi de yínzi bǐ tā yīnggāi dédào de duō le xǔduō, Zǐlù lǎolǎoshíshí de gàosu le zhǔrén. Zhǔrén xiàozhe shuō: "Háizi, gōngqián méi suàncuò, nǐ zuòshì qínkuai, zhè shì wǒ gěi nǐ jiā de jiǎngjīn."
column3: Zilu heard that a rich man a hundred li away was short of workers, and decided to try his luck. The master of the house saw that he was sturdy and took him on. Zilu worked very hard, and the master grew fond of the young man. Half a year later, when Zilu was about to go home, he found that the master had given him much more silver than he was owed, and he honestly told the master so. The master smiled and said, "Son, the wages aren't miscounted. You work hard, so this is a bonus I've added for you."

column1: 谢过主人，子路高兴地上路了。路过镇上，他买了一袋米、一块肉、两条鱼，背在后背上。天气非常寒冷，雪地很滑，子路不小心滑了一下，背上的米袋差点儿被甩出去。他顶着大雪往前走，扶着米袋的双手冻得不行，就停下来暖暖，再继续赶路。终于到家了，见到父母，子路把给他们买的东西及剩下的工钱都交给了他们。一家人高高兴兴地生火做饭，饱饱地吃了顿团圆饭。
column2: Xièguo zhǔrén, Zǐlù gāoxìng de shànglù le. Lùguò zhèn shang, tā mǎi le yí dài mǐ, yí kuài ròu, liǎng tiáo yú, bēi zài hòubèi shang. Tiānqì fēicháng hánlěng, xuědì hěn huá, Zǐlù bù xiǎoxīn huá le yíxià, bèi shang de mǐdài chàdiǎnr bèi shuǎi chuqu. Tā dǐngzhe dàxuě wǎng qián zǒu, fúzhe mǐdài de shuāngshǒu dòng de bùxíng, jiù tíng xialai nuǎnnuan, zài jìxù gǎnlù. Zhōngyú dào jiā le, jiàndào fùmǔ, Zǐlù bǎ gěi tāmen mǎi de dōngxi jí shèngxià de gōngqián dōu jiāogěi le tāmen. Yì jiā rén gāogāoxìngxìng de shēnghuǒ zuòfàn, bǎobǎo de chī le dùn tuányuánfàn.
column3: Having thanked the master, Zilu happily set off. Passing through a town, he bought a bag of rice, a piece of meat and two fish, and carried them on his back. The weather was bitterly cold and the snowy ground was slippery; Zilu slipped once, and the rice bag on his back was nearly flung off. He pressed on through the heavy snow, and when his hands holding the rice bag grew unbearably cold, he stopped to warm them before hurrying on. At last he got home, and when he saw his parents, he handed over everything he had bought for them along with the rest of his wages. The family happily lit a fire, cooked, and ate their fill at a reunion dinner.

column1: 后来子路的父母去世了，他也南下到了楚国。楚国国君觉得他很有本领，是个人才，就留他做了官，并给他很优厚的待遇。但他并没有因为物质条件好而感到欢喜，反而常常诚恳地说：“多么希望父母能和我一起过好日子！我现在有了一点儿成就，可他们已经不在了，即使再想背米百里去孝敬双亲，也不可能了。”
column2: Hòulái Zǐlù de fùmǔ qùshì le, tā yě nánxià dào le Chǔguó. Chǔguó guójūn juéde tā hěn yǒu běnlǐng, shì ge réncái, jiù liú tā zuò le guān, bìng gěi tā hěn yōuhòu de dàiyù. Dàn tā bìng méiyǒu yīnwèi wùzhì tiáojiàn hǎo ér gǎndào huānxǐ, fǎn'ér chángcháng chéngkěn de shuō: "Duōme xīwàng fùmǔ néng hé wǒ yìqǐ guò hǎo rìzi! Wǒ xiànzài yǒu le yìdiǎnr chéngjiù, kě tāmen yǐjīng bú zài le, jíshǐ zài xiǎng bēi mǐ bǎi lǐ qù xiàojìng shuāngqīn, yě bù kěnéng le."
column3: Later, Zilu's parents died, and he went south to the State of Chu. The ruler of Chu thought him very capable, a real talent, so he kept him on as an official and treated him very generously. But Zilu took no joy in his comfortable material life; instead he would often say sincerely, "How I wish my parents could share this good life with me! Now I've achieved a little, but they are gone; even if I wanted to carry rice a hundred li to serve them again, it's no longer possible."

column1: 中国古代有句话叫“百善孝为先”，意思是说，孝顺父母是各种美德中占第一位的。子路为了让父母吃到较好的食物，不怕辛苦，这种做法确实值得我们学习。
column2: Zhōngguó gǔdài yǒu jù huà jiào "bǎi shàn xiào wéi xiān", yìsi shì shuō, xiàoshùn fùmǔ shì gè zhǒng měidé zhōng zhàn dì-yī wèi de. Zǐlù wèile ràng fùmǔ chīdào jiào hǎo de shíwù, bú pà xīnkǔ, zhè zhǒng zuòfǎ quèshí zhíde wǒmen xuéxí.
column3: Ancient China had a saying, "Of all virtues, filial piety comes first," meaning that being devoted to one's parents ranks first among all the virtues. Zilu didn't mind hardship so that his parents could eat better food, and that is truly something we should learn from.

column1: 济南的泉水，历史悠久，最早的文字记载可以推到3000多年前。许多文人都对它的声音、颜色、形状、味道进行过描写，留下了许多赞美泉水的诗文。而济南的老百姓住在泉边，喝着这甜美的泉水，自然对它充满感激之情，从而也产生了许多关于泉水的美丽传说。
column2: Jǐnán de quánshuǐ, lìshǐ yōujiǔ, zuì zǎo de wénzì jìzǎi kěyǐ tuīdào sānqiān duō nián qián. Xǔduō wénrén dōu duì tā de shēngyīn, yánsè, xíngzhuàng, wèidao jìnxíng guo miáoxiě, liúxià le xǔduō zànměi quánshuǐ de shīwén. Ér Jǐnán de lǎobǎixìng zhù zài quán biān, hēzhe zhè tiánměi de quánshuǐ, zìrán duì tā chōngmǎn gǎnjī zhī qíng, cóng'ér yě chǎnshēng le xǔduō guānyú quánshuǐ de měilì chuánshuō.
column3: Jinan's springs have a long history; the earliest written records go back more than 3,000 years. Many men of letters described their sound, color, shape and taste, leaving behind many poems and essays praising them. And the ordinary people of Jinan, living beside the springs and drinking their sweet water, naturally felt deep gratitude toward them, which gave rise to many beautiful legends about the springs.

column1: 相传很久以前，济南城里有个善良的青年，名叫鲍全，他学习医术，救了很多人。一次，他在路边救了一位晕倒的老人，并把老人接回家照顾。这老人其实是东海龙王的哥哥。通过老人的介绍，鲍全从龙王那儿求到了治病救人的白玉壶。为了不被坏人抢走，他把壶埋入地下藏了起来，于是就变成了今天有“天下第一泉”美名的趵突泉。
column2: Xiāngchuán hěn jiǔ yǐqián, Jǐnán chéng li yǒu ge shànliáng de qīngnián, míng jiào Bào Quán, tā xuéxí yīshù, jiù le hěn duō rén. Yí cì, tā zài lù biān jiù le yí wèi yūndǎo de lǎorén, bìng bǎ lǎorén jiē huí jiā zhàogù. Zhè lǎorén qíshí shì Dōnghǎi Lóngwáng de gēge. Tōngguò lǎorén de jièshào, Bào Quán cóng Lóngwáng nàr qiúdào le zhìbìng jiùrén de báiyù hú. Wèile bú bèi huàirén qiǎngzǒu, tā bǎ hú mái rù dìxià cáng le qilai, yúshì jiù biànchéng le jīntiān yǒu "tiānxià dì-yī quán" měimíng de Bàotū Quán.
column3: Legend has it that long ago there was a kind young man in Jinan named Bao Quan who studied medicine and saved many lives. Once he rescued an old man who had fainted by the roadside and took him home to care for him. The old man was in fact the elder brother of the Dragon King of the East Sea. Through the old man's introduction, Bao Quan obtained from the Dragon King a white jade pot that could cure illness and save lives. To keep it from being stolen by bad people, he buried the pot underground to hide it, and it became today's Baotu Spring, famed as "the finest spring under heaven".

column1: 如今的济南市区内，分布着大大小小七百多个天然泉，这在国内外城市中是极为少有的。有如此之多的泉，名字当然也少不了。济南泉水的优美，还可从那独特的名字上反映出来，如：以人名命名的舜泉，以动物命名的黑虎泉，以形状命名的珍珠泉，等等。
column2: Rújīn de Jǐnán shìqū nèi, fēnbùzhe dàdàxiǎoxiǎo qībǎi duō ge tiānrán quán, zhè zài guónèiwài chéngshì zhōng shì jíwéi shǎoyǒu de. Yǒu rúcǐ zhī duō de quán, míngzi dāngrán yě shǎo bu liǎo. Jǐnán quánshuǐ de yōuměi, hái kě cóng nà dútè de míngzi shang fǎnyìng chulai, rú: yǐ rénmíng mìngmíng de Shùn Quán, yǐ dòngwù mìngmíng de Hēihǔ Quán, yǐ xíngzhuàng mìngmíng de Zhēnzhū Quán, děngděng.
column3: Today, more than 700 natural springs, large and small, are scattered across Jinan's urban area, which is extremely rare among cities in China and abroad. With so many springs, there are of course plenty of names too. The beauty of Jinan's springs is also reflected in their distinctive names, for example Shun Spring, named after a person; Black Tiger Spring, named after an animal; and Pearl Spring, named after its shape.

column1: 说到这里，您也许要问，这么多、这么好的泉水是如何形成的呢？济南的泉水，来自于济南市以南的广大山区，这些山区的岩石是大约四亿年前形成的一层厚厚的石灰岩。在这种石灰岩地区，陆地表面的水很容易进入地下。山区的石灰岩层，以大约三十度的角度，由南向北倾斜，因此大量的地下水向济南运动。而济南市区的地下岩石变为了火成岩，地下水流到这里，碰到火成岩挡住了路，就积蓄起来，越积越多。它无处可流，就得另找出路。济南旧城一带，地势低，有的地方甚至低过了地下水的水面，地下水就冲出地表，形成了众多的泉水。这就是济南“泉城”美名得来的原因。
column2: Shuōdào zhèlǐ, nín yěxǔ yào wèn, zhème duō, zhème hǎo de quánshuǐ shì rúhé xíngchéng de ne? Jǐnán de quánshuǐ, láizì yú Jǐnán Shì yǐ nán de guǎngdà shānqū, zhèxiē shānqū de yánshí shì dàyuē sì yì nián qián xíngchéng de yì céng hòuhòu de shíhuīyán. Zài zhè zhǒng shíhuīyán dìqū, lùdì biǎomiàn de shuǐ hěn róngyì jìnrù dìxià. Shānqū de shíhuīyán céng, yǐ dàyuē sānshí dù de jiǎodù, yóu nán xiàng běi qīngxié, yīncǐ dàliàng de dìxiàshuǐ xiàng Jǐnán yùndòng. Ér Jǐnán shìqū de dìxià yánshí biànwéi le huǒchéngyán, dìxiàshuǐ liúdào zhèlǐ, pèngdào huǒchéngyán dǎngzhù le lù, jiù jīxù qilai, yuè jī yuè duō. Tā wú chù kě liú, jiù děi lìng zhǎo chūlù. Jǐnán jiùchéng yídài, dìshì dī, yǒude dìfang shènzhì dīguò le dìxiàshuǐ de shuǐmiàn, dìxiàshuǐ jiù chōngchū dìbiǎo, xíngchéng le zhòngduō de quánshuǐ. Zhè jiù shì Jǐnán "Quánchéng" měimíng délái de yuányīn.
column3: At this point you may ask: how did so many fine springs form? Jinan's spring water comes from the vast mountains south of the city, whose rock is a thick layer of limestone formed about 400 million years ago. In limestone areas like this, surface water easily seeps underground. The limestone layers in the mountains slope from south to north at an angle of about thirty degrees, so large amounts of groundwater move toward Jinan. Under Jinan's urban area, however, the rock changes to igneous rock; when the groundwater flows here, its way is blocked by the igneous rock, so it collects and builds up more and more. With nowhere to flow, it has to find another way out. Around Jinan's old city the ground is low, in some places even lower than the groundwater level, so the groundwater bursts out of the surface and forms numerous springs. This is how Jinan earned its fine name, "City of Springs".

column1: 在中国，每年的农历十二月最后一天，全家人会一起吃年夜饭，守岁。但是，人们为什么要把年三十叫作除夕呢？
column2: Zài Zhōngguó, měi nián de nónglì shí'èr yuè zuìhòu yì tiān, quánjiā rén huì yìqǐ chī niányèfàn, shǒusuì. Dànshì, rénmen wèishénme yào bǎ nián sānshí jiàozuò chúxī ne?
column3: In China, on the last day of the twelfth lunar month each year, the whole family eats New Year's Eve dinner together and stays up to see the new year in. But why do people call the 30th of the twelfth month Chuxi?

column1: 传说在很久以前，有个叫作“夕”的怪物，经常出来伤害百姓，百姓对其恨之入骨，但是又十分无奈。当时有个英雄叫作七郎，他英俊高大，力大无比。七郎还有一条狗，这条狗非常勇敢，无论咬住什么都不会松口。
column2: Chuánshuō zài hěn jiǔ yǐqián, yǒu ge jiàozuò "Xī" de guàiwu, jīngcháng chūlai shānghài bǎixìng, bǎixìng duì qí hèn zhī rù gǔ, dànshì yòu shífēn wúnài. Dāngshí yǒu ge yīngxióng jiàozuò Qīláng, tā yīngjùn gāodà, lì dà wúbǐ. Qīláng hái yǒu yì tiáo gǒu, zhè tiáo gǒu fēicháng yǒnggǎn, wúlùn yǎozhù shénme dōu bú huì sōngkǒu.
column3: Legend has it that long ago there was a monster called "Xi" that often came out to harm the people. The people hated it to the bone, yet were helpless against it. At that time there was a hero named Qilang, handsome, tall and incredibly strong. Qilang also had a dog that was very brave and would never let go of anything it bit.

column1: 一天，七郎从外边回来，看到邻居家女孩的外公坐在路边哭，于是上前询问，一问才知道，原来天真可爱的女孩被“夕”吃掉了。七郎暗暗下定决心一定要杀死“夕”，替百姓除掉这个制造灾害的东西。于是七郎带着他的狗出发了，他到处打听“夕”的消息，但是一直找不到它。
column2: Yì tiān, Qīláng cóng wàibian huílai, kàndào línjū jiā nǚhái de wàigōng zuò zài lù biān kū, yúshì shàngqián xúnwèn, yí wèn cái zhīdào, yuánlái tiānzhēn kě'ài de nǚhái bèi "Xī" chīdiào le. Qīláng àn'àn xiàdìng juéxīn yídìng yào shāsǐ "Xī", tì bǎixìng chúdiào zhège zhìzào zāihài de dōngxi. Yúshì Qīláng dàizhe tā de gǒu chūfā le, tā dàochù dǎting "Xī" de xiāoxi, dànshì yìzhí zhǎo bu dào tā.
column3: One day, Qilang came home and saw the grandfather of the neighbors' little girl sitting by the road crying. He went over to ask and learned that the innocent, lovely girl had been eaten by Xi. Qilang secretly made up his mind to kill Xi and rid the people of this bringer of disaster. So he set off with his dog and asked everywhere for news of Xi, but he never managed to find it.

column1: 这样过了差不多一年，这天正好是大年三十，七郎来到了一个热闹的城镇。这一年来，七郎虽然没有找到“夕”，但是了解到了很多关于“夕”的情况：它一般在太阳落山后出来害人，到天亮前又会逃得连影子都找不着了；此外，它还特别害怕声响。于是七郎告诉这里的百姓，“夕”说不定晚上要出来伤害大家，让大家今晚熬夜等着，一见到“夕”就赶紧敲打东西，大家一起把“夕”杀掉。
column2: Zhèyàng guò le chàbuduō yì nián, zhè tiān zhènghǎo shì dànián sānshí, Qīláng láidào le yí ge rènao de chéngzhèn. Zhè yì nián lái, Qīláng suīrán méiyǒu zhǎodào "Xī", dànshì liǎojiě dào le hěn duō guānyú "Xī" de qíngkuàng: tā yìbān zài tàiyáng luò shān hòu chūlai hài rén, dào tiānliàng qián yòu huì táo de lián yǐngzi dōu zhǎo bu zháo le; cǐwài, tā hái tèbié hàipà shēngxiǎng. Yúshì Qīláng gàosu zhèlǐ de bǎixìng, "Xī" shuōbudìng wǎnshang yào chūlai shānghài dàjiā, ràng dàjiā jīnwǎn áoyè děngzhe, yí jiàndào "Xī" jiù gǎnjǐn qiāodǎ dōngxi, dàjiā yìqǐ bǎ "Xī" shādiào.
column3: Nearly a year passed like this. On that day, which happened to be the 30th of the twelfth month, Qilang came to a bustling town. Although he hadn't found Xi that year, he had learned a lot about it: it usually came out to harm people after sunset and fled before dawn without a trace; besides, it was especially afraid of loud noises. So Qilang told the townspeople that Xi might come out that night to harm them, and asked everyone to stay up and wait; as soon as they saw Xi, they should bang on things right away, and all together they would kill it.

column1: 太阳很快落山了，到了晚上，“夕”果然出来了。它想吃一户人家的姑娘，被这家人发现了，于是他们立刻敲响了家中的锅和盆子，跟着整个镇子都响了起来。“夕”吓得什么似的，急忙往外逃。七郎的狗追上了“夕”，并死死地咬住了它。七郎跑上前去，一箭射死了“夕”。
column2: Tàiyáng hěn kuài luò shān le, dào le wǎnshang, "Xī" guǒrán chūlai le. Tā xiǎng chī yí hù rénjiā de gūniang, bèi zhè jiā rén fāxiàn le, yúshì tāmen lìkè qiāoxiǎng le jiā zhōng de guō hé pénzi, gēnzhe zhěnggè zhènzi dōu xiǎng le qilai. "Xī" xià de shénme shìde, jímáng wǎng wài táo. Qīláng de gǒu zhuīshang le "Xī", bìng sǐsǐ de yǎozhù le tā. Qīláng pǎoshàng qián qu, yí jiàn shèsǐ le "Xī".
column3: The sun soon set, and at night Xi did come out. It tried to eat a family's daughter but was spotted by the family, who immediately banged the pots and basins in their house, and then the whole town joined in the din. Xi was frightened out of its wits and rushed to flee. Qilang's dog caught up with Xi and bit down on it hard. Qilang ran up and killed Xi with a single arrow.

column1: 除掉“夕”以后，百姓纷纷对七郎表达谢意。由于这一天很有意义，于是人们就在每年的年三十这天晚上，仍然像那天一样整晚不睡觉，敲打出响声。就这样一代代传下来，形成了除夕夜守岁、放鞭炮的风俗。
column2: Chúdiào "Xī" yǐhòu, bǎixìng fēnfēn duì Qīláng biǎodá xièyì. Yóuyú zhè yì tiān hěn yǒu yìyì, yúshì rénmen jiù zài měi nián de nián sānshí zhè tiān wǎnshang, réngrán xiàng nà tiān yíyàng zhěng wǎn bú shuìjiào, qiāodǎ chū xiǎngshēng. Jiù zhèyàng yí dàidài chuán xialai, xíngchéng le chúxī yè shǒusuì, fàng biānpào de fēngsú.
column3: After Xi was gone, people one after another thanked Qilang. Because the day was so meaningful, every year on the night of the 30th of the twelfth month, people still stay up all night just like that night, banging out loud noises. Passed down from generation to generation, this became the custom of staying up and setting off firecrackers on Chuxi, New Year's Eve.

column1: 盲人摸象
column2: Mángrén mō xiàng
column3: The Blind Men and the Elephant

column1: 很久以前，有一个很有智慧的国王。一天，他让士兵们去找一头大象和一些出生时眼睛就瞎了的人回来。士兵们分别去不同地方寻找，把找到的大象和盲人带到他面前。国王叫盲人们去摸一摸大象，问他们：“你们觉得大象是什么样的呢？”摸到牙齿的盲人说：“我觉得像一个角。”“胡说！”摸到尾巴的盲人说，“它像一条绳子。”摸到大象身子的盲人说：“我觉得像一面又高又平的墙。”“不，你们都错了，应该是像一把扇子。”这个盲人摸到了大象的耳朵。
column2: Hěn jiǔ yǐqián, yǒu yí ge hěn yǒu zhìhuì de guówáng. Yì tiān, tā ràng shìbīngmen qù zhǎo yì tóu dàxiàng hé yìxiē chūshēng shí yǎnjing jiù xiā le de rén huílai. Shìbīngmen fēnbié qù bùtóng dìfang xúnzhǎo, bǎ zhǎodào de dàxiàng hé mángrén dàidào tā miànqián. Guówáng jiào mángrénmen qù mō yi mō dàxiàng, wèn tāmen: "Nǐmen juéde dàxiàng shì shénme yàng de ne?" Mōdào yáchǐ de mángrén shuō: "Wǒ juéde xiàng yí ge jiǎo." "Húshuō!" mōdào wěiba de mángrén shuō, "tā xiàng yì tiáo shéngzi." Mōdào dàxiàng shēnzi de mángrén shuō: "Wǒ juéde xiàng yí miàn yòu gāo yòu píng de qiáng." "Bù, nǐmen dōu cuò le, yīnggāi shì xiàng yì bǎ shànzi." Zhège mángrén mōdào le dàxiàng de ěrduo.
column3: Long ago there was a very wise king. One day he sent his soldiers to bring back an elephant and some people who had been blind from birth. The soldiers searched in different places and brought the elephant and the blind men before him. The king told the blind men to touch the elephant and asked them, "What do you think an elephant is like?" The blind man who touched the tusk said, "I think it's like a horn." "Nonsense!" said the blind man who touched the tail. "It's like a rope." The blind man who touched the elephant's body said, "I think it's like a tall, flat wall." "No, you're all wrong—it's like a fan." This blind man had touched the elephant's ear.

column1: 国王笑了起来：“你们每个人都只摸到了一点，就认为自己了解全部了吗？只有片面的认识是不能下结论的。”
column2: Guówáng xiào le qilai: "Nǐmen měi ge rén dōu zhǐ mōdào le yìdiǎn, jiù rènwéi zìjǐ liǎojiě quánbù le ma? Zhǐyǒu piànmiàn de rènshi shì bù néng xià jiélùn de."
column3: The king burst out laughing: "Each of you touched only a small part, yet you think you know the whole thing? You can't draw a conclusion from a one-sided understanding."

column1: 精诚所至，金石为开
column2: Jīngchéng suǒ zhì, jīnshí wéi kāi
column3: Where Sincerity Reaches, Even Metal and Stone Give Way

column1: 西汉时期有一位著名的将军叫李广，他善于骑马射箭，作战勇敢，被称为“飞将军”。一天傍晚，他正带着士兵们在山中打猎，忽然发现远处蹲着一只大老虎。士兵们都紧张地围了上来，想要保护他。李广摇摇头，表示不要紧。只见他从箭袋里取出一支箭，摆好姿势，全神贯注，用尽全力向老虎射去。
column2: Xī Hàn shíqī yǒu yí wèi zhùmíng de jiāngjūn jiào Lǐ Guǎng, tā shànyú qímǎ shèjiàn, zuòzhàn yǒnggǎn, bèi chēngwéi "Fēi Jiāngjūn". Yì tiān bàngwǎn, tā zhèng dàizhe shìbīngmen zài shān zhōng dǎliè, hūrán fāxiàn yuǎnchù dūnzhe yì zhī dà lǎohǔ. Shìbīngmen dōu jǐnzhāng de wéi le shanglai, xiǎng yào bǎohù tā. Lǐ Guǎng yáoyao tóu, biǎoshì bú yàojǐn. Zhǐ jiàn tā cóng jiàndài li qǔchū yì zhī jiàn, bǎihǎo zīshì, quánshén guànzhù, yòngjìn quánlì xiàng lǎohǔ shè qu.
column3: In the Western Han dynasty there was a famous general named Li Guang. He was skilled at riding and archery and fought bravely, and was called "the Flying General". One evening he was hunting in the mountains with his soldiers when he suddenly spotted a big tiger crouching in the distance. The soldiers nervously gathered around him to protect him. Li Guang shook his head to show there was no need. He took an arrow from his quiver, set his stance, focused completely, and shot at the tiger with all his might.

column1: 过了一会儿，老虎没什么反应，士兵们小心地走上前去，想确定它是不是死了。没想到仔细一看，被射中的竟不是老虎，而是一块形状很像老虎的大石头，而且一整支箭几乎全都射到石头中去了！大家都很吃惊，连李广自己都不相信他能有这么大的力气，于是他想再试试。可是，这次他连续换了几根箭，都没能再射进去，有的箭头碎了，有的箭杆断了，而大石头一点儿变化也没有。“哎，怎么会这样？”士兵奇怪地你看我，我看你。“唉！大概是我不够用心了吧！”李广也无奈地说。
column2: Guò le yíhuìr, lǎohǔ méi shénme fǎnyìng, shìbīngmen xiǎoxīn de zǒushàng qián qu, xiǎng quèdìng tā shì bu shì sǐ le. Méi xiǎngdào zǐxì yí kàn, bèi shèzhòng de jìng bú shì lǎohǔ, ér shì yí kuài xíngzhuàng hěn xiàng lǎohǔ de dà shítou, érqiě yì zhěng zhī jiàn jīhū quán dōu shèdào shítou zhōng qu le! Dàjiā dōu hěn chījīng, lián Lǐ Guǎng zìjǐ dōu bù xiāngxìn tā néng yǒu zhème dà de lìqi, yúshì tā xiǎng zài shìshi. Kěshì, zhè cì tā liánxù huàn le jǐ gēn jiàn, dōu méi néng zài shè jinqu, yǒude jiàntóu suì le, yǒude jiàngǎn duàn le, ér dà shítou yìdiǎnr biànhuà yě méiyǒu. "Āi, zěnme huì zhèyàng?" Shìbīng qíguài de nǐ kàn wǒ, wǒ kàn nǐ. "Ài! Dàgài shì wǒ bú gòu yòngxīn le ba!" Lǐ Guǎng yě wúnài de shuō.
column3: After a while the tiger still hadn't reacted, so the soldiers carefully walked up to see whether it was dead. To their surprise, on closer look, what had been hit wasn't a tiger at all but a big rock shaped very much like one, and the whole arrow had sunk almost completely into the stone! Everyone was astonished; even Li Guang himself couldn't believe he had such strength, so he wanted to try again. But this time, though he tried several arrows in a row, none went in again: some arrowheads shattered, some shafts snapped, and the big rock didn't change a bit. "Huh, how can this be?" The soldiers looked at one another in puzzlement. "Sigh! I suppose I just wasn't putting my whole heart into it!" Li Guang said helplessly.

column1: 人们对这件事情感到很不解，就去问当时最有影响力的学者扬雄。扬雄回答说：“如果诚心实意，即使像金属和石头那样硬的东西也会被打动。”“精诚所至，金石为开”这一成语也便由此流传下来。
column2: Rénmen duì zhè jiàn shìqing gǎndào hěn bùjiě, jiù qù wèn dāngshí zuì yǒu yǐngxiǎnglì de xuézhě Yáng Xióng. Yáng Xióng huídá shuō: "Rúguǒ chéngxīn shíyì, jíshǐ xiàng jīnshǔ hé shítou nàyàng yìng de dōngxi yě huì bèi dǎdòng." "Jīngchéng suǒ zhì, jīnshí wéi kāi" zhè yì chéngyǔ yě biàn yóucǐ liúchuán xialai.
column3: People were puzzled by this, so they went to ask Yang Xiong, the most influential scholar of the time. Yang Xiong replied, "If you are truly sincere, even things as hard as metal and stone can be moved." And so the idiom "Where sincerity reaches, even metal and stone give way" was handed down.

column1: 成语是汉语中很重要的一部分词汇。成语有固定的结构，不能随便更改；它的意义是整体性的，不是每个字意思的简单相加，而是综合起来表达一个完整的意思。
column2: Chéngyǔ shì Hànyǔ zhōng hěn zhòngyào de yí bùfen cíhuì. Chéngyǔ yǒu gùdìng de jiégòu, bù néng suíbiàn gēnggǎi; tā de yìyì shì zhěngtǐxìng de, bú shì měi ge zì yìsi de jiǎndān xiāngjiā, ér shì zōnghé qilai biǎodá yí ge wánzhěng de yìsi.
column3: Idioms (chengyu) are a very important part of Chinese vocabulary. An idiom has a fixed structure that can't be changed at will; its meaning is a whole, not simply the sum of the meanings of each character, but a combination that expresses one complete idea.

column1: 一般来说，成语的意义也是稳定的，很少发生变化，比如我们学过的“盲人摸象”和“精诚所至，金石为开”。但也有古今不同的，像我们今天要学习的“朝三暮四”。
column2: Yìbān lái shuō, chéngyǔ de yìyì yě shì wěndìng de, hěn shǎo fāshēng biànhuà, bǐrú wǒmen xué guo de "mángrén mō xiàng" hé "jīngchéng suǒ zhì, jīnshí wéi kāi". Dàn yě yǒu gǔ jīn bùtóng de, xiàng wǒmen jīntiān yào xuéxí de "zhāo sān mù sì".
column3: Generally speaking, an idiom's meaning is also stable and seldom changes, such as "the blind men and the elephant" and "where sincerity reaches, even metal and stone give way", which we've already learned. But some differ between ancient and modern times, like "three in the morning, four in the evening", which we'll learn today.

column1: 中国古代有一位哲学家，在他的书中讲了这样一个寓言故事：
