When deciding whether to choose Oxford, the whole family held a meeting. Her parents thought she should go, but Wenwen disagreed with them and insisted on going to the United States.

column1: 这一次妈妈让步了。她隐隐约约觉得：自己该完全放手了。没想到，正是妈妈的放手，让风筝越飞越高。
column2: Zhè yí cì māma ràngbù le. Tā yǐnyǐn yuēyuē juéde: zìjǐ gāi wánquán fàngshǒu le. Méi xiǎngdào, zhèng shì māma de fàngshǒu, ràng fēngzheng yuè fēi yuè gāo.
column3: This time her mother gave in. She vaguely felt that it was time to let go completely. Unexpectedly, it was precisely her mother letting go that allowed the kite to fly higher and higher.

column1: 几年后，文文在美国工作，妈妈去洛杉矶看她。在这个陌生的地方，妈妈感到她们好像交换了某种身份：自己倒像女儿，而文文倒像妈妈。她们建立了一种新的关系。
column2: Jǐ nián hòu, Wénwen zài Měiguó gōngzuò, māma qù Luòshānjī kàn tā. Zài zhège mòshēng de dìfang, māma gǎndào tāmen hǎoxiàng jiāohuàn le mǒu zhǒng shēnfèn: zìjǐ dào xiàng nǚ'ér, ér Wénwen dào xiàng māma. Tāmen jiànlì le yì zhǒng xīn de guānxi.
column3: A few years later, Wenwen was working in the United States, and her mother went to Los Angeles to visit her. In this unfamiliar place, her mother felt as if they had swapped roles: she was more like the daughter, and Wenwen more like the mother. They built a new kind of relationship.

column1: 最初，妈妈哪儿也不敢去，不能单独出门，不能与人沟通，什么都要靠女儿。后来文文工作忙，就给她地图、车钥匙、机票，鼓励她自己出去。从家门口的超市开始，妈妈越走越远，最后竟然独自把美国横穿了一遍。她说，是女儿的“放手”，让她走得更远。做妈妈的，这才算是真正明白了“放手”的重要。
column2: Zuìchū, māma nǎr yě bù gǎn qù, bù néng dāndú chūmén, bù néng yǔ rén gōutōng, shénme dōu yào kào nǚ'ér. Hòulái Wénwen gōngzuò máng, jiù gěi tā dìtú, chē yàoshi, jīpiào, gǔlì tā zìjǐ chūqu. Cóng jiā ménkǒu de chāoshì kāishǐ, māma yuè zǒu yuè yuǎn, zuìhòu jìngrán dúzì bǎ Měiguó héngchuān le yí biàn. Tā shuō, shì nǚ'ér de "fàngshǒu", ràng tā zǒu de gèng yuǎn. Zuò māma de, zhè cái suànshì zhēnzhèng míngbai le "fàngshǒu" de zhòngyào.
column3: At first, her mother didn't dare go anywhere: she couldn't go out alone or communicate with people, and she depended on her daughter for everything. Later, when Wenwen got busy at work, she gave her mother a map, car keys and plane tickets and encouraged her to go out on her own. Starting with the supermarket outside the front door, her mother went farther and farther, and in the end she actually crossed the whole United States by herself. She said it was her daughter's "letting go" that let her go farther. Only then did she, as a mother, truly understand the importance of "letting go."

column1: 2010年3月的一个夜晚，母女俩躺在夏威夷的沙滩上谈心。妈妈第一次为以前对女儿的“不放手”而道歉。文文沉默了很久，最后吻了妈妈一下，轻轻地说：“妈妈，我真的很喜欢现在的你。”妈妈忍不住流下了眼泪。她说：“幸亏那晚天色很暗。”
column2: Èr líng yī líng nián sān yuè de yí ge yèwǎn, mǔnǚ liǎ tǎng zài Xiàwēiyí de shātān shang tánxīn. Māma dì-yī cì wèi yǐqián duì nǚ'ér de "bú fàngshǒu" ér dàoqiàn. Wénwen chénmò le hěn jiǔ, zuìhòu wěn le māma yíxià, qīngqīng de shuō: "Māma, wǒ zhēn de hěn xǐhuan xiànzài de nǐ." Māma rěn bu zhù liúxià le yǎnlèi. Tā shuō: "Xìngkuī nà wǎn tiānsè hěn àn."
column3: One night in March 2010, mother and daughter lay on a beach in Hawaii having a heart-to-heart talk. For the first time, the mother apologized for "not letting go" of her daughter in the past. Wenwen was silent for a long time, then finally kissed her mother and said softly, "Mom, I really like who you are now." Her mother couldn't hold back her tears. She said, "Luckily it was very dark that night."

column1: 来云南支教一年多，郝琳硕老师自己也记不清有多少次家访了。刚到时，一位叫赵福根的男生引起了她的注意。他上课从不发言，很多课不及格，平时也几乎不和同学交往。
column2: Lái Yúnnán zhījiào yì nián duō, Hǎo Línshuò lǎoshī zìjǐ yě jì bu qīng yǒu duōshǎo cì jiāfǎng le. Gāng dào shí, yí wèi jiào Zhào Fúgēn de nánshēng yǐnqǐ le tā de zhùyì. Tā shàngkè cóng bù fāyán, hěn duō kè bù jígé, píngshí yě jīhū bù hé tóngxué jiāowǎng.
column3: In the more than a year since she came to Yunnan as a volunteer teacher, Hao Linshuo herself can't remember how many home visits she has made. When she first arrived, a boy named Zhao Fugen caught her attention. He never spoke up in class, failed many subjects, and hardly ever interacted with his classmates.

column1: 郝老师家访后得知，赵福根的父亲去世了，姐姐在外打工，他家里很穷，还得帮着妈妈做家务，是个体贴孝顺的孩子。“和他妈妈聊天才知道他很喜欢跳舞，”郝老师说，“我觉得这是个机会！”她鼓励福根在学校艺术节上表演，每周二带着他一起去找音乐老师排练。表演时，福根的蝴蝶舞得了舞蹈组的冠军，台下的同学们鼓起掌来，齐声地喊着“福根”的名字。
column2: Hǎo lǎoshī jiāfǎng hòu dézhī, Zhào Fúgēn de fùqīn qùshì le, jiějie zài wài dǎgōng, tā jiāli hěn qióng, hái děi bāngzhe māma zuò jiāwù, shì ge tǐtiē xiàoshùn de háizi. "Hé tā māma liáotiān cái zhīdào tā hěn xǐhuan tiàowǔ," Hǎo lǎoshī shuō, "wǒ juéde zhè shì ge jīhuì!" Tā gǔlì Fúgēn zài xuéxiào yìshùjié shang biǎoyǎn, měi zhōu'èr dàizhe tā yìqǐ qù zhǎo yīnyuè lǎoshī páiliàn. Biǎoyǎn shí, Fúgēn de húdiéwǔ dé le wǔdǎo zǔ de guànjūn, tái xià de tóngxuémen gǔ qi zhǎng lai, qíshēng de hǎnzhe "Fúgēn" de míngzi.
column3: After a home visit, Ms. Hao learned that Zhao Fugen's father had died and his older sister was working away from home. His family was very poor, and he also had to help his mother with housework—he was a caring, dutiful child. "Only after chatting with his mother did I learn that he loves dancing," Ms. Hao said. "I thought, this is an opportunity!" She encouraged Fugen to perform at the school arts festival and took him to rehearse with the music teacher every Tuesday. At the performance, Fugen's butterfly dance won first place in the dance category, and his classmates in the audience broke into applause, chanting "Fugen" in unison.

column1: 之后，赵福根学习用功了，成绩也逐渐进步。他写了一篇题目为《那天的舞蹈和掌声》的作文，得了全班最高分，他朗读了自己的作文：“郝老师来到我家，那是第一次有老师来。她非常温柔……我永远都忘不了那热烈的掌声和同学们送我的糖，甜甜的。我感觉在学校也有人爱我了，我开始有勇气……”
column2: Zhīhòu, Zhào Fúgēn xuéxí yònggōng le, chéngjì yě zhújiàn jìnbù. Tā xiě le yì piān tímù wéi "Nà Tiān de Wǔdǎo hé Zhǎngshēng" de zuòwén, dé le quán bān zuì gāo fēn, tā lǎngdú le zìjǐ de zuòwén: "Hǎo lǎoshī láidào wǒ jiā, nà shì dì-yī cì yǒu lǎoshī lái. Tā fēicháng wēnróu…… Wǒ yǒngyuǎn dōu wàng bu liǎo nà rèliè de zhǎngshēng hé tóngxuémen sòng wǒ de táng, tiántián de. Wǒ gǎnjué zài xuéxiào yě yǒu rén ài wǒ le, wǒ kāishǐ yǒu yǒngqì……"
column3: After that, Zhao Fugen began studying hard, and his grades gradually improved. He wrote a composition titled "The Dance and the Applause That Day," which got the highest score in the class, and he read it aloud: "Ms. Hao came to my home—it was the first time a teacher had ever come. She was very gentle... I will never forget that warm applause and the candy my classmates gave me, so sweet. I felt that at school, too, there were people who loved me, and I began to have courage..."

column1: 郝老师发现，山里的青壮年都出去闯世界，只有老人、孩子留守。“他们出去了还回来吗？大山以后谁来负责？”于是，郝老师组织了一个8周的研究型学习活动，主题是“让家乡的明天更美好”。她鼓励学生寻找村子的问题，通过了解历史地理情况、采访村里的老人、小组讨论等，最终提出解决方案。她和其他志愿者利用午休、周末等空闲时间给学生们指导和培训。
column2: Hǎo lǎoshī fāxiàn, shān li de qīngzhuàngnián dōu chūqu chuǎng shìjiè, zhǐyǒu lǎorén, háizi liúshǒu. "Tāmen chūqu le hái huílai ma? Dàshān yǐhòu shéi lái fùzé?" Yúshì, Hǎo lǎoshī zǔzhī le yí ge bā zhōu de yánjiūxíng xuéxí huódòng, zhǔtí shì "ràng jiāxiāng de míngtiān gèng měihǎo". Tā gǔlì xuésheng xúnzhǎo cūnzi de wèntí, tōngguò liǎojiě lìshǐ dìlǐ qíngkuàng, cǎifǎng cūn li de lǎorén, xiǎozǔ tǎolùn děng, zuìzhōng tíchū jiějué fāng'àn. Tā hé qítā zhìyuànzhě lìyòng wǔxiū, zhōumò děng kòngxián shíjiān gěi xuéshengmen zhǐdǎo hé péixùn.
column3: Ms. Hao noticed that the young and able-bodied people in the mountains had all gone out to seek their fortune, leaving only the elderly and children behind. "Once they've left, will they come back? Who will take care of the mountains in the future?" So she organized an eight-week research-based learning project with the theme "Making Our Hometown's Tomorrow Better." She encouraged the students to look for problems in their village and, by learning about its history and geography, interviewing the village elders and holding group discussions, finally propose solutions. She and other volunteers used their free time, such as lunch breaks and weekends, to guide and train the students.

column1: 学生们说：“以前，我们总认为建设家乡是大人的事，用不着我们操心。不过，现在我们明白了，建设家乡，人人有责，我们也要承担这个义务。这个任务很艰巨，我们要尽自己最大的力量。”
column2: Xuéshengmen shuō: "Yǐqián, wǒmen zǒng rènwéi jiànshè jiāxiāng shì dàren de shì, yòng bu zháo wǒmen cāoxīn. Búguò, xiànzài wǒmen míngbai le, jiànshè jiāxiāng, rénrén yǒu zé, wǒmen yě yào chéngdān zhège yìwù. Zhège rènwu hěn jiānjù, wǒmen yào jìn zìjǐ zuì dà de lìliang."
column3: The students said, "We used to think building up our hometown was the adults' business and nothing for us to worry about. But now we understand that building our hometown is everyone's responsibility, and we too must take on this duty. It's a tough task, and we'll do our very best."

column1: 郝琳硕觉得自己的收获远多于给孩子们的。“不管以后在哪儿，我都会继续用我的力量影响山里的孩子们，因为他们是国家的未来与希望。”
column2: Hǎo Línshuò juéde zìjǐ de shōuhuò yuǎn duō yú gěi háizimen de. "Bùguǎn yǐhòu zài nǎr, wǒ dōu huì jìxù yòng wǒ de lìliang yǐngxiǎng shān li de háizimen, yīnwèi tāmen shì guójiā de wèilái yǔ xīwàng."
column3: Hao Linshuo feels that she has gained far more than she has given the children. "Wherever I am in the future, I'll keep using my strength to influence the children in the mountains, because they are the country's future and hope."

column1: 有一位经验丰富的老船长，一次返航中，天气恶劣，他们的船遇到了可怕的巨大风浪。正当水手们慌张得不知如何是好时，老船长命令水手们立刻打开货舱，使劲儿朝里面放水。
column2: Yǒu yí wèi jīngyàn fēngfù de lǎo chuánzhǎng, yí cì fǎnháng zhōng, tiānqì èliè, tāmen de chuán yùdào le kěpà de jùdà fēnglàng. Zhèng dāng shuǐshǒumen huāngzhāng de bù zhī rúhé shì hǎo shí, lǎo chuánzhǎng mìnglìng shuǐshǒumen lìkè dǎkāi huòcāng, shǐjìnr cháo lǐmiàn fàng shuǐ.
column3: There was an old, very experienced sea captain. Once, on a voyage home, the weather turned terrible and their ship ran into frightening, huge winds and waves. Just as the sailors were so panicked they didn't know what to do, the old captain ordered them to open the cargo hold at once and pump water into it as hard as they could.

column1: “船长简直是疯了，这样做只会增加船的压力，船就会下沉得更快，这不是找死吗？”一个年轻的水手骂道。
column2: Chuánzhǎng jiǎnzhí shì fēng le, zhèyàng zuò zhǐ huì zēngjiā chuán de yālì, chuán jiù huì xiàchén de gèng kuài, zhè bú shì zhǎosǐ ma? Yí ge niánqīng de shuǐshǒu mà dào.
column3: The captain has simply gone mad! Doing this will only add to the pressure on the ship, and it'll sink even faster. Isn't this asking to die? a young sailor cursed.

column1: 看着船长严肃的表情，水手们还是照做了。随着货舱里的水位越升越高，船一点一点地下沉，狂风巨浪依然猛烈，对船的威胁却减小了，船也渐渐取得了平衡。
column2: Kànzhe chuánzhǎng yánsù de biǎoqíng, shuǐshǒumen háishi zhào zuò le. Suízhe huòcāng lǐ de shuǐwèi yuè shēng yuè gāo, chuán yìdiǎn yìdiǎn de xiàchén, kuángfēng jùlàng yīrán měngliè, duì chuán de wēixié què jiǎnxiǎo le, chuán yě jiànjiàn qǔdé le pínghéng.
column3: Seeing the captain's stern expression, the sailors did as they were told anyway. As the water level in the hold rose higher and higher, the ship sank little by little; the howling wind and huge waves were as fierce as ever, yet the threat to the ship grew smaller, and the ship gradually regained its balance.

column1: 船长望着松了一口气的水手们说：“几万吨的钢铁巨轮很少有被打翻的，被打翻的常常是根基很轻的小船。船在有一定重量的时候是最安全的，在空的时候则是最危险的。”
column2: Chuánzhǎng wàngzhe sōng le yì kǒu qì de shuǐshǒumen shuō: "Jǐ wàn dūn de gāngtiě jùlún hěn shǎo yǒu bèi dǎfān de, bèi dǎfān de chángcháng shì gēnjī hěn qīng de xiǎo chuán. Chuán zài yǒu yídìng zhòngliàng de shíhou shì zuì ānquán de, zài kōng de shíhou zé shì zuì wēixiǎn de."
column3: Looking at the sailors, who had breathed a sigh of relief, the captain said: "Giant steel ships of tens of thousands of tons are rarely capsized; the ones that capsize are usually small boats with a very light base. A ship is safest when it carries a certain weight, and most dangerous when it's empty."

column1: 另一个相似的故事发生在某一著名风景区，那里有一段被当地人称为“鬼谷”的最危险的路段，山路非常窄，两边是万丈深渊。每当导游们带队来这里游览时，一定要让游客们背点或者拿点什么东西。
column2: Lìng yí ge xiāngsì de gùshi fāshēng zài mǒu yī zhùmíng fēngjǐngqū, nàli yǒu yí duàn bèi dāngdì rén chēngwéi "Guǐgǔ" de zuì wēixiǎn de lùduàn, shānlù fēicháng zhǎi, liǎngbiān shì wànzhàng shēnyuān. Měi dāng dǎoyóumen dài duì lái zhèlǐ yóulǎn shí, yídìng yào ràng yóukèmen bēi diǎn huòzhě ná diǎn shénme dōngxi.
column3: Another similar story took place in a famous scenic area. There is a most dangerous stretch of road there that the locals call "Ghost Valley": the mountain path is very narrow, with bottomless chasms on both sides. Whenever tour guides lead a group here, they always make the tourists carry something on their backs or in their hands.

column1: “这么危险的地方，我不拿东西两腿都发抖，再负重前行，那不是更容易摔倒吗？”一位妇女不解地问。
column2: Zhème wēixiǎn de dìfang, wǒ bù ná dōngxi liǎng tuǐ dōu fādǒu, zài fùzhòng qiánxíng, nà bú shì gèng róngyì shuāidǎo ma? Yí wèi fùnǚ bùjiě de wèn.
column3: In such a dangerous place my legs are shaking even without carrying anything. If I go forward with a load on top of that, won't I be even more likely to fall? a woman asked, puzzled.

column1: 导游小姐解释道：“这里以前发生过好几起意外，都是迷路的游客在丝毫没有感觉到压力的情况下，一不小心滚下去的。当地人每天都从这条路上背着东西来来往往，却从来没人出事。假如你感觉到了有风险，谨慎地负重前行，反而会更安全。”
column2: Dǎoyóu xiǎojiě jiěshì dào: "Zhèlǐ yǐqián fāshēng guo hǎo jǐ qǐ yìwài, dōu shì mílù de yóukè zài sīháo méiyǒu gǎnjué dào yālì de qíngkuàng xià, yí bù xiǎoxīn gǔn xiaqu de. Dāngdì rén měi tiān dōu cóng zhè tiáo lù shang bēizhe dōngxi láiláiwǎngwǎng, què cónglái méi rén chūshì. Jiǎrú nǐ gǎnjué dào le yǒu fēngxiǎn, jǐnshèn de fùzhòng qiánxíng, fǎn'ér huì gèng ānquán."
column3: The tour guide explained: "Quite a few accidents have happened here before. In every case it was tourists who had lost their way and, not feeling the slightest pressure, carelessly tumbled down. The locals come and go along this road every day carrying loads on their backs, yet no one has ever had an accident. If you sense the risk and move forward carefully with a load, you'll actually be safer."

column1: 这就是“压力效应”。那些胸怀理想、肩上有责任感的人，才能承受住压力，从历史的风雨中走过“鬼谷”；而那些没有理想，没有一点压力，做一天和尚撞一天钟的人，就像一艘风暴中的空船，往往一场人生的狂风巨浪便会把他们彻底地打翻在地。
column2: Zhè jiù shì "yālì xiàoyìng". Nàxiē xiōnghuái lǐxiǎng, jiān shang yǒu zérèngǎn de rén, cái néng chéngshòu zhù yālì, cóng lìshǐ de fēngyǔ zhōng zǒuguò "Guǐgǔ"; ér nàxiē méiyǒu lǐxiǎng, méiyǒu yìdiǎn yālì, zuò yì tiān héshang zhuàng yì tiān zhōng de rén, jiù xiàng yì sōu fēngbào zhōng de kōng chuán, wǎngwǎng yì chǎng rénshēng de kuángfēng jùlàng biàn huì bǎ tāmen chèdǐ de dǎfān zài dì.
column3: This is the "pressure effect." Only people who cherish ideals and carry a sense of responsibility on their shoulders can withstand pressure and walk through the "Ghost Valley" amid the storms of history; while those with no ideals and no pressure at all, who just go through the motions day by day, are like an empty boat in a storm—often a single violent storm in life is enough to knock them flat completely.

column1: 工作中的忙碌大概可以分为三种：第一种忙，忙得很被动，总是被事情追着、赶着，人几乎成了工作的奴隶；第二种忙，忙得很主动，忙而不乱，人是工作的主人；第三种忙，忙得有些虚伪，因为在他们的思想中，已经把忙与成功、闲与失败联系到一起，所以，这样的人总是想办法让自己忙。
column2: Gōngzuò zhōng de mánglù dàgài kěyǐ fēnwéi sān zhǒng: dì-yī zhǒng máng, máng de hěn bèidòng, zǒngshì bèi shìqing zhuīzhe, gǎnzhe, rén jīhū chéng le gōngzuò de núlì; dì-èr zhǒng máng, máng de hěn zhǔdòng, máng ér bú luàn, rén shì gōngzuò de zhǔrén; dì-sān zhǒng máng, máng de yǒuxiē xūwěi, yīnwèi zài tāmen de sīxiǎng zhōng, yǐjīng bǎ máng yǔ chénggōng, xián yǔ shībài liánxì dào yìqǐ, suǒyǐ, zhèyàng de rén zǒngshì xiǎng bànfǎ ràng zìjǐ máng.
column3: Being busy at work can roughly be divided into three kinds. The first kind is passive busyness: you're always being chased and driven by tasks, and you've almost become a slave to your work. The second kind is active busyness: busy but not chaotic, you are the master of your work. The third kind is somewhat fake busyness: in these people's minds, being busy is already linked with success and being idle with failure, so they're always finding ways to keep themselves busy.

column1: 你属于哪种忙呢？
column2: Nǐ shǔyú nǎ zhǒng máng ne?
column3: Which kind of busy are you?

column1: 我有一个体会：现实中，我们不一定知道正确的道路是什么，但时时反省、总结，却可以使我们不会在错误的道路上走得太远。
column2: Wǒ yǒu yí ge tǐhuì: xiànshí zhōng, wǒmen bù yídìng zhīdào zhèngquè de dàolù shì shénme, dàn shíshí fǎnxǐng, zǒngjié, què kěyǐ shǐ wǒmen bú huì zài cuòwù de dàolù shang zǒu de tài yuǎn.
column3: Here's something I've learned from experience: in real life we don't necessarily know what the right path is, but constantly reflecting and taking stock can keep us from going too far down the wrong one.

column1: 据说，曾经有一位很有个性、极爱冒险的大导演到南美丛林拍有关古代印加文明的纪录片。他雇了20来个当地人为他带路和搬运行李。这批当地人个个都表现出色，尽管他们背着重重的行李，但他们的脚力过人，健步如飞。一连三天，他们都很顺利地实现了原定的计划。到了第四天，大导演一早醒来就催着大家上路。然而，当地人却拒绝行动。大导演非常着急，一来，耽误了时间，日程就得重新安排；二来，会因为费用增加而让投资人不高兴，至于这部影片的投资人，可是一位大人物，他可不敢得罪。经过沟通，大导演总算弄明白了，当地人自古就有一种习俗：在赶路时，用尽全力地向前冲，但每走上三天，便要休息一天。当大导演进一步询问原因时，当地人的回答令他受益终生。
column2: Jùshuō, céngjīng yǒu yí wèi hěn yǒu gèxìng, jí ài màoxiǎn de dà dǎoyǎn dào Nán Měi cónglín pāi yǒuguān gǔdài Yìnjiā wénmíng de jìlùpiàn. Tā gù le èrshí lái ge dāngdì rén wèi tā dàilù hé bānyùn xíngli. Zhè pī dāngdì rén gègè dōu biǎoxiàn chūsè, jǐnguǎn tāmen bēizhe zhòngzhòng de xíngli, dàn tāmen de jiǎolì guòrén, jiànbù rú fēi. Yìlián sān tiān, tāmen dōu hěn shùnlì de shíxiàn le yuándìng de jìhuà. Dào le dì-sì tiān, dà dǎoyǎn yìzǎo xǐnglái jiù cuīzhe dàjiā shànglù. Rán'ér, dāngdì rén què jùjué xíngdòng. Dà dǎoyǎn fēicháng zháojí, yī lái, dānwu le shíjiān, rìchéng jiù děi chóngxīn ānpái; èr lái, huì yīnwèi fèiyòng zēngjiā ér ràng tóuzīrén bù gāoxìng, zhìyú zhè bù yǐngpiàn de tóuzīrén, kě shì yí wèi dàrénwù, tā kě bù gǎn dézuì. Jīngguò gōutōng, dà dǎoyǎn zǒngsuàn nòng míngbai le, dāngdì rén zìgǔ jiù yǒu yì zhǒng xísú: zài gǎnlù shí, yòngjìn quánlì de xiàng qián chōng, dàn měi zǒu shang sān tiān, biàn yào xiūxi yì tiān. Dāng dà dǎoyǎn jìnyíbù xúnwèn yuányīn shí, dāngdì rén de huídá lìng tā shòuyì zhōngshēng.
column3: It is said that a famous director with a strong personality and a great love of adventure once went to the South American jungle to shoot a documentary about the ancient Inca civilization. He hired about twenty locals to guide him and carry the luggage. Every one of them performed excellently: although they carried heavy loads, their legs were extraordinarily strong and they walked as if flying. For three days in a row they carried out the original plan smoothly. On the fourth day, the director woke up early and urged everyone to set off. However, the locals refused to move. The director was very anxious: first, losing time meant the schedule would have to be rearranged; second, the extra costs would upset the investor—and the film's investor was a very important person whom he dared not offend. After talking it over, the director finally understood: the locals had a custom since ancient times—when traveling, they push forward with all their strength, but after every three days of walking they must rest for one day. When the director asked further about the reason, the locals' answer benefited him for the rest of his life.

column1: “那是为了让我们的灵魂，能够追得上我们赶了三天路的疲劳的身体。”
column2: Nà shì wèile ràng wǒmen de línghún, nénggòu zhuī de shàng wǒmen gǎn le sān tiān lù de píláo de shēntǐ.
column3: It's so that our souls can catch up with our tired bodies, which have been rushing along for three days.

column1: 多么富有哲理的话！在这个提倡和鼓励竞争的时代，我们常常只顾低头拉车，却少了抬头看路，少了思考、总结这一重要的步骤。
column2: Duōme fùyǒu zhélǐ de huà! Zài zhège tíchàng hé gǔlì jìngzhēng de shídài, wǒmen chángcháng zhǐ gù dītóu lā chē, què shǎo le táitóu kàn lù, shǎo le sīkǎo, zǒngjié zhè yí zhòngyào de bùzhòu.
column3: What philosophical words! In this age that promotes and encourages competition, we often just keep our heads down pulling the cart, but forget to look up at the road, and skip the important step of thinking and taking stock.

column1: 从20世纪80年代起，比尔·盖茨每年都要进行两次为期一周的“闭关”。在这一周的时间里，他会把自己关在一所房子里，包括家人在内的任何人他都一律不见，使自己完全不受日常工作的打扰。盖茨的这种令人寂寞难耐的“闭关”不只是一种休息方式，更是一种高效率的工作方式。
column2: Cóng èrshí shìjì bāshí niándài qǐ, Bǐ'ěr Gàicí měi nián dōu yào jìnxíng liǎng cì wéiqī yì zhōu de "bìguān". Zài zhè yì zhōu de shíjiān lǐ, tā huì bǎ zìjǐ guān zài yì suǒ fángzi lǐ, bāokuò jiārén zài nèi de rènhé rén tā dōu yílǜ bú jiàn, shǐ zìjǐ wánquán bú shòu rìcháng gōngzuò de dǎrǎo. Gàicí de zhè zhǒng lìng rén jìmò nánnài de "bìguān" bù zhǐ shì yì zhǒng xiūxi fāngshì, gèng shì yì zhǒng gāo xiàolǜ de gōngzuò fāngshì.
column3: Since the 1980s, Bill Gates has gone into "seclusion" twice a year for a week at a time. During that week he shuts himself up in a house and sees no one at all, family included, so that he is completely undisturbed by daily work. This unbearably lonely "seclusion" of Gates's is not just a way of resting; it's even more a highly efficient way of working.

column1: 忙碌的人们，请多给自己一点思考的时间吧。
column2: Mánglù de rénmen, qǐng duō gěi zìjǐ yìdiǎn sīkǎo de shíjiān ba.
column3: Busy people, please give yourselves a little more time to think.

column1: 我父亲是一位象棋教练。那一年，我大学放假回家，父亲要跟我下棋，我高兴地答应了。
column2: Wǒ fùqin shì yí wèi xiàngqí jiàoliàn. Nà yì nián, wǒ dàxué fàngjià huí jiā, fùqin yào gēn wǒ xià qí, wǒ gāoxìng de dāying le.
column3: My father is a Chinese chess coach. That year, when I came home from university on vacation, my father wanted to play chess with me, and I happily agreed.

column1: 父亲让我先走三步。不到三分钟，我的棋子损失大半，棋盘空空的，只剩下几个子了。没办法，眼睁睁看着父亲“将军”，我认输了。
column2: Fùqin ràng wǒ xiān zǒu sān bù. Bú dào sān fēnzhōng, wǒ de qízǐ sǔnshī dàbàn, qípán kōngkōng de, zhǐ shèngxià jǐ ge zǐ le. Méi bànfǎ, yǎnzhēngzhēng kànzhe fùqin "jiāngjūn", wǒ rènshū le.
column3: My father let me make three moves first. In less than three minutes I had lost most of my pieces; the board was empty, with only a few of my pieces left. There was nothing I could do but watch helplessly as my father said "check," and I admitted defeat.

column1: 我不服气，说：“这次运气不好，再来！”第二局又输了，“这次没发挥好，我们再来！”几局下来，基本上都是不到10分钟我就败下阵来。我有些灰心。父亲看看我说：“你初学棋，输是正常的。但是你要知道输在什么地方，要吸取教训。否则，你就再下上10年，也未必能赢。”
column2: Wǒ bù fúqì, shuō: "Zhè cì yùnqi bù hǎo, zài lái!" Dì-èr jú yòu shū le, "Zhè cì méi fāhuī hǎo, wǒmen zài lái!" Jǐ jú xiàlai, jīběn shang dōu shì bú dào shí fēnzhōng wǒ jiù bài xià zhèn lai. Wǒ yǒuxiē huīxīn. Fùqin kànkan wǒ shuō: "Nǐ chū xué qí, shū shì zhèngcháng de. Dànshì nǐ yào zhīdào shū zài shénme dìfang, yào xīqǔ jiàoxun. Fǒuzé, nǐ jiù zài xià shang shí nián, yě wèibì néng yíng."
column3: I wasn't willing to accept it and said, "I was unlucky this time. Again!" I lost the second game too: "I didn't play well this time. Let's go again!" After several games, I was basically always beaten in under ten minutes. I felt a bit discouraged. My father looked at me and said, "You've only just started learning chess, so losing is normal. But you need to know where you lost and learn from it. Otherwise, even if you play for another ten years, you may not be able to win."

column1: “我知道，我技术没你好，经验也不足。”
column2: Wǒ zhīdào, wǒ jìshù méi nǐ hǎo, jīngyàn yě bù zú.
column3: I know. My skill isn't as good as yours, and I don't have enough experience.

column1: “这只是次要因素，不是最重要的。”
column2: Zhè zhǐ shì cìyào yīnsù, bú shì zuì zhòngyào de.
column3: That's only a secondary factor, not the most important one.

column1: “那最重要的是什么？”我奇怪地问。
column2: Nà zuì zhòngyào de shì shénme? Wǒ qíguài de wèn.
column3: Then what's the most important thing? I asked, puzzled.

column1: “最重要的问题在于你心态不对。你不够珍惜你的棋子。”
column2: Zuì zhòngyào de wèntí zàiyú nǐ xīntài bú duì. Nǐ bú gòu zhēnxī nǐ de qízǐ.
column3: The most important problem is that your attitude is wrong. You don't value your pieces enough.

column1: “怎么不珍惜呀？我每走一步，都想半天。”我否认说。
column2: Zěnme bù zhēnxī ya? Wǒ měi zǒu yí bù, dōu xiǎng bàntiān. Wǒ fǒurèn shuō.
column3: How don't I value them? I think for ages before every move, I protested.

column1: “那是后来。开始你是这样吗？我仔细观察过，你三分之二的棋子是在前三分之一的时间失去的。这期间你好像很有把握，下棋时不假思索，拿起来就走，失去了也不觉得可惜。因为你觉得棋子很多，失一两个不算什么。后三分之二的时间，你又犯了相反的错误：对棋子过于珍惜，每走一步都过于谨慎，一个棋子也不想失，反而一个一个都失去了。”
column2: Nà shì hòulái. Kāishǐ nǐ shì zhèyàng ma? Wǒ zǐxì guānchá guo, nǐ sān fēn zhī èr de qízǐ shì zài qián sān fēn zhī yī de shíjiān shīqù de. Zhè qījiān nǐ hǎoxiàng hěn yǒu bǎwò, xià qí shí bùjiǎ sīsuǒ, ná qilai jiù zǒu, shīqù le yě bù juéde kěxī. Yīnwèi nǐ juéde qízǐ hěn duō, shī yì liǎng ge bú suàn shénme. Hòu sān fēn zhī èr de shíjiān, nǐ yòu fàn le xiāngfǎn de cuòwù: duì qízǐ guòyú zhēnxī, měi zǒu yí bù dōu guòyú jǐnshèn, yí ge qízǐ yě bù xiǎng shī, fǎn'ér yí ge yí ge dōu shīqù le.
column3: That was later. Were you like that at the start? I watched carefully: you lost two-thirds of your pieces in the first third of the game. During that time you seemed very sure of yourself—you moved without thinking, picking up a piece and playing it right away, and you didn't feel sorry when you lost one. Because you felt you had plenty of pieces, losing one or two didn't seem to matter. In the last two-thirds of the game you made the opposite mistake: you valued your pieces too much, were overly cautious with every move, didn't want to lose a single piece—and instead lost them one after another.

column2: Tā jiào Liú Chén, shì yí ge nián jǐn èrshísān suì de yīngjiè běnkē bìyèshēng, zài guò yí ge yuè jiù yào bìyè le. Miànduì bìng bú lèguān de jiùyè xíngshì, tā yālì hěn dà: "Shuō shíhuà, wǒ juéde zìjǐ shízài méi shénme yōushì."
column3: His name is Liu Chen, a graduating undergraduate only 23 years old, who will graduate in another month. Facing a job market that is far from optimistic, he is under a lot of pressure: "To be honest, I really don't think I have any advantages."

column1: 就在他为工作发愁时，机会来了。天津卫视的《非你莫属》节目组看了他的简历，接受了他的申请，他可以到节目现场去求职。来到现场，他发现，果然有一家公司有适合他的职位——旅游体验师。因为小学六年级的时候，他迷上了公交车，从此，就一直关注公交线路，北京市范围内所有的公交线路他都了如指掌。从上初中起，他就是同学们的出行顾问，无论谁想去哪里，他都能很快地回答出最方便的路线，提供给同学们参考。在他的成长过程中，公交就是他最好的伙伴。
column2: Jiù zài tā wèi gōngzuò fāchóu shí, jīhuì lái le. Tiānjīn Wèishì de "Fēi Nǐ Mò Shǔ" jiémù zǔ kàn le tā de jiǎnlì, jiēshòu le tā de shēnqǐng, tā kěyǐ dào jiémù xiànchǎng qù qiúzhí. Lái dào xiànchǎng, tā fāxiàn, guǒrán yǒu yì jiā gōngsī yǒu shìhé tā de zhíwèi—lǚyóu tǐyànshī. Yīnwèi xiǎoxué liù niánjí de shíhou, tā míshang le gōngjiāochē, cóngcǐ, jiù yìzhí guānzhù gōngjiāo xiànlù, Běijīng Shì fànwéi nèi suǒyǒu de gōngjiāo xiànlù tā dōu liǎorú zhǐzhǎng. Cóng shàng chūzhōng qǐ, tā jiù shì tóngxuémen de chūxíng gùwèn, wúlùn shéi xiǎng qù nǎli, tā dōu néng hěn kuài de huídá chū zuì fāngbiàn de lùxiàn, tígōng gěi tóngxuémen cānkǎo. Zài tā de chéngzhǎng guòchéng zhōng, gōngjiāo jiù shì tā zuì hǎo de huǒbàn.
column3: Just as he was worrying about finding a job, an opportunity came. The team behind Tianjin TV's show "Only You" read his résumé and accepted his application, so he could go to the show to look for a job. When he got there, he found that one company did indeed have a position that suited him—travel experience tester. Back in sixth grade he had become fascinated with buses, and from then on he had kept following bus routes; he knew every bus route in Beijing like the back of his hand. From junior high on, he was his classmates' travel adviser: wherever anyone wanted to go, he could quickly tell them the most convenient route for their reference. As he grew up, buses were his best companions.

column1: 节目制作时，电视台问他有什么才艺，他便说：“我是个公交迷，对北京市的公交、地铁线路都有一些研究。”主持人现场考他：“假设我要从国贸到鼓楼大街，该怎么乘车？”他反应得非常快，马上回答说：“在国贸坐1路车，到天安门东，换乘82路，就可以到达。”他的回答让台上的12位老板都兴奋了起来，他们开始陆续向他提问。他有问必答，不但准确无误地按顺序报了一大串公交车、地铁站的名字，而且还给一对情侣制订了北京休闲一日游的具体方案。
column2: Jiémù zhìzuò shí, diànshìtái wèn tā yǒu shénme cáiyì, tā biàn shuō: "Wǒ shì ge gōngjiāo mí, duì Běijīng Shì de gōngjiāo, dìtiě xiànlù dōu yǒu yìxiē yánjiū." Zhǔchírén xiànchǎng kǎo tā: "Jiǎshè wǒ yào cóng Guómào dào Gǔlóu Dàjiē, gāi zěnme chéng chē?" Tā fǎnyìng de fēicháng kuài, mǎshàng huídá shuō: "Zài Guómào zuò yī lù chē, dào Tiān'ānmén Dōng, huànchéng bāshí'èr lù, jiù kěyǐ dàodá." Tā de huídá ràng tái shang de shí'èr wèi lǎobǎn dōu xīngfèn le qilai, tāmen kāishǐ lùxù xiàng tā tíwèn. Tā yǒu wèn bì dá, búdàn zhǔnquè wúwù de àn shùnxù bào le yí dà chuàn gōngjiāochē, dìtiězhàn de míngzi, érqiě hái gěi yí duì qínglǚ zhìdìng le Běijīng xiūxián yí rì yóu de jùtǐ fāng'àn.
column3: When the show was being made, the TV station asked him what talents he had, and he said: "I'm a bus fan, and I've studied Beijing's bus and subway routes." The host tested him on the spot: "Suppose I want to go from Guomao to Gulou Street—how should I travel?" He reacted very quickly and immediately answered: "Take the No. 1 bus at Guomao to Tian'anmen East, then change to the No. 82, and you'll get there." His answer got all twelve bosses on stage excited, and one after another they began to ask him questions. He answered every question: not only did he accurately reel off, in order, a long string of bus stop and subway station names, he also drew up a detailed plan for a relaxing one-day tour of Beijing for a couple.

column1: 他对公交的这种专注显然为他的求职打开了大门。老总们向他发出了热情的邀请，给他非常好的职位和待遇，甚至要专门为他成立有关的部门，只为留住这个人才。最终，他选择了一家他感兴趣的单位。
column2: Tā duì gōngjiāo de zhè zhǒng zhuānzhù xiǎnrán wèi tā de qiúzhí dǎkāi le dàmén. The bosses warmly invited him, offering him excellent positions and pay, and some were even willing to set up a dedicated department just for him, simply to keep such a talent. In the end, he chose a company he was interested in.

column1: 主持人问这家公司的老总：“你给的工资是不是太高了？”这个老总回答：“专业的、执着的、优秀的人才是无价的，这样的人一定会有光明的前途。”是的，无论在哪个行业，最缺乏的永远都是专注的人。专注的人永远不缺机会！
column2: Zhǔchírén wèn zhè jiā gōngsī de lǎozǒng: "Nǐ gěi de gōngzī shì bu shì tài gāo le?" Indeed, whatever the industry, what's always in shortest supply is focused people. Focused people never lack opportunities!

column1: 建伟在大学的一座公寓楼里开了一家书店，顺便卖点儿文具、电池、小日用品等。一年多来，虽然每件商品的利润都并不高，但他诚信经营，薄利多销，使书店生意越来越红火，甚至成为了媒体的采访对象。这个大学里另外还有三家书店，由于受到了建伟书店的影响，这三家书店的经营空间越来越小，三家的营业额加起来还不如他一家高。建伟成了这里的“书店老大”。
column2: Jiànwěi zài dàxué de yí zuò gōngyùlóu lǐ kāi le yì jiā shūdiàn, shùnbiàn mài diǎnr wénjù, diànchí, xiǎo rìyòngpǐn děng. Yì nián duō lái, suīrán měi jiàn shāngpǐn de lìrùn dōu bìng bù gāo, dàn tā chéngxìn jīngyíng, bólì duō xiāo, shǐ shūdiàn shēngyi yuèláiyuè hónghuo, shènzhì chéngwéi le méitǐ de cǎifǎng duìxiàng. Zhège dàxué lǐ lìngwài hái yǒu sān jiā shūdiàn, yóuyú shòudào le Jiànwěi shūdiàn de yǐngxiǎng, zhè sān jiā shūdiàn de jīngyíng kōngjiān yuèláiyuè xiǎo, sān jiā de yíngyè'é jiā qilai hái bùrú tā yì jiā gāo. Jiànwěi chéng le zhèlǐ de "shūdiàn lǎodà".
column3: Jianwei opened a bookstore in a dormitory building at a university, also selling some stationery, batteries, small daily necessities and so on. Over the past year or so, although the profit on each item wasn't high, he ran the business honestly with small profits and high sales, so the store did better and better and even became a subject of media interviews. There were three other bookstores at this university; affected by Jianwei's store, their room to operate kept shrinking, and the three stores' combined revenue was still less than his alone. Jianwei became the "top bookstore" here.

column1: 这时，许多亲朋好友便建议他干脆把另三家书店挤垮，垄断这个市场。可建伟不但没有去挤垮对手，反而还经常帮助三家书店搞一些营销活动，对于一家快要倒闭的书店，他还主动热心地借给其资金，想办法让它继续经营下去。
column2: Zhè shí, xǔduō qīnpéng hǎoyǒu biàn jiànyì tā gāncuì bǎ lìng sān jiā shūdiàn jǐkuǎ, lǒngduàn zhège shìchǎng. Kě Jiànwěi búdàn méiyǒu qù jǐkuǎ duìshǒu, fǎn'ér hái jīngcháng bāngzhù sān jiā shūdiàn gǎo yìxiē yíngxiāo huódòng, duìyú yì jiā kuài yào dǎobì de shūdiàn, tā hái zhǔdòng rèxīn de jiè gěi qí zījīn, xiǎng bànfǎ ràng tā jìxù jīngyíng xiaqu.
column3: At this point, many friends and relatives suggested he simply squeeze the other three bookstores out of business and monopolize the market. But not only did Jianwei not try to crush his rivals, he often helped the three stores run marketing events, and for one store that was about to close down, he even took the initiative to lend it money and found ways to keep it in business.

column1: 建伟说，我是在保持这一地区图书市场的“生态平衡”。商业领域其实和自然界一样，自然界中的生物，适当有一些“敌人”，会促使它们生长得更好；同样的，对手并不会妨碍我的发展，反而会促进经营，让我获得更多利益。一个原因是这样能创造让客户有所比较和优中选优的购物环境，通过比较，学生们才知道我的书店服务好、品种优、价格合理。如果只有我一家书店了，学生们没有了比较，价格定得再低也会认为我的书价高，万一他们自己跑到其他图书市场去“货比三家”，那我的生意就完了。还有一个很重要的原因，就是维持这种书店饱和的“生态”，避免更多、更强的对手来“插足”。我把其他三家都挤垮了，不见得是件好事，因为别人一看这么大的地方只有我一家书店，新的书店可能就会出现，搞不好来一个比我更强的对手。所以，为了保持目前这种经营的“生态平衡”，我要继续把对手培养好。
column2: Jiànwěi shuō, wǒ shì zài bǎochí zhè yí dìqū túshū shìchǎng de "shēngtài pínghéng". Shāngyè lǐngyù qíshí hé zìránjiè yíyàng, zìránjiè zhōng de shēngwù, shìdàng yǒu yìxiē "dírén", huì cùshǐ tāmen shēngzhǎng de gèng hǎo; tóngyàng de, duìshǒu bìng bú huì fáng'ài wǒ de fāzhǎn, fǎn'ér huì cùjìn jīngyíng, ràng wǒ huòdé gèng duō lìyì. Yí ge yuányīn shì zhèyàng néng chuàngzào ràng kèhù yǒu suǒ bǐjiào hé yōu zhōng xuǎn yōu de gòuwù huánjìng, tōngguò bǐjiào, xuéshengmen cái zhīdào wǒ de shūdiàn fúwù hǎo, pǐnzhǒng yōu, jiàgé hélǐ. Rúguǒ zhǐ yǒu wǒ yì jiā shūdiàn le, xuéshengmen méiyǒu le bǐjiào, jiàgé dìng de zài dī yě huì rènwéi wǒ de shūjià gāo, wànyī tāmen zìjǐ pǎo dào qítā túshū shìchǎng qù "huò bǐ sān jiā", nà wǒ de shēngyi jiù wán le. Hái yǒu yí ge hěn zhòngyào de yuányīn, jiù shì wéichí zhè zhǒng shūdiàn bǎohé de "shēngtài", bìmiǎn gèng duō, gèng qiáng de duìshǒu lái "chāzú". Wǒ bǎ qítā sān jiā dōu jǐkuǎ le, bújiànde shì jiàn hǎoshì, yīnwèi biérén yí kàn zhème dà de dìfang zhǐ yǒu wǒ yì jiā shūdiàn, xīn de shūdiàn kěnéng jiù huì chūxiàn, gǎo bu hǎo lái yí ge bǐ wǒ gèng qiáng de duìshǒu. Suǒyǐ, wèile bǎochí mùqián zhè zhǒng jīngyíng de "shēngtài pínghéng", wǒ yào jìxù bǎ duìshǒu péiyǎng hǎo.
column3: Jianwei said he was maintaining the "ecological balance" of the book market in this area. Business is actually just like nature: living things that have a few "enemies" are pushed to grow better. In the same way, rivals don't hinder my growth; instead they boost business and bring me more profit. One reason is that this creates a shopping environment where customers can compare and pick the best of the best. Only by comparing do students realize that my store has good service, quality selection and reasonable prices. If mine were the only bookstore, students would have nothing to compare with, and however low I set my prices they'd still think my books were expensive. And if they went off to other book markets to "shop around," my business would be finished. Another very important reason is to maintain this saturated "ecosystem" of bookstores and keep more and stronger rivals from "butting in." If I squeezed out the other three, it wouldn't necessarily be a good thing, because as soon as others saw that such a big place had only my bookstore, new stores might appear, and I could end up with a rival even stronger than me. So, to keep the current "ecological balance" of the business, I'll go on nurturing my rivals.

column1: 西班牙人特别喜欢吃沙丁鱼。但沙丁鱼对离开大海后的环境极不适应，运输就成了问题。鱼上岸后，过不了多久就会死去。而死掉的沙丁鱼口感很差，作为商品销售，价格就会便宜很多。如果上岸时沙丁鱼还活着，鱼的卖价可以涨很多倍。
column2: Xībānyá rén tèbié xǐhuan chī shādīngyú. Dàn shādīngyú duì líkāi dàhǎi hòu de huánjìng jí bú shìyìng, yùnshū jiù chéng le wèntí. Yú shàng'àn hòu, guò bu liǎo duōjiǔ jiù huì sǐqù. Ér sǐdiào de shādīngyú kǒugǎn hěn chà, zuòwéi shāngpǐn xiāoshòu, jiàgé jiù huì piányi hěn duō. Rúguǒ shàng'àn shí shādīngyú hái huózhe, yú de màijià kěyǐ zhǎng hěn duō bèi.
column3: Spaniards especially love eating sardines. But sardines adapt very poorly to life out of the sea, so transporting them became a problem. Once brought ashore, the fish die before long. Dead sardines taste bad, and when sold as goods they fetch a much lower price. If the sardines are still alive when they come ashore, their selling price can rise many times over.

column1: 为了延长沙丁鱼的存活期，减少经济损失，渔民们想了很多办法，但情况仍然没有得到太大的改善。后来一位渔民无意中发现了一种巧妙而实用的方法：把几条沙丁鱼的天敌鲶鱼放进装鱼的设备中。因为鲶鱼是食肉鱼，无法和沙丁鱼和平共处，它会四处游动寻找小鱼吃，对沙丁鱼构成威胁。为了逃避天敌，沙丁鱼自然会不断地加速游动，从而保持了旺盛的生命力，存活的比例大大提高。
column2: Wèile yáncháng shādīngyú de cúnhuóqī, jiǎnshǎo jīngjì sǔnshī, yúmínmen xiǎng le hěn duō bànfǎ, dàn qíngkuàng réngrán méiyǒu dédào tài dà de gǎishàn. Hòulái yí wèi yúmín wúyì zhōng fāxiàn le yì zhǒng qiǎomiào ér shíyòng de fāngfǎ: bǎ jǐ tiáo shādīngyú de tiāndí niányú fàng jìn zhuāng yú de shèbèi zhōng. Yīnwèi niányú shì shíròu yú, wúfǎ hé shādīngyú hépíng gòngchǔ, tā huì sìchù yóudòng xúnzhǎo xiǎo yú chī, duì shādīngyú gòuchéng wēixié. Wèile táobì tiāndí, shādīngyú zìrán huì búduàn de jiāsù yóudòng, cóng'ér bǎochí le wàngshèng de shēngmìnglì, cúnhuó de bǐlì dàdà tígāo.
column3: To extend the sardines' survival time and reduce financial losses, fishermen tried many methods, but the situation still didn't improve much. Later, a fisherman accidentally discovered a clever and practical method: put a few catfish, the sardine's natural enemy, into the fish containers. Because catfish are carnivorous, they can't live peacefully with sardines; they swim around looking for small fish to eat, posing a threat to the sardines. To escape their natural enemy, the sardines naturally keep swimming faster, which keeps them full of vitality, and the survival rate rises greatly.

column1: 看到这里，你有什么感想和体会呢？其实，这在经济学上被称为“鲶鱼效应”。“鲶鱼效应”对于市场经济以及现代企业管理都有着重要的启发作用。这个概念的核心是：一个市场如果能采取一种措施，刺激企业活跃起来，就能使企业获得足够的活力，在市场中积极参与竞争而不至于落后，同时这样反过来又能促使市场更为高效。
column2: Kàn dào zhèlǐ, nǐ yǒu shénme gǎnxiǎng hé tǐhuì ne? Qíshí, zhè zài jīngjìxué shang bèi chēngwéi "niányú xiàoyìng". "Niányú xiàoyìng" duìyú shìchǎng jīngjì yǐjí xiàndài qǐyè guǎnlǐ dōu yǒuzhe zhòngyào de qǐfā zuòyòng. Zhège gàiniàn de héxīn shì: yí ge shìchǎng rúguǒ néng cǎiqǔ yì zhǒng cuòshī, cìjī qǐyè huóyuè qilai, jiù néng shǐ qǐyè huòdé zúgòu de huólì, zài shìchǎng zhōng jījí cānyù jìngzhēng ér bú zhìyú luòhòu, tóngshí zhèyàng fǎn guolai yòu néng cùshǐ shìchǎng gèng wéi gāoxiào.
column3: Having read this far, what thoughts and insights do you have? In fact, in economics this is called the "catfish effect." The "catfish effect" offers important inspiration for the market economy and modern business management. The core of the concept is: if a market can take some measure to stimulate companies into action, it can give them enough vitality to compete actively in the market without falling behind; at the same time, this in turn makes the market more efficient.

column1: 从本质上说，“鲶鱼效应”使得企业和员工产生一种危机感，其实就是一种压力效应。很多研究发现，适度的压力有利于我们保持良好的状态，更加有助于挖掘我们的潜力，从而提高个人的工作效率。比如运动员每到参加比赛，尤其是决赛时，一定要将自己调整到接近最佳状态，让自己感到适度的压力，如果他不紧张、没压力感，则不利于出成绩。因此，“鲶鱼效应”的确对挖掘员工潜力、提高企业活力具有积极的意义。
column2: Cóng běnzhì shang shuō, "niányú xiàoyìng" shǐde qǐyè hé yuángōng chǎnshēng yì zhǒng wēijīgǎn, qíshí jiù shì yì zhǒng yālì xiàoyìng. Hěn duō yánjiū fāxiàn, shìdù de yālì yǒulìyú wǒmen bǎochí liánghǎo de zhuàngtài, gèngjiā yǒuzhùyú wājué wǒmen de qiánlì, cóng'ér tígāo gèrén de gōngzuò xiàolǜ. Bǐrú yùndòngyuán měi dào cānjiā bǐsài, yóuqí shì juésài shí, yídìng yào jiāng zìjǐ tiáozhěng dào jiējìn zuì jiā zhuàngtài, ràng zìjǐ gǎndào shìdù de yālì, rúguǒ tā bù jǐnzhāng, méi yālìgǎn, zé bú lìyú chū chéngjì. Yīncǐ, "niányú xiàoyìng" díquè duì wājué yuángōng qiánlì, tígāo qǐyè huólì jùyǒu jījí de yìyì.
column3: In essence, the "catfish effect" gives companies and employees a sense of crisis; it's really a kind of pressure effect. Many studies have found that moderate pressure helps us stay in good shape and, even more, helps tap our potential, thereby raising our personal work efficiency. For example, whenever athletes compete, especially in a final, they must adjust themselves to near their best condition and let themselves feel a moderate amount of pressure; if an athlete isn't nervous and feels no pressure, it's harder to get good results. Therefore, the "catfish effect" really does have positive significance for tapping employees' potential and boosting a company's vitality.

column1: 一个朋友在报社当编辑。一天他去请假，他先问领导：“您今天心情好吗？”领导说：“怎么了？”朋友答：“嗯，如果您心情好，我就说件事；心情不好就改天再说。”领导有了兴趣，假，就这样轻易地请好了。
column2: Yí ge péngyou zài bàoshè dāng biānjí. Yì tiān tā qù qǐngjià, tā xiān wèn lǐngdǎo: "Nín jīntiān xīnqíng hǎo ma?" Lǐngdǎo shuō: "Zěnme le?" Péngyou dá: "Ǹg, rúguǒ nín xīnqíng hǎo, wǒ jiù shuō jiàn shì; xīnqíng bù hǎo jiù gǎitiān zài shuō." Lǐngdǎo yǒu le xìngqù, jià, jiù zhèyàng qīngyì de qǐng hǎo le.
column3: A friend of mine works as an editor at a newspaper. One day he went to ask for leave, and first asked his boss: "Are you in a good mood today?" The boss said: "Why?" My friend replied: "Well, if you're in a good mood, I'll bring something up; if not, I'll mention it another day." The boss got curious, and so the leave was granted just like that, easily.

column1: 不得不说，这位朋友很会利用“登门槛效应”来处理问题。
column2: Bùdébù shuō, zhè wèi péngyou hěn huì lìyòng "dēng ménkǎn xiàoyìng" lái chǔlǐ wèntí.
column3: I have to say, this friend is very good at using the "foot-in-the-door effect" to handle problems.

column1: 心理学家曾做过“登门槛技术”的现场实验。他们派人到两个社区，劝人们在屋前立一块“小心驾驶”的圆形标志。在第一个社区，研究人员直接向人们提出要求，结果很多人表示拒绝，接受率仅为17%。在第二个社区，研究人员把同样的事情分成两个步骤：先向大家出示一份赞成安全驾驶的请愿书，请求他们在上面签字；然后再提出立标志的要求。这次接受者竟然达到了55%。第一个步骤的签字是很容易的，几乎所有人都照做了，大家可能都没意识到，这个小小的“登门槛行为”对接下来的决定产生了重要影响。
column2: Xīnlǐxuéjiā céng zuò guo "dēng ménkǎn jìshù" de xiànchǎng shíyàn. Tāmen pài rén dào liǎng ge shèqū, quàn rénmen zài wū qián lì yí kuài "xiǎoxīn jiàshǐ" de yuánxíng biāozhì. Zài dì-yī ge shèqū, yánjiū rényuán zhíjiē xiàng rénmen tíchū yāoqiú, jiéguǒ hěn duō rén biǎoshì jùjué, jiēshòulǜ jǐn wéi bǎi fēn zhī shíqī. Zài dì-èr ge shèqū, yánjiū rényuán bǎ tóngyàng de shìqing fēnchéng liǎng ge bùzhòu: xiān xiàng dàjiā chūshì yí fèn zànchéng ānquán jiàshǐ de qǐngyuànshū, qǐngqiú tāmen zài shàngmiàn qiānzì; ránhòu zài tíchū lì biāozhì de yāoqiú. Zhè cì jiēshòuzhě jìngrán dádào le bǎi fēn zhī wǔshíwǔ. Dì-yī ge bùzhòu de qiānzì shì hěn róngyì de, jīhū suǒyǒu rén dōu zhào zuò le, dàjiā kěnéng dōu méi yìshí dào, zhège xiǎoxiǎo de "dēng ménkǎn xíngwéi" duì jiē xialai de juédìng chǎnshēng le zhòngyào yǐngxiǎng.
column3: Psychologists once did a field experiment on the "foot-in-the-door technique." They sent people to two neighborhoods to persuade residents to put up a round "Drive Carefully" sign in front of their houses. In the first neighborhood, the researchers made the request directly; many people refused, and the acceptance rate was only 17%. In the second neighborhood, the researchers split the same task into two steps: first they showed everyone a petition supporting safe driving and asked them to sign it; then they made the request to put up the sign. This time, the acceptance rate actually reached 55%. Signing in the first step was easy, and almost everyone did it; people probably didn't realize that this tiny "foot-in-the-door" act had an important influence on their next decision.

column1: 日常生活中也是这样。当你想要求某人做某件较大的事情，又担心对方不愿意做时，可以先向他或她提出做一件同类型的、比较容易的事。比如你想与一个女孩谈恋爱，如果一开始就迫切地提出要跟她约会，女孩可能会犹豫，甚至表现得很冷淡；如果你说“饭总是要吃的吧，一起吃饭吧”，她答应了，那接下来是去看电影还是泡酒吧都无所谓了。你想让同事帮你值班或写报告什么的，直接说八成儿会被拒绝，把事情模糊化，“能不能帮个小忙”，“不会占用你很多时间”，台阶一铺，事情就容易多了。
column2: Rìcháng shēnghuó zhōng yě shì zhèyàng. Dāng nǐ xiǎng yāoqiú mǒu rén zuò mǒu jiàn jiào dà de shìqing, yòu dānxīn duìfāng bú yuànyì zuò shí, kěyǐ xiān xiàng tā huò tā tíchū zuò yí jiàn tóng lèixíng de, bǐjiào róngyì de shì. Bǐrú nǐ xiǎng yǔ yí ge nǚhái tán liàn'ài, rúguǒ yì kāishǐ jiù pòqiè de tíchū yào gēn tā yuēhuì, nǚhái kěnéng huì yóuyù, shènzhì biǎoxiàn de hěn lěngdàn; rúguǒ nǐ shuō "fàn zǒngshì yào chī de ba, yìqǐ chī fàn ba", tā dāying le, nà jiē xialai shì qù kàn diànyǐng háishi pào jiǔbā dōu wúsuǒwèi le. Nǐ xiǎng ràng tóngshì bāng nǐ zhíbān huò xiě bàogào shénme de, zhíjiē shuō bāchéngr huì bèi jùjué, bǎ shìqing móhuhuà, "néng bu néng bāng ge xiǎo máng", "bú huì zhànyòng nǐ hěn duō shíjiān", táijiē yì pū, shìqing jiù róngyì duō le.
column3: It's the same in everyday life. When you want someone to do something fairly big but worry they won't be willing, you can first ask him or her to do something of the same kind that's easier. For example, if you want to date a girl and right from the start you eagerly ask her out, she may hesitate or even act very cold; but if you say "Everyone has to eat—let's have a meal together," and she agrees, then whether you go to a movie or hang out at a bar afterward doesn't really matter. If you want a colleague to cover your shift or write a report for you, asking directly will most likely get you turned down; make it vague instead—"Could you do me a small favor?" "It won't take much of your time"—and once you've laid down the steps, things get much easier.

column1: 你可能会说，这些小动作会让人觉得你很狡猾。但是不得不承认，有了这些小动作的帮助，别人的确更愿意接受你的请求。有时候，当你自认为了不起时，别人通常觉得你这人不过如此；可是当你放低身段时，会缩短与人的距离，别人并不会看不起你，反而会觉得你为人谦虚。实践证明，第二种人得到的总是比第一种人更多。
column2: Nǐ kěnéng huì shuō, zhèxiē xiǎo dòngzuò huì ràng rén juéde nǐ hěn jiǎohuá. Dànshì bùdébù chéngrèn, yǒu le zhèxiē xiǎo dòngzuò de bāngzhù, biérén díquè gèng yuànyì jiēshòu nǐ de qǐngqiú. Yǒu shíhou, dāng nǐ zì rènwéi liǎobuqǐ shí, biérén tōngcháng juéde nǐ zhè rén búguò rúcǐ; kěshì dāng nǐ fàngdī shēnduàn shí, huì suōduǎn yǔ rén de jùlí, biérén bìng bú huì kàn bu qǐ nǐ, fǎn'ér huì juéde nǐ wéirén qiānxū. Shíjiàn zhèngmíng, dì-èr zhǒng rén dédào de zǒngshì bǐ dì-yī zhǒng rén gèng duō.
column3: You might say these little tricks make people think you're sly. But you have to admit that with their help, others really are more willing to accept your requests. Sometimes, when you think highly of yourself, others usually feel you're nothing special; but when you lower yourself, you shorten the distance between you and others—people won't look down on you, but will instead think you're modest. Practice shows that the second kind of person always gains more than the first.

column1: 如果你觉得地球上的一点儿小污染没什么关系，那你可就大错特错了！环境污染会危害动物、植物以及人类自身。
column2: Rúguǒ nǐ juéde dìqiú shang de yìdiǎnr xiǎo wūrǎn méi shénme guānxi, nà nǐ kě jiù dàcuò tècuò le! Huánjìng wūrǎn huì wēihài dòngwù, zhíwù yǐjí rénlèi zìshēn.
column3: If you think a little pollution on Earth doesn't matter, you're dead wrong! Environmental pollution harms animals, plants and humans themselves.

column1: 有些生活在过去的动物，你今天再也看不到了，植物也面临着同样的危险。动植物的消失，部分原因是由于自然界的变化，比如洪水、地震等改变了它们生活的环境，但更大的原因则是人类对自然的破坏——有些地区的森林已经几乎被人砍光了，很多河流被污染，不再适合鱼类生存，有的地区原本是草原，如今已变为沙漠……从国际环保组织公布的数据可知，地球上一半以上的动植物正在消失，这是真实的情况，一点儿也不夸张。
column2: Yǒuxiē shēnghuó zài guòqù de dòngwù, nǐ jīntiān zài yě kàn bu dào le, zhíwù yě miànlínzhe tóngyàng de wēixiǎn. Dòngzhíwù de xiāoshī, bùfen yuányīn shì yóuyú zìránjiè de biànhuà, bǐrú hóngshuǐ, dìzhèn děng gǎibiàn le tāmen shēnghuó de huánjìng, dàn gèng dà de yuányīn zé shì rénlèi duì zìrán de pòhuài—yǒuxiē dìqū de sēnlín yǐjīng jīhū bèi rén kǎnguāng le, hěn duō héliú bèi wūrǎn, bú zài shìhé yúlèi shēngcún, yǒude dìqū yuánběn shì cǎoyuán, rújīn yǐ biànwéi shāmò…… Cóng guójì huánbǎo zǔzhī gōngbù de shùjù kě zhī, dìqiú shang yíbàn yǐshàng de dòngzhíwù zhèngzài xiāoshī, zhè shì zhēnshí de qíngkuàng, yìdiǎnr yě bù kuāzhāng.
column3: Some animals that lived in the past can no longer be seen today, and plants face the same danger. The disappearance of animals and plants is partly due to changes in nature—floods, earthquakes and so on have changed their habitats—but the bigger reason is human destruction of nature: in some regions the forests have been almost completely cut down, many rivers are polluted and no longer fit for fish to live in, and some areas that were once grassland have now turned into desert... Data published by international environmental organizations show that more than half of the Earth's animals and plants are disappearing. This is the real situation, not the least bit exaggerated.

column1: 人类自身也饱受污染的危害。有些地区地表水已污染，地下水又被过量使用，水资源短缺问题就连科学家们也不知道该如何解决，目前世界上有17%的人无法享用干净的饮用水，而每年死于与空气污染有关的病的人比死于车祸的还要多。这些数据确实令人不安。
column2: Rénlèi zìshēn yě bǎoshòu wūrǎn de wēihài. Yǒuxiē dìqū dìbiǎoshuǐ yǐ wūrǎn, dìxiàshuǐ yòu bèi guòliàng shǐyòng, shuǐ zīyuán duǎnquē wèntí jiù lián kēxuéjiāmen yě bù zhīdào gāi rúhé jiějué, mùqián shìjiè shang yǒu bǎi fēn zhī shíqī de rén wúfǎ xiǎngyòng gānjìng de yǐnyòngshuǐ, ér měi nián sǐ yú yǔ kōngqì wūrǎn yǒuguān de bìng de rén bǐ sǐ yú chēhuò de hái yào duō. Zhèxiē shùjù quèshí lìng rén bù'ān.
column3: Humans themselves also suffer greatly from pollution. In some regions the surface water is already polluted and the groundwater is overused; even scientists don't know how to solve the water shortage. At present, 17% of the world's people have no access to clean drinking water, and every year more people die of illnesses related to air pollution than die in car accidents. These figures are truly disturbing.

column1: 一部分环境污染是由工业农业生产活动造成的，例如，大型工厂生产过程中，有的会产生大量废水；有的要大量燃烧煤炭，从而产生大量废气和废物。还有一部分污染和我们的日常生活密切相关，汽车尾气就是其中之一。此外，垃圾也会对环境造成严重的损害。
column2: Yí bùfen huánjìng wūrǎn shì yóu gōngyè nóngyè shēngchǎn huódòng zàochéng de, lìrú, dàxíng gōngchǎng shēngchǎn guòchéng zhōng, yǒude huì chǎnshēng dàliàng fèishuǐ; yǒude yào dàliàng ránshāo méitàn, cóng'ér chǎnshēng dàliàng fèiqì hé fèiwù. Hái yǒu yí bùfen wūrǎn hé wǒmen de rìcháng shēnghuó mìqiè xiāngguān, qìchē wěiqì jiù shì qízhōng zhī yī. Cǐwài, lājī yě huì duì huánjìng zàochéng yánzhòng de sǔnhài.
column3: Part of environmental pollution is caused by industrial and agricultural production. For example, during production some large factories produce large amounts of wastewater; some burn large amounts of coal, producing large amounts of waste gas and waste. Another part of pollution is closely related to our daily lives, and car exhaust is one example. In addition, garbage can also do serious damage to the environment.

column1: 幸运的是，越来越多的人敏感地认识到了环境问题的严重，并自觉地投入到了保护地球的行动中。生产中，增加环保设施，减少污染物排放，调整能源消费结构，逐步向可再生能源转变；而在日常生活中，改变生活习惯，尽量减少生活垃圾，做到垃圾分类。同时，尽量多骑自行车，多选择公共交通，少使用私家车。这些为此付出努力的人们令人尊敬，取得的成绩也令人鼓舞。
column2: Xìngyùn de shì, yuèláiyuè duō de rén mǐngǎn de rènshi dào le huánjìng wèntí de yánzhòng, bìng zìjué de tóurù dào le bǎohù dìqiú de xíngdòng zhōng. Shēngchǎn zhōng, zēngjiā huánbǎo shèshī, jiǎnshǎo wūrǎnwù páifàng, tiáozhěng néngyuán xiāofèi jiégòu, zhúbù xiàng kě zàishēng néngyuán zhuǎnbiàn; ér zài rìcháng shēnghuó zhōng, gǎibiàn shēnghuó xíguàn, jǐnliàng jiǎnshǎo shēnghuó lājī, zuòdào lājī fēnlèi. Tóngshí, jǐnliàng duō qí zìxíngchē, duō xuǎnzé gōnggòng jiāotōng, shǎo shǐyòng sījiāchē. Zhèxiē wèicǐ fùchū nǔlì de rénmen lìng rén zūnjìng, qǔdé de chéngjì yě lìng rén gǔwǔ.
column3: Fortunately, more and more people have keenly recognized how serious environmental problems are and have voluntarily joined the effort to protect the Earth. In production: adding environmental facilities, reducing pollutant emissions, adjusting the structure of energy consumption, and gradually shifting to renewable energy. In daily life: changing habits, reducing household waste as much as possible, and sorting garbage. At the same time, cycling more, choosing public transport more often, and using private cars less. The people who put in effort for this deserve respect, and their achievements are encouraging.

column1: 我们只有一个地球，我们应该把它看作一个属于自己的大房间。房间脏了，消极的逃避和不符合实际的幻想都不能解决问题，为保持它的卫生每一个人都应付出行动，做出贡献。人类的命运由我们自己掌握，改变要靠我们自己。
column2: Wǒmen zhǐ yǒu yí ge dìqiú, wǒmen yīnggāi bǎ tā kànzuò yí ge shǔyú zìjǐ de dà fángjiān. Fángjiān zāng le, xiāojí de táobì hé bù fúhé shíjì de huànxiǎng dōu bù néng jiějué wèntí, wèi bǎochí tā de wèishēng měi yí ge rén dōu yīng fùchū xíngdòng, zuòchū gòngxiàn. Rénlèi de mìngyùn yóu wǒmen zìjǐ zhǎngwò, gǎibiàn yào kào wǒmen zìjǐ.
column3: We have only one Earth, and we should think of it as a big room that belongs to us. When the room gets dirty, neither passively running away nor unrealistic fantasies will solve the problem; to keep it clean, everyone should take action and contribute. Humanity's fate is in our own hands, and change depends on ourselves.

column1: 城市汽车的数量迅速增长，最初还被视为是社会发展、经济繁荣的体现。但很快人们就发现了问题。随着车流量的增加，道路变得格外拥挤，堵车在大城市中已经成了家常便饭。
column2: Chéngshì qìchē de shùliàng xùnsù zēngzhǎng, zuìchū hái bèi shìwéi shì shèhuì fāzhǎn, jīngjì fánróng de tǐxiàn. Dàn hěn kuài rénmen jiù fāxiàn le wèntí. Suízhe chēliúliàng de zēngjiā, dàolù biàn de géwài yōngjǐ, dǔchē zài dà chéngshì zhōng yǐjīng chéng le jiācháng biànfàn.
column3: The number of cars in cities grew rapidly, which at first was even seen as a sign of social development and economic prosperity. But people soon discovered the problems. As traffic volume increased, roads became extremely crowded, and traffic jams have become an everyday occurrence in big cities.

column1: 解决交通拥堵的问题就要减少单位面积道路内的汽车数量，新建或加宽道路被公认为最基本的方法。但事实证明这只是我们美好的主观愿望，道路扩建的速度远远跟不上车流量增加的速度，面积的增加并未使道路空出空间来，甚至还会无形之中鼓励更多的司机开车上路，使得市中心的道路更加拥挤。
column2: Jiějué jiāotōng yōngdǔ de wèntí jiù yào jiǎnshǎo dānwèi miànjī dàolù nèi de qìchē shùliàng, xīnjiàn huò jiākuān dàolù bèi gōngrèn wéi zuì jīběn de fāngfǎ. Dàn shìshí zhèngmíng zhè zhǐ shì wǒmen měihǎo de zhǔguān yuànwàng, dàolù kuòjiàn de sùdù yuǎnyuǎn gēn bu shàng chēliúliàng zēngjiā de sùdù, miànjī de zēngjiā bìng wèi shǐ dàolù kòng chu kōngjiān lai, shènzhì hái huì wúxíng zhī zhōng gǔlì gèng duō de sījī kāichē shànglù, shǐde shì zhōngxīn de dàolù gèngjiā yōngjǐ.
column3: To solve traffic congestion, you have to reduce the number of cars per unit of road area, and building new roads or widening existing ones is generally recognized as the most basic method. But facts have proved this is only our wishful thinking: road expansion can't come close to keeping up with the growth in traffic, and the extra area hasn't freed up space on the roads—it may even quietly encourage more drivers to take to the road, making downtown roads even more crowded.

column1: 那么，如何根治交通拥堵呢？这里我们不妨听听佩·詹森的故事。
column2: Nàme, rúhé gēnzhì jiāotōng yōngdǔ ne? Zhèlǐ wǒmen bùfáng tīngting Pèi Zhānsēn de gùshi.
column3: So how can traffic congestion be cured once and for all? Here we might as well listen to the story of Per Jensen.

column1: 詹森一到欧洲环境保护署交通部工作，就接到了研究如何解决城市拥堵问题的任务。于是，他开始展开调查，研究收集上来的数据，归纳问题特点，并虚心咨询了有关专家。
column2: Zhānsēn yí dào Ōuzhōu Huánjìng Bǎohù Shǔ Jiāotōng Bù gōngzuò, jiù jiēdào le yánjiū rúhé jiějué chéngshì yōngdǔ wèntí de rènwu. Yúshì, tā kāishǐ zhǎnkāi diàochá, yánjiū shōují shanglai de shùjù, guīnà wèntí tèdiǎn, bìng xūxīn zīxún le yǒuguān zhuānjiā.
column3: As soon as Jensen started working in the transport department of the European Environment Agency, he was given the task of studying how to solve urban congestion. So he launched an investigation, studied the data that was collected, summarized the features of the problem, and humbly consulted relevant experts.

column1: 九月中旬的一天早晨，詹森照常提前出门赶在高峰之前去交通部。他看到一个健身的人慢跑通过一个有过街天桥的路口时，为图省事没上天桥，而是横穿马路。结果，他被一辆车撞倒在地，虽然最后他只是受了点轻伤，而且有保险可以赔偿，但司机还是被吓得不轻。
column2: Jiǔ yuè zhōngxún de yì tiān zǎochen, Zhānsēn zhàocháng tíqián chūmén gǎn zài gāofēng zhīqián qù Jiāotōng Bù. Tā kàndào yí ge jiànshēn de rén mànpǎo tōngguò yí ge yǒu guòjiē tiānqiáo de lùkǒu shí, wèi tú shěngshì méi shàng tiānqiáo, ér shì héngchuān mǎlù. Jiéguǒ, tā bèi yí liàng chē zhuàngdǎo zài dì, suīrán zuìhòu tā zhǐshì shòu le diǎn qīngshāng, érqiě yǒu bǎoxiǎn kěyǐ péicháng, dàn sījī háishi bèi xià de bù qīng.
column3: One morning in mid-September, Jensen left home early as usual to get to the transport department before rush hour. He saw a man out jogging who, when passing an intersection with a pedestrian overpass, didn't bother to take the overpass to save effort and instead cut straight across the road. As a result, he was knocked to the ground by a car. Although in the end he was only slightly injured and had insurance to compensate him, the driver was badly shaken.

column1: 不过这件事倒是给了詹森启发：开车出行是为了省时省力，但如果情况相反呢？他决定要改变市民出行的观念，反其道而行之——让城市先堵起来，给司机制造麻烦，以堵治堵。
column2: Búguò zhè jiàn shì dàoshì gěi le Zhānsēn qǐfā: kāichē chūxíng shì wèile shěng shí shěng lì, dàn rúguǒ qíngkuàng xiāngfǎn ne? Tā juédìng yào gǎibiàn shìmín chūxíng de guānniàn, fǎn qí dào ér xíng zhī—ràng chéngshì xiān dǔ qilai, gěi sījī zhìzào máfan, yǐ dǔ zhì dǔ.
column3: But this incident actually inspired Jensen: people drive to save time and effort—but what if it were the other way around? He decided to change how residents think about getting around by doing the opposite: first make the city congested, create trouble for drivers, and fight congestion with congestion.

column1: 经过多次努力，政府批准了他提出的改革措施，比如，增设红绿灯，让车辆不得不走走停停；在主要十字路口取消地下通道，让行人从地下重返地面；在购物广场、商务大厦的附近不建停车场等。同时，大力发展公共交通。
column2: Jīngguò duō cì nǔlì, zhèngfǔ pīzhǔn le tā tíchū de gǎigé cuòshī, bǐrú, zēngshè hónglǜdēng, ràng chēliàng bùdébù zǒuzǒu tíngtíng; zài zhǔyào shízì lùkǒu qǔxiāo dìxià tōngdào, ràng xíngrén cóng dìxià chóng fǎn dìmiàn; zài gòuwù guǎngchǎng, shāngwù dàshà de fùjìn bú jiàn tíngchēchǎng děng. Tóngshí, dàlì fāzhǎn gōnggòng jiāotōng.
column3: After repeated efforts, the government approved the reform measures he proposed, such as adding traffic lights so vehicles have to stop and go; removing underground passages at major intersections so pedestrians return from underground to street level; and not building parking lots near shopping plazas and office buildings. At the same time, public transport was vigorously developed.

column1: 半年过去了，虽然市民们有些抱怨，但效果非常明显，自愿放弃开私家车出门的人越来越多。这也难怪，与其堵在路上浪费时间和汽油，污染环境，倒不如改乘公交出行。这样一来，道路拥堵大为缓解。
column2: Bàn nián guòqu le, suīrán shìmínmen yǒuxiē bàoyuàn, dàn xiàoguǒ fēicháng míngxiǎn, zìyuàn fàngqì kāi sījiāchē chūmén de rén yuèláiyuè duō. Zhè yě nánguài, yǔqí dǔ zài lù shang làngfèi shíjiān hé qìyóu, wūrǎn huánjìng, dào bùrú gǎi chéng gōngjiāo chūxíng. Zhèyàng yìlái, dàolù yōngdǔ dàwéi huǎnjiě.
column3: Six months later, although residents complained a bit, the results were very clear: more and more people voluntarily gave up driving their own cars. No wonder—rather than sitting in traffic wasting time and gas and polluting the environment, it's better to switch to public transport. As a result, road congestion was greatly eased.

column1: 城市本是为人而建，如今却被汽车占有，詹森的目标很明确，就是期待能够解放城市，使之更适合人类生活。
column2: Chéngshì běn shì wèi rén ér jiàn, rújīn què bèi qìchē zhànyǒu, Zhānsēn de mùbiāo hěn míngquè, jiù shì qīdài nénggòu jiěfàng chéngshì, shǐ zhī gèng shìhé rénlèi shēnghuó.
column3: Cities were originally built for people, but now they've been taken over by cars. Jensen's goal is very clear: he hopes to liberate the city and make it more suitable for human life.

column1: 大家都接触过鸟儿吧？那你知道鸟儿最重要的特征是什么吗？是有翅膀会飞？还是吃昆虫？
column2: Dàjiā dōu jiēchù guo niǎor ba? Nà nǐ zhīdào niǎor zuì zhòngyào de tèzhēng shì shénme ma? Shì yǒu chìbǎng huì fēi? Háishi chī kūnchóng?
column3: You've all come across birds, right? Then do you know what a bird's most important feature is? Having wings and being able to fly? Or eating insects?

column1: 作为一只鸟儿，不管是天空中飞的，陆地上走的，或者能入水的，都必须拥有羽毛。没错儿，区分鸟儿和其他动物的唯一特征就是羽毛，而不是会不会飞！羽毛的作用很多，既可以保暖，又可以保护皮肤；羽毛上的颜色和斑还能充当保护色；当然，更关键的是，羽毛有助于飞行；甚至还有一些鸟儿的部分羽毛有“触觉”。总之，在鸟儿的生活中，羽毛充当着十分重要的角色。所以，鸟儿非常爱惜羽毛，每天都会花很长时间来保养自己的“羽衣”。
column2: Zuòwéi yì zhī niǎor, bùguǎn shì tiānkōng zhōng fēi de, lùdì shang zǒu de, huòzhě néng rù shuǐ de, dōu bìxū yōngyǒu yǔmáo. Méi cuòr, qūfēn niǎor hé qítā dòngwù de wéiyī tèzhēng jiù shì yǔmáo, ér bú shì huì bu huì fēi! Yǔmáo de zuòyòng hěn duō, jì kěyǐ bǎonuǎn, yòu kěyǐ bǎohù pífū; yǔmáo shang de yánsè hé bān hái néng chōngdāng bǎohùsè; dāngrán, gèng guānjiàn de shì, yǔmáo yǒuzhùyú fēixíng; shènzhì hái yǒu yìxiē niǎor de bùfen yǔmáo yǒu "chùjué". Zǒngzhī, zài niǎor de shēnghuó zhōng, yǔmáo chōngdāngzhe shífēn zhòngyào de juésè. Suǒyǐ, niǎor fēicháng àixī yǔmáo, měi tiān dōu huì huā hěn cháng shíjiān lái bǎoyǎng zìjǐ de "yǔyī".
column3: To be a bird—whether it flies in the sky, walks on land or can go into water—it must have feathers. That's right: the only feature that distinguishes birds from other animals is feathers, not whether they can fly! Feathers have many functions: they keep birds warm and protect their skin; the colors and spots on them can serve as camouflage; of course, more crucially, feathers help with flight; some birds even have feathers that can "feel." In short, feathers play an extremely important role in a bird's life. So birds take great care of their feathers and spend a long time every day maintaining their "feather coats."

column1: 整理羽毛是保养的基本功，它们只要有时间，就会情不自禁地背过头去，反复地啄着羽毛，就像随身带了一把梳子梳头发一样，顺便上上油，让羽毛更光滑。另外，鸟儿在理毛的时候，还会抓出一点儿寄生虫。
column2: Zhěnglǐ yǔmáo shì bǎoyǎng de jīběngōng, tāmen zhǐyào yǒu shíjiān, jiù huì qíngbù zìjīn de bèi guo tóu qu, fǎnfù de zhuózhe yǔmáo, jiù xiàng suíshēn dài le yì bǎ shūzi shū tóufa yíyàng, shùnbiàn shàngshang yóu, ràng yǔmáo gèng guānghuá. Lìngwài, niǎor zài lǐ máo de shíhou, hái huì zhuā chū yìdiǎnr jìshēngchóng.
column3: Preening is the basic skill of feather care. Whenever they have time, birds can't help turning their heads back and pecking at their feathers over and over, just like carrying a comb around to comb their hair, oiling them along the way to make the feathers sleeker. Besides, while preening, birds also pick out a few parasites.

column1: 毫无疑问，洗澡也是保养的一大基本项目。不过，鸟儿洗澡用不着肥皂，而且不同种类的鸟儿选择的“澡堂”也不一样，概括来说，就是以方便为原则。比如，海鸟在岛屿上生活，就会选择海水；知更鸟喜欢路旁的浅水坑；寒带的鸟呢，因为江河池塘不好找，只好以雪代水；而老鹰的洗澡方式更是直接，它们会在雨中张开双翅痛快地迎接洗礼！沙浴也是一些鸟儿喜欢的保养方式。所谓沙浴，就是用沙子洗澡，它们之所以放弃了用水洗澡，在很大程度上和它们的生活环境有关，它们大多生活在沙漠等干燥的环境，爱在地面上活动。
column2: Háowú yíwèn, xǐzǎo yě shì bǎoyǎng de yí dà jīběn xiàngmù. Búguò, niǎor xǐzǎo yòng bu zháo féizào, érqiě bùtóng zhǒnglèi de niǎor xuǎnzé de "zǎotáng" yě bù yíyàng, gàikuò lái shuō, jiù shì yǐ fāngbiàn wéi yuánzé. Bǐrú, hǎiniǎo zài dǎoyǔ shang shēnghuó, jiù huì xuǎnzé hǎishuǐ; zhīgēngniǎo xǐhuan lù páng de qiǎn shuǐkēng; hándài de niǎo ne, yīnwèi jiāng hé chítáng bù hǎo zhǎo, zhǐhǎo yǐ xuě dài shuǐ; ér lǎoyīng de xǐzǎo fāngshì gèng shì zhíjiē, tāmen huì zài yǔ zhōng zhāngkāi shuāng chì tòngkuai de yíngjiē xǐlǐ! Shāyù yě shì yìxiē niǎor xǐhuan de bǎoyǎng fāngshì. Suǒwèi shāyù, jiù shì yòng shāzi xǐzǎo, tāmen zhīsuǒyǐ fàngqì le yòng shuǐ xǐzǎo, zài hěn dà chéngdù shang hé tāmen de shēnghuó huánjìng yǒuguān, tāmen dàduō shēnghuó zài shāmò děng gānzào de huánjìng, ài zài dìmiàn shang huódòng.
column3: Without a doubt, bathing is another major part of feather care. But birds don't need soap to bathe, and different kinds of birds choose different "bathhouses"; generally speaking, the principle is convenience. For example, seabirds living on islands choose seawater; robins like shallow puddles by the road; birds in cold regions, since rivers and ponds are hard to find, have to use snow instead of water; and eagles bathe even more directly—they spread their wings in the rain and joyfully welcome the shower! Dust bathing is also a way some birds like to care for themselves. A so-called sand bath means bathing with sand. The reason they've given up bathing in water has a lot to do with their environment: most of them live in dry places such as deserts and like to move about on the ground.

column1: 另外，睡眠是鸟儿们最佳的保养方式，虽然我们很少看到睡眠中的鸟儿，那是因为它们通常会寻找一处秘密的地方休息。大多数鸟儿1天大约睡8小时，有些鸟儿差不多要睡1天，而另一些鸟儿几乎一点儿觉也不用睡。
column2: Lìngwài, shuìmián shì niǎormen zuì jiā de bǎoyǎng fāngshì, suīrán wǒmen hěn shǎo kàndào shuìmián zhōng de niǎor, nà shì yīnwèi tāmen tōngcháng huì xúnzhǎo yí chù mìmì de dìfang xiūxi. Dàduōshù niǎor yì tiān dàyuē shuì bā xiǎoshí, yǒuxiē niǎor chàbuduō yào shuì yì tiān, ér lìng yìxiē niǎor jīhū yìdiǎnr jiào yě bú yòng shuì.
column3: In addition, sleep is the best way for birds to look after themselves. We rarely see sleeping birds because they usually find a secret place to rest. Most birds sleep about eight hours a day; some sleep almost the whole day, while others hardly need any sleep at all.

column1: 炎热的夏天，踢完一场球赛，每个队员都已经是汗如雨下。如果这个时候，能到大树下歇一歇，喝口凉开水，吃个冰激凌，放松放松肌肉，缓解一下疲劳，那一定是件美事，可以很快恢复活力。不过，你知道吗，我们之所以能在大树下享受这种湿润荫凉，也是因为大树在“出汗”呢！
column2: Yánrè de xiàtiān, tī wán yì chǎng qiúsài, měi ge duìyuán dōu yǐjīng shì hàn rú yǔ xià. Rúguǒ zhège shíhou, néng dào dà shù xià xiē yi xiē, hē kǒu liáng kāishuǐ, chī ge bīngjīlíng, fàngsōng fàngsōng jīròu, huǎnjiě yíxià píláo, nà yídìng shì jiàn měishì, kěyǐ hěn kuài huīfù huólì. Búguò, nǐ zhīdào ma, wǒmen zhīsuǒyǐ néng zài dà shù xià xiǎngshòu zhè zhǒng shīrùn yìnliáng, yě shì yīnwèi dà shù zài "chū hàn" ne!
column3: On a hot summer day, after a football match, every player is already dripping with sweat. If at that moment you could rest for a while under a big tree, drink some cool boiled water, eat an ice cream, relax your muscles and ease your tiredness, that would surely be a delight, and you'd quickly regain your energy. But did you know? The reason we can enjoy this moist, cool shade under a big tree is that the tree is "sweating" too!

column1: 人体要保持相对稳定的温度，一旦温度上升，大脑就会指挥我们的身体赶快出汗，这时所有汗腺开始工作，汗水就从毛孔里冒了出来。大树出的“汗”，通常是从叶片的气孔里冒出来的，不过，这种“出汗”可不是为了降低温度，而是为了运输养分。
column2: Réntǐ yào bǎochí xiāngduì wěndìng de wēndù, yídàn wēndù shàngshēng, dànǎo jiù huì zhǐhuī wǒmen de shēntǐ gǎnkuài chū hàn, zhè shí suǒyǒu hànxiàn kāishǐ gōngzuò, hànshuǐ jiù cóng máokǒng lǐ mào le chulai. Dà shù chū de "hàn", tōngcháng shì cóng yèpiàn de qìkǒng lǐ mào chulai de, búguò, zhè zhǒng "chū hàn" kě bú shì wèile jiàngdī wēndù, ér shì wèile yùnshū yǎngfèn.
column3: The human body needs to keep a relatively stable temperature. Once the temperature rises, the brain tells our body to sweat quickly; all the sweat glands start working, and sweat comes out of our pores. The "sweat" of a big tree usually comes out of the stomata on its leaves; however, this kind of "sweating" isn't for lowering the temperature, but for transporting nutrients.

column1: 我们都知道这样的常识——植物的根会吸收养分和水分，但是你有没有想过，植物是怎么控制这些成分，把它们运输到十几米甚至上百米的树梢的呢？
column2: Wǒmen dōu zhīdào zhèyàng de chángshí—zhíwù de gēn huì xīshōu yǎngfèn hé shuǐfèn, dànshì nǐ yǒu méiyǒu xiǎng guo, zhíwù shì zěnme kòngzhì zhèxiē chéngfèn, bǎ tāmen yùnshū dào shí jǐ mǐ shènzhì shàng bǎi mǐ de shùshāo de ne?
column3: We all know this common fact: plant roots absorb nutrients and water. But have you ever wondered how plants control these substances and transport them to treetops a dozen or more meters, or even a hundred meters, high?

column1: 最初人们认为大树是通过毛细作用来提水的。所谓“毛细作用”，简单来说，就是水会顺着很细很细的管子向上“爬”，我们在家可以用一个比较细的玻璃管体验一下。玻璃管越细，水爬升的高度就越高。可是，经过测验计算发现，以大树输送管道的尺寸产生的毛细作用，根本无法把水分送到几十米高的地方。
column2: Zuìchū rénmen rènwéi dà shù shì tōngguò máoxì zuòyòng lái tí shuǐ de. Suǒwèi "máoxì zuòyòng", jiǎndān lái shuō, jiù shì shuǐ huì shùnzhe hěn xì hěn xì de guǎnzi xiàng shàng "pá", wǒmen zài jiā kěyǐ yòng yí ge bǐjiào xì de bōliguǎn tǐyàn yíxià. Bōliguǎn yuè xì, shuǐ páshēng de gāodù jiù yuè gāo. Kěshì, jīngguò cèyàn jìsuàn fāxiàn, yǐ dà shù shūsòng guǎndào de chǐcùn chǎnshēng de máoxì zuòyòng, gēnběn wúfǎ bǎ shuǐfèn sòng dào jǐshí mǐ gāo de dìfang.
column3: At first people thought big trees lifted water through capillary action. So-called "capillary action," simply put, means water "climbs" up along very, very thin tubes; we can try it at home with a fairly thin glass tube. The thinner the glass tube, the higher the water climbs. However, tests and calculations found that the capillary action produced by tubes the size of a tree's vessels simply can't send water dozens of meters high.

column1: 实际上，大树利用的是枝干顶端的那些叶片。叶子通过不停地向空气中释放水汽，迫使树干中的水分自动前来补充，这样节节传递，就像是把树根吸收的水分给抽了上来。因为跟蒸腾作用有关，这种特殊的提升力就被称为“蒸腾拉力”。不过，这个大树内部的供水系统具体的运转状况是怎么样的，它们遵守的是一种什么样的秩序，为什么会产生如此巨大的拉力，到目前还是个谜。
column2: Shíjì shang, dà shù lìyòng de shì zhīgàn dǐngduān de nàxiē yèpiàn. Yèzi tōngguò bù tíng de xiàng kōngqì zhōng shìfàng shuǐqì, pòshǐ shùgàn zhōng de shuǐfèn zìdòng qián lái bǔchōng, zhèyàng jiéjié chuándì, jiù xiàng shì bǎ shùgēn xīshōu de shuǐfèn gěi chōu le shanglai. Yīnwèi gēn zhēngténg zuòyòng yǒuguān, zhè zhǒng tèshū de tíshēnglì jiù bèi chēngwéi "zhēngténg lālì". Búguò, zhège dà shù nèibù de gōngshuǐ xìtǒng jùtǐ de yùnzhuǎn zhuàngkuàng shì zěnmeyàng de, tāmen zūnshǒu de shì yì zhǒng shénmeyàng de zhìxù, wèi shénme huì chǎnshēng rúcǐ jùdà de lālì, dào mùqián hái shì ge mí.
column3: In fact, what big trees use are the leaves at the tips of their branches. By constantly releasing water vapor into the air, the leaves force water in the trunk to move up automatically to replace it; passed on section by section like this, it's as if the water absorbed by the roots were being pumped up. Because it's related to transpiration, this special lifting force is called "transpiration pull." However, exactly how this water-supply system inside a big tree operates, what kind of order it follows, and why it can produce such an enormous pull are still a mystery.

column1: 作家老舍先生爱花，他养的花很多，满满摆了一院子。可除非是那些好种易活、自己会奋斗的花草，否则他是不养的。因为他知道北京的气候对养花来说，不算很好，想把南方的名花养活并非易事。
column2: Zuòjiā Lǎo Shě xiānsheng ài huā, tā yǎng de huā hěn duō, mǎnmǎn bǎi le yí yuànzi. Kě chúfēi shì nàxiē hǎo zhòng yì huó, zìjǐ huì fèndòu de huācǎo, fǒuzé tā shì bù yǎng de. Yīnwèi tā zhīdào Běijīng de qìhòu duì yǎng huā lái shuō, bú suàn hěn hǎo, xiǎng bǎ nánfāng de mínghuā yǎnghuó bìngfēi yìshì.
column3: The writer Lao She loved flowers. He grew a great many, filling a whole courtyard. But unless they were flowers and plants that were easy to grow, survived easily and could fend for themselves, he wouldn't grow them. He knew Beijing's climate wasn't very good for growing flowers, and keeping famous southern flowers alive was no easy task.

column1: 老舍把养花当作一种生活乐趣。他不在乎花开得大小好坏，只要开花，他就高兴。每天老舍像好朋友似的照管着花草。工作的时候，经常写几十个字，就到院中去转转，瞧瞧这棵，看看那棵，有时拿起剪刀给它们剪剪枝，有时蹲下捡几块小石头放在花盆里做点儿装饰，然后回到屋中再写一会儿，然后再出去，就这样脑力和体力很好地结合，身心也得到放松。
column2: Lǎo Shě bǎ yǎng huā dàngzuò yì zhǒng shēnghuó lèqù. Tā bú zàihu huā kāi de dàxiǎo hǎohuài, zhǐyào kāihuā, tā jiù gāoxìng. Měi tiān Lǎo Shě xiàng hǎo péngyou shìde zhàoguǎnzhe huācǎo. Gōngzuò de shíhou, jīngcháng xiě jǐshí ge zì, jiù dào yuàn zhōng qù zhuànzhuan, qiáoqiao zhè kē, kànkan nà kē, yǒushí ná qi jiǎndāo gěi tāmen jiǎnjian zhī, yǒushí dūn xia jiǎn jǐ kuài xiǎo shítou fàng zài huāpén lǐ zuò diǎnr zhuāngshì, ránhòu huí dào wū zhōng zài xiě yíhuìr, ránhòu zài chūqu, jiù zhèyàng nǎolì hé tǐlì hěn hǎo de jiéhé, shēnxīn yě dédào fàngsōng.
column3: Lao She treated growing flowers as one of life's pleasures. He didn't care whether the blossoms were big or small, good or bad; as long as they bloomed, he was happy. Every day he looked after his plants like good friends. While working, he would often write a few dozen characters and then go out to stroll around the courtyard, looking at this plant and that one; sometimes he picked up scissors and trimmed their branches, sometimes he crouched down to pick up a few small stones and put them in the pots as decoration. Then he'd go back inside to write a while longer, then go out again. In this way mental and physical work were nicely combined, and both his body and mind got to relax.

column1: 写作是件艰苦的工作，养花也是如此。有时赶上狂风暴雨，情况紧急，他就得劳驾全家人抢救花草。几百盆花，要很快地抢到屋里去，累得腰酸腿疼，热汗直流。第二天，天气好了，又得一盆盆地搬出去。可是，他并不抱怨，在他看来，任何事都要有付出，不然怎么会有回报？这是生活的真理。
column2: Xiězuò shì jiàn jiānkǔ de gōngzuò, yǎng huā yě shì rúcǐ. Yǒushí gǎn shang kuángfēng bàoyǔ, qíngkuàng jǐnjí, tā jiù děi láojià quán jiā rén qiǎngjiù huācǎo. Jǐ bǎi pén huā, yào hěn kuài de qiǎng dào wū lǐ qù, lèi de yāo suān tuǐ téng, rè hàn zhí liú. Dì-èr tiān, tiānqì hǎo le, yòu děi yì pénpén de bān chuqu. Kěshì, tā bìng bú bàoyuàn, zài tā kànlái, rènhé shì dōu yào yǒu fùchū, bùrán zěnme huì yǒu huíbào? Zhè shì shēnghuó de zhēnlǐ.
column3: Writing is hard work, and so is growing flowers. Sometimes, when a violent storm hit and things were urgent, he had to ask the whole family to help rescue the plants. Several hundred pots had to be rushed indoors quickly, leaving them with aching backs and sore legs, dripping with sweat. The next day, when the weather cleared, they had to carry them back out pot by pot. But he didn't complain. In his view, everything requires effort—otherwise how could there be any reward? That's one of life's truths.

column1: 一来二去，他慢慢地总结出一些养花的经验：有的花喜干，就别多浇水；有的花喜欢潮湿的环境，就别放在太阳地里。给花换盆剪枝施肥的活儿他越做越熟练，花生病长虫他也知道如何应付了。看着院子里那鲜艳的花朵，老舍自豪地说：“不是乱吹，这就是知识啊！多得些知识，一定不是坏事。”
column2: Yì lái èr qù, tā mànmàn de zǒngjié chu yìxiē yǎng huā de jīngyàn: yǒude huā xǐ gān, jiù bié duō jiāo shuǐ; yǒude huā xǐhuan cháoshī de huánjìng, jiù bié fàng zài tàiyáng dì lǐ. Gěi huā huàn pén jiǎn zhī shī féi de huór tā yuè zuò yuè shúliàn, huā shēngbìng zhǎng chóng tā yě zhīdào rúhé yìngfu le. Kànzhe yuànzi lǐ nà xiānyàn de huāduǒ, Lǎo Shě zìháo de shuō: "Bú shì luàn chuī, zhè jiù shì zhīshi a! Duō dé xiē zhīshi, yídìng bú shì huàishì."
column3: Over time, he gradually built up some experience in growing flowers: some flowers like it dry, so don't water them too much; some like a damp environment, so don't put them in the sun. He grew more and more skilled at repotting, pruning and fertilizing, and he also learned how to deal with flowers getting sick or infested with insects. Looking at the bright flowers in the courtyard, Lao She said proudly: "I'm not just boasting—this is knowledge! Gaining more knowledge is certainly never a bad thing."

column1: 老舍很有爱心，更懂得快乐要分享。每到菊花开放的时候，他就约上几位朋友来家里赏花庆祝。花分根了，一棵分为几棵，他会毫无保留地送给朋友们。看着友人高兴地拿走自己的劳动果实，老舍心里十分欢喜。有一次，送牛奶的小伙子进门就夸“好香”，这让老舍先生感到格外高兴。
column2: Lǎo Shě hěn yǒu àixīn, gèng dǒngde kuàilè yào fēnxiǎng. Měi dào júhuā kāifàng de shíhou, tā jiù yuē shang jǐ wèi péngyou lái jiā lǐ shǎng huā qìngzhù. Huā fēn gēn le, yì kē fēnwéi jǐ kē, tā huì háowú bǎoliú de sòng gěi péngyoumen. Kànzhe yǒurén gāoxìng de ná zǒu zìjǐ de láodòng guǒshí, Lǎo Shě xīnli shífēn huānxǐ. Yǒu yí cì, sòng niúnǎi de xiǎohuǒzi jìn mén jiù kuā "hǎo xiāng", zhè ràng Lǎo Shě xiānsheng gǎndào géwài gāoxìng.
column3: Lao She was very kind-hearted and, even more, understood that happiness should be shared. Whenever the chrysanthemums bloomed, he would invite a few friends over to admire the flowers and celebrate. When the plants were divided at the roots, one becoming several, he would give them to his friends without holding anything back. Watching his friends happily take away the fruits of his labor made Lao She very glad. Once, the young man who delivered the milk exclaimed "What a lovely smell!" as soon as he came in, which made Lao She especially happy.

column1: 当然，也有伤心的时候。一年夏天，下了暴雨，邻居家的墙倒了，菊花被砸死了一百多棵，这下可把老舍难受坏了，一连几天人们都看不到他脸上的笑容。
column2: Dāngrán, yě yǒu shāngxīn de shíhou. Yì nián xiàtiān, xià le bàoyǔ, línjū jiā de qiáng dǎo le, júhuā bèi zá sǐ le yìbǎi duō kē, zhè xià kě bǎ Lǎo Shě nánshòu huài le, yìlián jǐ tiān rénmen dōu kàn bu dào tā liǎn shang de xiàoróng.
column3: Of course, there were sad times too. One summer, during a rainstorm, the neighbors' wall collapsed and crushed more than a hundred chrysanthemums to death. That really upset Lao She terribly, and for several days in a row no one saw a smile on his face.

column1: “有喜有悲，有笑有泪”，这是老舍对养花、对生活的体验。“我不知道花草们受我的照顾，感谢我不感谢，反正我要感谢它们。”老舍在自己的文章中这样写道。从中我们不难看出老舍先生对大自然的热爱，对生活的热爱。
column2: Yǒu xǐ yǒu bēi, yǒu xiào yǒu lèi, zhè shì Lǎo Shě duì yǎng huā, duì shēnghuó de tǐyàn. "Wǒ bù zhīdào huācǎomen shòu wǒ de zhàogù, gǎnxiè wǒ bù gǎnxiè, fǎnzhèng wǒ yào gǎnxiè tāmen." Lǎo Shě zài zìjǐ de wénzhāng zhōng zhèyàng xiě dào. Cóng zhōng wǒmen bù nán kàn chū Lǎo Shě xiānsheng duì dàzìrán de rè'ài, duì shēnghuó de rè'ài.
column3: There's joy and sorrow, laughter and tears—this was Lao She's experience of growing flowers and of life. "I don't know whether the flowers and plants, having received my care, are grateful to me or not, but in any case I want to thank them," Lao She wrote in one of his essays. From this it's easy to see Lao She's love of nature and his love of life.

column1: # hsk-6 · HSK标准教程6（课文原文，整段） — 手写拼音+英文（2026-10）
林林和天天是同学。天天的父母要出差，想请我们帮忙照看几天女儿，我和老公爽快地答应下来，有个孩子和我们的独生女朝夕相处，我们巴不得呢！最兴奋的是林林，嚷着要用爸爸最拿手的美味佳肴欢迎天天来我家，还提出，她的书桌可以和天天共用。看到女儿对伙伴热情无私，我和老公别提多高兴了。
column2: Línlín hé Tiāntiān shì tóngxué. Tiāntiān de fùmǔ yào chūchāi, xiǎng qǐng wǒmen bāngmáng zhàokàn jǐ tiān nǚ'ér, wǒ hé lǎogōng shuǎngkuai de dāying xialai, yǒu ge háizi hé wǒmen de dúshēngnǚ zhāoxī xiāngchǔ, wǒmen bā bu de ne! Zuì xīngfèn de shì Línlín, rǎngzhe yào yòng bàba zuì náshǒu de měiwèi jiāyáo huānyíng Tiāntiān lái wǒ jiā, hái tíchū, tā de shūzhuō kěyǐ hé Tiāntiān gòngyòng. Kàndào nǚ'ér duì huǒbàn rèqíng wúsī, wǒ hé lǎogōng biétí duō gāoxìng le.
column3: Linlin and Tiantian are classmates. Tiantian's parents had to go on a business trip and wanted us to look after their daughter for a few days, and my husband and I readily agreed—having a child spend day and night with our only daughter was exactly what we wished for! The most excited was Linlin, who clamored to welcome Tiantian to our home with her dad's best signature dishes, and even offered to share her desk with Tiantian. Seeing our daughter so warm and selfless toward her friend, my husband and I couldn't have been happier.

column1: 天天还没来，林林就变得异常勤劳，将屋子收拾得干干净净，东西摆放得整整齐齐，什么好事都想着天天。我家林林虽是女孩，却也绅士风度十足。
column2: Tiāntiān hái méi lái, Línlín jiù biàn de yìcháng qínláo, jiāng wūzi shōushi de gāngān jìngjìng, dōngxi bǎifàng de zhěngzhěng qíqí, shénme hǎo shì dōu xiǎngzhe Tiāntiān. Wǒ jiā Línlín suī shì nǚhái, què yě shēnshì fēngdù shízú.
column3: Before Tiantian had even arrived, Linlin became unusually hardworking: she tidied the room until it was spotless and arranged everything neatly, and whatever good thing there was, she thought of Tiantian first. Although our Linlin is a girl, she was a perfect gentleman.

column1: 天天的到来，使我和老公的日子过得异常省心。两个孩子每天早上不用叫就醒了，上学不用接送，做作业不用督促；她们不打架，不闹别扭，关系别提多融洽了。看到女儿和天天这么亲密，大有忽略我们的趋势，我和老公都有点儿嫉妒了。
column2: Tiāntiān de dàolái, shǐ wǒ hé lǎogōng de rìzi guò de yìcháng shěngxīn. Liǎng ge háizi měi tiān zǎoshang bú yòng jiào jiù xǐng le, shàngxué bú yòng jiēsòng, zuò zuòyè bú yòng dūcù; tāmen bù dǎjià, bú nào bièniu, guānxi biétí duō róngqià le. Kàndào nǚ'ér hé Tiāntiān zhème qīnmì, dà yǒu hūlüè wǒmen de qūshì, wǒ hé lǎogōng dōu yǒudiǎnr jídù le.
column3: Tiantian's arrival made life remarkably worry-free for my husband and me. The two children woke up every morning without being called, didn't need to be taken to and from school, and didn't need to be pushed to do their homework; they didn't fight or sulk, and got along wonderfully. Seeing our daughter so close to Tiantian that she seemed well on her way to ignoring us, my husband and I both got a little jealous.

column1: 这天晚上，两个孩子做完作业，开始滔滔不绝地聊了起来，一个说，我不喜欢王朵朵，她就喜欢跟穿得漂亮的同学一起玩儿，还老嘲笑别人。另一个说我讨厌高春来，他最会讨好老师了……
column2: Zhè tiān wǎnshang, liǎng ge háizi zuòwán zuòyè, kāishǐ tāotāo bù jué de liáo le qilai, yí ge shuō, wǒ bù xǐhuan Wáng Duǒduo, tā jiù xǐhuan gēn chuān de piàoliang de tóngxué yìqǐ wánr, hái lǎo cháoxiào biérén. Lìng yí ge shuō wǒ tǎoyàn Gāo Chūnlái, tā zuì huì tǎohǎo lǎoshī le……
column3: That evening, after finishing their homework, the two children began chatting nonstop. One said, I don't like Wang Duoduo—she only likes playing with classmates who dress nicely, and she's always making fun of others. The other said, I can't stand Gao Chunlai—he's the best at sucking up to the teacher...

column1: 我和老公对视一眼，这么小的孩子怎么学会了背后议论人。我郑重地走到她们跟前，严肃地说：“看到别人有缺点，应该当面说，背后说人家的坏话不好。”老公也在旁边附和：“大伙儿要和睦相处，对人要宽容。”女儿却是一脸的疑惑，反问道：“你们不是也有时候说，哪个朋友好相处，哪个朋友很自私吗？”瞬间我和老公被问得说不出话来，屋子里鸦雀无声。
column2: Wǒ hé lǎogōng duìshì yì yǎn, zhème xiǎo de háizi zěnme xuéhuì le bèihòu yìlùn rén. Wǒ zhèngzhòng de zǒudào tāmen gēnqián, yánsù de shuō: "Kàndào biérén yǒu quēdiǎn, yīnggāi dāngmiàn shuō, bèihòu shuō rénjia de huàihuà bù hǎo." Lǎogōng yě zài pángbiān fùhè: "Dàhuǒr yào hémù xiāngchǔ, duì rén yào kuānróng." Nǚ'ér què shì yì liǎn de yíhuò, fǎnwèn dào: "Nǐmen bú shì yě yǒu shíhou shuō, nǎge péngyou hǎo xiāngchǔ, nǎge péngyou hěn zìsī ma?" Shùnjiān wǒ hé lǎogōng bèi wèn de shuō bu chū huà lai, wūzi li yāquè wú shēng.
column3: My husband and I exchanged a glance—how had such young children learned to talk about people behind their backs? I walked over to them solemnly and said seriously, "If you see that someone has a fault, you should tell them to their face; speaking ill of people behind their backs isn't nice." My husband chimed in beside me: "Everyone should get along in harmony and be tolerant of others." But our daughter looked puzzled and asked back, "Don't you sometimes say too which friend is easy to get along with and which friend is selfish?" In an instant my husband and I were left speechless, and the room fell completely silent.

column1: 人们常说，启蒙老师的重要性不可忽视，父母就是孩子的第一任老师，这话确实不假，可如果这次不是女儿反驳，我还意识不到，我们自己的做法和对孩子的要求实行的是两套标准，那便是对自己宽容，对孩子严厉。孩子也可以是我们的老师啊。
column2: Rénmen cháng shuō, qǐméng lǎoshī de zhòngyàoxìng bùkě hūshì, fùmǔ jiù shì háizi de dì-yī rèn lǎoshī, zhè huà quèshí bù jiǎ, kě rúguǒ zhè cì bú shì nǚ'ér fǎnbó, wǒ hái yìshí bu dào, wǒmen zìjǐ de zuòfǎ hé duì háizi de yāoqiú shíxíng de shì liǎng tào biāozhǔn, nà biàn shì duì zìjǐ kuānróng, duì háizi yánlì. Háizi yě kěyǐ shì wǒmen de lǎoshī a.
column3: People often say that the importance of one's first teacher can't be overlooked, and that parents are a child's first teachers. That's certainly true, but if my daughter hadn't talked back this time, I still wouldn't have realized that we were applying two sets of standards—one for our own behavior and another for what we demanded of our child: lenient with ourselves, strict with her. Children can be our teachers too.

column1: 说真的，这次是孩子给我上了一课：我深深地感到，想当好父母，首先要约束好自己的言行。
column2: Shuō zhēn de, zhè cì shì háizi gěi wǒ shàng le yí kè: wǒ shēnshēn de gǎndào, xiǎng dānghǎo fùmǔ, shǒuxiān yào yuēshù hǎo zìjǐ de yánxíng.
