Zuìjìn yòu yǒu rén tōngguò wǎngluò, hé péngyou, péngyou de péngyou héhuǒ chóubèi zījīn mǎi fáng, rénmen shì zhè yí chuàngjǔ wéi hùliánwǎng jīnróng xià de xīn chéngyuán.
column3: The internet hasn't been part of our lives for long, yet it has made us truly feel that life is changing with each passing day. It lets us talk, video-chat and send messages freely, even if you are at the ends of the earth; it keeps our lives from being dull and dreary, making every day romantic, rich and fulfilling; it has made shopping and trading from afar possible—without leaving home we can pick whatever we like from European and American goods; we can study online, freely and without losing the fun; we can look for jobs online, simply and efficiently; we can set up personal websites that both widen your circle of friends and satisfy your little bit of vanity, and if you like, you can also set up websites for your relatives and friends as precious gifts for them. Recently, some people have even used the internet to pool money with friends, and friends of friends, to buy homes—an innovation people regard as a new member of internet finance.

column1: 据集资买房项目发起人介绍，此次众筹买房，初步打算召集200人，筹备建立众筹家园小区。众筹购房的好处在于价格上拥有明显优势，比市场价至少便宜30%，无论是投资还是自住，都很合算。项目沟通中，微信是主要渠道，申请人递交申请表、通过审查后，缴纳100元订金就可以进入购房微信群，项目的设计、户型、价格等，全部由大家商议决定。
column2: Jù jízī mǎi fáng xiàngmù fāqǐrén jièshào, cǐ cì zhòngchóu mǎi fáng, chūbù dǎsuan zhàojí liǎngbǎi rén, chóubèi jiànlì zhòngchóu jiāyuán xiǎoqū. Zhòngchóu gòu fáng de hǎochu zàiyú jiàgé shang yōngyǒu míngxiǎn yōushì, bǐ shìchǎngjià zhìshǎo piányi bǎi fēn zhī sānshí, wúlùn shì tóuzī háishi zì zhù, dōu hěn hésuàn. Xiàngmù gōutōng zhōng, Wēixìn shì zhǔyào qúdào, shēnqǐngrén dìjiāo shēnqǐngbiǎo, tōngguò shěnchá hòu, jiǎonà yìbǎi yuán dìngjīn jiù kěyǐ jìnrù gòu fáng Wēixìn qún, xiàngmù de shèjì, hùxíng, jiàgé děng, quánbù yóu dàjiā shāngyì juédìng.
column3: According to the initiator of the pooled home-buying project, this crowdfunded purchase initially plans to gather 200 people to prepare to build a crowdfunded residential community. The advantage of crowdfunding a home lies in its clear price edge: it is at least 30% cheaper than the market price, a good deal whether as an investment or to live in. WeChat is the main channel of communication for the project: after submitting an application form and passing review, applicants pay a 100-yuan deposit to join the home-buying WeChat group, and the project's design, floor plans, prices and so on are all decided through group discussion.

column1: 大家深知买房对每个家庭都不是小事，众筹买房也还处于摸索阶段，因此必须慎重。众筹的参与者，都是发起人的朋友，或者朋友的朋友。他们层次较高，都有一定的经济基础，对新生事物有强烈好奇心，基本属于同一阶层。用发起人的话说，众筹不是在筹房子，而是在凝聚人心。房子怎么设计、对国家的政策怎么理解、失败了怎么办？大家每天在微信群你来我往，忙碌而欢乐，除了严肃的房价，这种共商大事的感觉也很让人着迷。
column2: Dàjiā shēnzhī mǎi fáng duì měi ge jiātíng dōu bú shì xiǎoshì, zhòngchóu mǎi fáng yě hái chǔyú mōsuǒ jiēduàn, yīncǐ bìxū shènzhòng. Zhòngchóu de cānyùzhě, dōu shì fāqǐrén de péngyou, huòzhě péngyou de péngyou. Tāmen céngcì jiào gāo, dōu yǒu yídìng de jīngjì jīchǔ, duì xīnshēng shìwù yǒu qiángliè hàoqíxīn, jīběn shǔyú tóng yí jiēcéng. Yòng fāqǐrén de huà shuō, zhòngchóu bú shì zài chóu fángzi, ér shì zài níngjù rénxīn. Fángzi zěnme shèjì, duì guójiā de zhèngcè zěnme lǐjiě, shībàile zěnme bàn? Dàjiā měi tiān zài Wēixìn qún nǐlái wǒwǎng, mánglù ér huānlè, chúle yánsù de fángjià, zhè zhǒng gòng shāng dàshì de gǎnjué yě hěn ràng rén zháomí.
column3: Everyone knows full well that buying a home is no small matter for any family, and crowdfunded home buying is still at an exploratory stage, so it calls for great caution. The participants are all friends of the initiator, or friends of friends. They are fairly high-level, all have a certain economic base and a strong curiosity about new things, and basically belong to the same social stratum. In the initiator's words, crowdfunding isn't about raising money for houses but about bringing people together. How should the houses be designed? How should national policies be understood? What if it fails? Every day people go back and forth in the WeChat group, busy and happy; apart from the serious matter of house prices, this feeling of deciding big things together is also fascinating.

column1: 什么是“众筹”？说白了，就是大家筹钱干一件事，上文所说的“众筹”更像是“集资建房”，广义的“众筹”则是互联网金融的产物，指创业者通过网络向众多素不相识的人争取资金支持。
column2: Shénme shì "zhòngchóu"? Shuōbái le, jiù shì dàjiā chóu qián gàn yí jiàn shì, shàngwén suǒ shuō de "zhòngchóu" gèng xiàng shì "jízī jiàn fáng", guǎngyì de "zhòngchóu" zé shì hùliánwǎng jīnróng de chǎnwù, zhǐ chuàngyèzhě tōngguò wǎngluò xiàng zhòngduō sùbù xiāngshí de rén zhēngqǔ zījīn zhīchí.
column3: What is "crowdfunding"? Put simply, it's everyone pooling money to do something. The "crowdfunding" described above is more like "pooling funds to build homes"; in the broad sense, "crowdfunding" is a product of internet finance, referring to entrepreneurs seeking financial support online from large numbers of strangers.

column1: 世界上第一个让初创公司梦想成真的众筹网站是美国的Kickstarter。2011年5月，中国国内首家众筹网站——点名时间，将Kickstarter的模式搬进了中国，之后众筹平台越来越多。如今，从慈善到图书出版，从电影制作到创业项目，众筹几乎跨越了所有的领域。
column2: Shìjiè shang dì-yī ge ràng chūchuàng gōngsī mèngxiǎng chéng zhēn de zhòngchóu wǎngzhàn shì Měiguó de Kickstarter. Èr líng yī yī nián wǔ yuè, Zhōngguó guónèi shǒu jiā zhòngchóu wǎngzhàn — Diǎnmíng Shíjiān, jiāng Kickstarter de móshì bānjìnle Zhōngguó, zhīhòu zhòngchóu píngtái yuè lái yuè duō. Rújīn, cóng císhàn dào túshū chūbǎn, cóng diànyǐng zhìzuò dào chuàngyè xiàngmù, zhòngchóu jīhū kuàyuèle suǒyǒu de lǐngyù.
column3: The world's first crowdfunding website to make start-ups' dreams come true was Kickstarter in the United States. In May 2011, China's first domestic crowdfunding website, Demohour (Dianming Shijian), brought the Kickstarter model to China, and after that more and more crowdfunding platforms appeared. Today, from charity to book publishing and from film production to start-up projects, crowdfunding spans almost every field.

column1: 美微传媒CEO朱江做梦也没想到，他成了传说中的“中国众筹第一人”。那年，朱江开始在淘宝网出售美微会员卡，购买会员卡就是购买公司的原始股票，每股1.2元，最低认购100股，也就是说，花120元就可以成为持有美微股份的股东。朱江回忆起当时钞票源源不断流进来的感觉，真的有种苦尽甘来的味道。
column2: Měiwēi Chuánméi CEO Zhū Jiāng zuòmèng yě méi xiǎngdào, tā chéngle chuánshuō zhōng de "Zhōngguó zhòngchóu dì-yī rén". Nà nián, Zhū Jiāng kāishǐ zài Táobǎo Wǎng chūshòu Měiwēi huìyuánkǎ, gòumǎi huìyuánkǎ jiù shì gòumǎi gōngsī de yuánshǐ gǔpiào, měi gǔ yī diǎn èr yuán, zuì dī rèngòu yìbǎi gǔ, yě jiù shì shuō, huā yìbǎi èrshí yuán jiù kěyǐ chéngwéi chíyǒu Měiwēi gǔfèn de gǔdōng. Zhū Jiāng huíyì qi dāngshí chāopiào yuányuán búduàn liú jinlai de gǎnjué, zhēn de yǒu zhǒng kǔjìn gānlái de wèidao.
column3: Zhu Jiang, CEO of Meiwei Media, never dreamed he would become the legendary "first person of Chinese crowdfunding". That year, Zhu Jiang began selling Meiwei membership cards on Taobao. Buying a membership card meant buying the company's original shares, at 1.2 yuan per share with a minimum subscription of 100 shares—in other words, for 120 yuan you could become a shareholder holding Meiwei stock. When Zhu Jiang recalls the feeling of money pouring in non-stop back then, it really did taste like sweetness coming after bitterness.

column1: 时至今日，众筹项目有成功的，也有处境尴尬的，而国内第一家众筹网站“点名时间”三年以后却抛弃了“众筹”，改营其他。坦白地讲，国内用户与国外有很大区别，比如，Kickstarter上聚集着一群理想主义者，他们心中充满向往，购买时感性因素超越了理性。国内用户则希望尽快得到回报，甚至有些急功近利，而用户的心态很大程度上决定了项目成功的可能性。再比如，国内用户对收获时间和产品质量要求较高，如果认为产品不符合预期，或是项目进展比计划的慢，就会发牢骚，有怨气。另外，大部分投资者对众筹还是持观望态度。因此，迄今为止众筹在国内还是一个看起来很美、做起来吃力的事情。
column2: Shízhì jīnrì, zhòngchóu xiàngmù yǒu chénggōng de, yě yǒu chǔjìng gāngà de, ér guónèi dì-yī jiā zhòngchóu wǎngzhàn "Diǎnmíng Shíjiān" sān nián yǐhòu què pāoqìle "zhòngchóu", gǎi yíng qítā. Tǎnbái de jiǎng, guónèi yònghù yǔ guówài yǒu hěn dà qūbié, bǐrú, Kickstarter shang jùjízhe yì qún lǐxiǎng zhǔyìzhě, tāmen xīnzhōng chōngmǎn xiàngwǎng, gòumǎi shí gǎnxìng yīnsù chāoyuèle lǐxìng. Guónèi yònghù zé xīwàng jǐnkuài dédào huíbào, shènzhì yǒuxiē jígōng jìnlì, ér yònghù de xīntài hěn dà chéngdù shang juédìngle xiàngmù chénggōng de kěnéngxìng. Zài bǐrú, guónèi yònghù duì shōuhuò shíjiān hé chǎnpǐn zhìliàng yāoqiú jiào gāo, rúguǒ rènwéi chǎnpǐn bù fúhé yùqī, huò shì xiàngmù jìnzhǎn bǐ jìhuà de màn, jiù huì fā láosāo, yǒu yuànqì. Lìngwài, dà bùfen tóuzīzhě duì zhòngchóu háishi chí guānwàng tàidu. Yīncǐ, qìjīn wéizhǐ zhòngchóu zài guónèi háishi yí ge kàn qilai hěn měi, zuò qilai chīlì de shìqing.
column3: To this day, some crowdfunding projects have succeeded while others are in an awkward position, and China's first crowdfunding website, Demohour, abandoned "crowdfunding" three years later and switched to other business. Frankly speaking, domestic users differ greatly from those abroad. For example, Kickstarter gathers a crowd of idealists whose hearts are full of aspiration, and when they buy, emotion outweighs reason. Domestic users, by contrast, hope to get returns as soon as possible and are even somewhat eager for quick success, and users' mindset largely determines a project's chances of success. As another example, domestic users have high expectations of delivery times and product quality; if they feel a product falls short of expectations, or a project progresses more slowly than planned, they grumble and get resentful. In addition, most investors still take a wait-and-see attitude toward crowdfunding. So far, therefore, crowdfunding in China is still something that looks beautiful but is hard work to do.

column1: 是啊，在互联网变得家喻户晓，给我们的生活带来许许多多的方便和乐趣的同时，也给我们增添了无穷无尽的烦恼，众筹平台上有，其他领域也有。据官方报道，尚未查明身份的罪犯盗窃了1800万个电子邮件账户及其密码；仅有两三个人的皮包公司公然冒充国家部门开设了一家假网站，大肆进行诈骗，如今已被警方依法刑事拘留；还有时时活跃着的网络黑客。每次类似这些败坏互联网名誉的事件一经曝光，就会使我们有种触目惊心之感。
column2: Shì a, zài hùliánwǎng biàn de jiāyù hùxiǎo, gěi wǒmen de shēnghuó dàilái xǔxǔduōduō de fāngbiàn hé lèqù de tóngshí, yě gěi wǒmen zēngtiānle wúqióng wújìn de fánnǎo, zhòngchóu píngtái shang yǒu, qítā lǐngyù yě yǒu. Jù guānfāng bàodào, shàngwèi chámíng shēnfen de zuìfàn dàoqièle yìqiān bābǎi wàn ge diànzǐ yóujiàn zhànghù jí qí mìmǎ; jǐn yǒu liǎng sān ge rén de píbāo gōngsī gōngrán màochōng guójiā bùmén kāishèle yì jiā jiǎ wǎngzhàn, dàsì jìnxíng zhàpiàn, rújīn yǐ bèi jǐngfāng yīfǎ xíngshì jūliú; hái yǒu shíshí huóyuèzhe de wǎngluò hēikè. Měi cì lèisì zhèxiē bàihuài hùliánwǎng míngyù de shìjiàn yìjīng bàoguāng, jiù huì shǐ wǒmen yǒu zhǒng chùmù jīngxīn zhī gǎn.
column3: Indeed, while the internet has become a household name and brought our lives a great deal of convenience and fun, it has also added endless troubles—on crowdfunding platforms and in other fields too. According to official reports, criminals whose identities have yet to be established stole 18 million email accounts and their passwords; a shell company of only two or three people brazenly posed as a government department and set up a fake website to carry out large-scale fraud, and its people have now been criminally detained by the police according to law; and then there are the hackers who are always active online. Every time incidents like these that damage the internet's reputation come to light, they give us a shocking feeling.

column1: 这就是互联网时代，在我们对它爱不释手的同时，也不免对它心存担忧。
column2: Zhè jiù shì hùliánwǎng shídài, zài wǒmen duì tā àibú shìshǒu de tóngshí, yě bùmiǎn duì tā xīn cún dānyōu.
column3: This is the internet age: even as we can't bear to put it down, we can't help harboring worries about it.

column1: 我们一直以为世界纪录就是要不断被打破，但国际田联公布的各项比赛成绩却告诉我们，多数世界纪录都是在20世纪90年代创造的。此外，更有人引用《每日电讯报》的说法称：截至2060年，人类可能不会再创造体坛新纪录。
column2: Wǒmen yìzhí yǐwéi shìjiè jìlù jiù shì yào búduàn bèi dǎpò, dàn Guójì Tiánlián gōngbù de gè xiàng bǐsài chéngjì què gàosu wǒmen, duōshù shìjiè jìlù dōu shì zài èrshí shìjì jiǔshí niándài chuàngzào de. Cǐwài, gèng yǒu rén yǐnyòng "Měirì Diànxùn Bào" de shuōfǎ chēng: jiézhì èr líng liù líng nián, rénlèi kěnéng bú huì zài chuàngzào tǐtán xīn jìlù.
column3: We have always thought world records are meant to be broken again and again, but the competition results published by the IAAF tell us that most world records were set in the 1990s. Moreover, some people even cite The Daily Telegraph as saying that by 2060, humans may no longer set new sports records.

column1: 一个人的体能究竟有多大？人们在力争打破世界纪录的同时，不禁会对自己的身体产生疑问。比如说，100米短跑最快需要几秒？这不是一个简单的谁拿冠军、谁拿亚军、谁拿季军的问题，这是对人类体能极限的追问。
column2: Yí ge rén de tǐnéng jiūjìng yǒu duō dà? Rénmen zài lìzhēng dǎpò shìjiè jìlù de tóngshí, bùjīn huì duì zìjǐ de shēntǐ chǎnshēng yíwèn. Bǐrú shuō, yìbǎi mǐ duǎnpǎo zuì kuài xūyào jǐ miǎo? Zhè bú shì yí ge jiǎndān de shéi ná guànjūn, shéi ná yàjūn, shéi ná jìjūn de wèntí, zhè shì duì rénlèi tǐnéng jíxiàn de zhuīwèn.
column3: Just how great is a person's physical capacity? While striving to break world records, people can't help questioning their own bodies. For example, what is the fastest possible time for the 100-meter sprint? This is not simply a question of who wins gold, silver or bronze; it is an inquiry into the limits of human physical ability.

column1: 有专家认为，人类跑100米速度的极限应该是10.42秒，再考虑一般跑到80米才能达到全速，人类可能达到的最快速度大约为11.96米/秒。
column2: Yǒu zhuānjiā rènwéi, rénlèi pǎo yìbǎi mǐ sùdù de jíxiàn yīnggāi shì shí diǎn sì èr miǎo, zài kǎolǜ yìbān pǎodào bāshí mǐ cái néng dádào quánsù, rénlèi kěnéng dádào de zuì kuài sùdù dàyuē wéi shíyī diǎn jiǔ liù mǐ měi miǎo.
column3: Some experts believe the limit of human speed over 100 meters should be 10.42 seconds; considering further that runners generally only reach full speed at around 80 meters, the fastest speed humans could achieve is about 11.96 meters per second.

column1: 然而，在那条狭窄的跑道上，任性的牙买加田径比赛选手博尔特简直就不把世界纪录放在眼里！2008年6月1日，在美国纽约锐步大奖赛上，他以9.72秒的成绩获得100米短跑冠军，打破了同胞鲍威尔保持的9.74秒的世界纪录；2008年8月16日北京奥运会百米决赛电视直播中，飘动的旗帜汇成了沸腾的海洋，他以9.69秒的成绩再次刷新世界纪录，领先亚军0.2秒。振奋之余人们不禁再次追问——人体运动到底有没有极限？
column2: Rán'ér, zài nà tiáo xiázhǎi de pǎodào shang, rènxìng de Yámǎijiā tiánjìng bǐsài xuǎnshǒu Bó'ěrtè jiǎnzhí jiù bù bǎ shìjiè jìlù fàng zài yǎn li! Èr líng líng bā nián liù yuè yī rì, zài Měiguó Niǔyuē Ruìbù Dàjiǎngsài shang, tā yǐ jiǔ diǎn qī èr miǎo de chéngjì huòdé yìbǎi mǐ duǎnpǎo guànjūn, dǎpòle tóngbāo Bàowēi'ěr bǎochí de jiǔ diǎn qī sì miǎo de shìjiè jìlù; èr líng líng bā nián bā yuè shíliù rì Běijīng Àoyùnhuì bǎi mǐ juésài diànshì zhíbō zhōng, piāodòng de qízhì huìchéngle fèiténg de hǎiyáng, tā yǐ jiǔ diǎn liù jiǔ miǎo de chéngjì zàicì shuāxīn shìjiè jìlù, lǐngxiān yàjūn líng diǎn èr miǎo. Zhènfèn zhī yú rénmen bùjīn zàicì zhuīwèn — réntǐ yùndòng dàodǐ yǒu méiyǒu jíxiàn?
column3: However, on that narrow track, the headstrong Jamaican track-and-field athlete Bolt simply paid no attention to world records! On June 1, 2008, at the Reebok Grand Prix in New York, he won the 100-meter sprint in 9.72 seconds, breaking the 9.74-second world record held by his compatriot Powell. On August 16, 2008, in the live TV broadcast of the 100-meter final at the Beijing Olympics, as fluttering flags merged into a seething sea, he broke the world record again with 9.69 seconds, finishing 0.2 seconds ahead of the runner-up. Amid the excitement, people couldn't help asking once more: is there really a limit to human athletic performance?

column1: 有研究者分解了博尔特取得9.72秒成绩的那次比赛动作，并利用公式做了精密计算，结论是：他是从静止状态开跑的，9.72秒还包括了加速的时间，如果他跑200米，那么，第二个100米会比第一个100米快，因为没有起跑的过程。
column2: Yǒu yánjiūzhě fēnjiěle Bó'ěrtè qǔdé jiǔ diǎn qī èr miǎo chéngjì de nà cì bǐsài dòngzuò, bìng lìyòng gōngshì zuòle jīngmì jìsuàn, jiélùn shì: tā shì cóng jìngzhǐ zhuàngtài kāipǎo de, jiǔ diǎn qī èr miǎo hái bāokuòle jiāsù de shíjiān, rúguǒ tā pǎo liǎngbǎi mǐ, nàme, dì-èr ge yìbǎi mǐ huì bǐ dì-yī ge yìbǎi mǐ kuài, yīnwèi méiyǒu qǐpǎo de guòchéng.
column3: One researcher broke down Bolt's movements in the race where he ran 9.72 seconds and made precise calculations with formulas. The conclusion: he started running from a standstill, so the 9.72 seconds included acceleration time; if he ran 200 meters, the second 100 meters would be faster than the first, because there would be no start.

column1: 数据相差如此悬殊，我们到底信谁？飞人博尔特创造的奇迹怎么解释？我们还能迷信专家吗？一时舆论哗然，质疑不断，专家、学者、网民纷纷自发掀起人体极限的讨论。
column2: Shùjù xiāngchà rúcǐ xuánshū, wǒmen dàodǐ xìn shéi? Fēirén Bó'ěrtè chuàngzào de qíjì zěnme jiěshì? Wǒmen hái néng míxìn zhuānjiā ma? Yìshí yúlùn huárán, zhìyí búduàn, zhuānjiā, xuézhě, wǎngmín fēnfēn zìfā xiānqǐ réntǐ jíxiàn de tǎolùn.
column3: With such a huge gap in the figures, whom should we believe? How can the miracle created by the "flying man" Bolt be explained? Can we still put blind faith in experts? For a time public opinion was in an uproar and doubts kept coming; experts, scholars and netizens one after another spontaneously launched discussions about the limits of the human body.

column1: 有人说，空洞的结论没有说服力，我们还是看看人体结构吧。运动员向前跑的动力大部分由股四头肌提供，股四头肌腱与膝盖连接，运动员才可以加速，这一结构也成为了运动员加速的制约因素，原理就是，超越极限的速度需要的力量足以造成股四头肌腱和膝盖间的连接点撕裂。人体结构是确定的，人体活动当然也有一定的范围，科学就是这么冷酷。
column2: Yǒu rén shuō, kōngdòng de jiélùn méiyǒu shuōfúlì, wǒmen háishi kànkan réntǐ jiégòu ba. Yùndòngyuán xiàng qián pǎo de dònglì dà bùfen yóu gǔsìtóujī tígōng, gǔsìtóujījiàn yǔ xīgài liánjiē, yùndòngyuán cái kěyǐ jiāsù, zhè yì jiégòu yě chéngwéile yùndòngyuán jiāsù de zhìyuē yīnsù, yuánlǐ jiù shì, chāoyuè jíxiàn de sùdù xūyào de lìliàng zúyǐ zàochéng gǔsìtóujījiàn hé xīgài jiān de liánjiēdiǎn sīliè. Réntǐ jiégòu shì quèdìng de, réntǐ huódòng dāngrán yě yǒu yídìng de fànwéi, kēxué jiù shì zhème lěngkù.
column3: Some say empty conclusions are unconvincing, so let's look at the structure of the human body. Most of the power that drives an athlete forward comes from the quadriceps; the quadriceps tendon connects to the knee, which is what lets the athlete accelerate. But this structure also becomes a limiting factor on acceleration. The principle is that the force needed for a speed beyond the limit would be enough to tear the connection between the quadriceps tendon and the knee. The structure of the human body is fixed, so human activity naturally has a certain range too—science is just that cold.

column1: 也有人从运动医学和心理学角度出发，其观点也不无道理。跑步看起来是用腿，其实要动员全身的力量，牵扯到全身各个器官。心脏管辖着全身，如果它出了故障，腿再快也不管用。人进入运动状态后，心率加快，运动时最高心率＝（220－年龄）次/分。运动时的心率应在一定范围内，低限一般是最高心率的60%，高限一般是最高心率的85%。如一名40岁的人，运动时的心率应保持在每分钟108～150次左右，严禁超过心率的极限值，否则会因供血不足发生猝死。
column2: Yě yǒu rén cóng yùndòng yīxué hé xīnlǐxué jiǎodù chūfā, qí guāndiǎn yě bù wú dàoli. Pǎobù kàn qilai shì yòng tuǐ, qíshí yào dòngyuán quánshēn de lìliàng, qiānchě dào quánshēn gègè qìguān. Xīnzàng guǎnxiázhe quánshēn, rúguǒ tā chūle gùzhàng, tuǐ zài kuài yě bù guǎnyòng. Rén jìnrù yùndòng zhuàngtài hòu, xīnlǜ jiākuài, yùndòng shí zuì gāo xīnlǜ děngyú (èrbǎi èrshí jiǎn niánlíng) cì měi fēn. Yùndòng shí de xīnlǜ yīng zài yídìng fànwéi nèi, dīxiàn yìbān shì zuì gāo xīnlǜ de bǎi fēn zhī liùshí, gāoxiàn yìbān shì zuì gāo xīnlǜ de bǎi fēn zhī bāshíwǔ. Rú yì míng sìshí suì de rén, yùndòng shí de xīnlǜ yīng bǎochí zài měi fēnzhōng yìbǎi líng bā zhì yìbǎi wǔshí cì zuǒyòu, yánjìn chāoguò xīnlǜ de jíxiànzhí, fǒuzé huì yīn gōngxuè bùzú fāshēng cùsǐ.
column3: Others approach the question from the angle of sports medicine and psychology, and their views are not without merit. Running looks like it uses the legs, but in fact it mobilizes the strength of the whole body and involves every organ. The heart governs the whole body; if it breaks down, no matter how fast the legs are, it's no use. Once a person starts exercising, the heart rate speeds up; the maximum heart rate during exercise = (220 − age) beats per minute. The heart rate during exercise should stay within a certain range: the lower limit is generally 60% of the maximum heart rate, and the upper limit generally 85%. For example, a 40-year-old should keep their heart rate at around 108 to 150 beats per minute during exercise, and must never exceed the heart-rate limit, or they could die suddenly from an insufficient blood supply.

column1: 每个人的运动极限都不同，长期正规科学的训练，多次接近实战性的“演习”，可以让自己越来越接近极限。人的心理因素弹性很大，积极的精神状态可以激发身体潜能，从而让运动员在竞赛中超水平发挥。
column2: Měi ge rén de yùndòng jíxiàn dōu bùtóng, chángqī zhèngguī kēxué de xùnliàn, duō cì jiējìn shízhànxìng de "yǎnxí", kěyǐ ràng zìjǐ yuè lái yuè jiējìn jíxiàn. Rén de xīnlǐ yīnsù tánxìng hěn dà, jījí de jīngshén zhuàngtài kěyǐ jīfā shēntǐ qiánnéng, cóng'ér ràng yùndòngyuán zài jìngsài zhōng chāo shuǐpíng fāhuī.
column3: Everyone's athletic limit is different. Long-term, regular, scientific training and many "drills" close to real competition can bring you closer and closer to your limit. Human psychological factors are highly elastic: a positive mental state can unlock the body's potential, allowing athletes to perform beyond their usual level in competition.

column1: 体能只有60%是与生俱来的，其余40%要通过训练等外界影响去发挥。故而，体能、心理素质好的运动员，会成为优先选拔的对象。年轻运动员身体资产丰厚，得天独厚的优势就是他们的年龄；老运动员作风过硬，顽强，有志气，不屈服，这些使不少教练员对打破世界纪录依然充满信心。体育界有种说法：“运动员选对了，就成功了一半；通过训练让运动员的超能力发挥出来，那就是百分之百的成功。”
column2: Tǐnéng zhǐyǒu bǎi fēn zhī liùshí shì yǔshēng jùlái de, qíyú bǎi fēn zhī sìshí yào tōngguò xùnliàn děng wàijiè yǐngxiǎng qù fāhuī. Gù'ér, tǐnéng, xīnlǐ sùzhì hǎo de yùndòngyuán, huì chéngwéi yōuxiān xuǎnbá de duìxiàng. Niánqīng yùndòngyuán shēntǐ zīchǎn fēnghòu, détiān dúhòu de yōushì jiù shì tāmen de niánlíng; lǎo yùndòngyuán zuòfēng guòyìng, wánqiáng, yǒu zhìqì, bù qūfú, zhèxiē shǐ bù shǎo jiàoliànyuán duì dǎpò shìjiè jìlù yīrán chōngmǎn xìnxīn. Tǐyùjiè yǒu zhǒng shuōfǎ: "Yùndòngyuán xuǎnduì le, jiù chénggōngle yíbàn; tōngguò xùnliàn ràng yùndòngyuán de chāo nénglì fāhuī chulai, nà jiù shì bǎi fēn zhī bǎi de chénggōng."
column3: Only 60% of physical ability is innate; the remaining 40% has to be developed through training and other external influences. Therefore, athletes with good physical and psychological qualities become the first choice in selection. Young athletes are rich in physical assets, and their unique advantage is their age; veteran athletes have a solid work ethic and are tenacious, ambitious and unyielding. All this keeps many coaches confident about breaking world records. There's a saying in the sports world: "Pick the right athlete and you're halfway to success; bring out the athlete's extraordinary abilities through training, and that's one hundred percent success."

column1: 优秀的选手和科学训练相辅相成，是通往成功的有效手段。如今，教练员依托电脑、超高速摄影机等先进装备以及技术分析等手段来指导训练，用新颖的战术思想指导比赛。谁能顽强地越过人体极限这道“悬崖峭壁”，找到体能的“突破口”，谁就能成为无数竞争者中涌现出来的明星，这也是一个公认的事实。
column2: Yōuxiù de xuǎnshǒu hé kēxué xùnliàn xiāngfǔ xiāngchéng, shì tōngwǎng chénggōng de yǒuxiào shǒuduàn. Rújīn, jiàoliànyuán yītuō diànnǎo, chāo gāosù shèyǐngjī děng xiānjìn zhuāngbèi yǐjí jìshù fēnxī děng shǒuduàn lái zhǐdǎo xùnliàn, yòng xīnyǐng de zhànshù sīxiǎng zhǐdǎo bǐsài. Shéi néng wánqiáng de yuèguò réntǐ jíxiàn zhè dào "xuányá qiàobì", zhǎodào tǐnéng de "tūpòkǒu", shéi jiù néng chéngwéi wúshù jìngzhēngzhě zhōng yǒngxiàn chulai de míngxīng, zhè yě shì yí ge gōngrèn de shìshí.
column3: Outstanding athletes and scientific training complement each other and are an effective path to success. Today, coaches rely on computers, ultra-high-speed cameras and other advanced equipment, as well as technical analysis, to guide training, and use innovative tactical thinking to guide competition. Whoever can tenaciously scale the "sheer cliff" of the human body's limits and find the "breakthrough point" of physical ability will become the star who emerges from countless competitors—this too is a widely recognized fact.
